title: Google Ads Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Digital ROI is a performance-focused marketing partner built on the belief that marketing should lead to measurable business growth, not vanity metrics. Founded in 2018, the company helps small and mid-sized Indian businesses navigate digital marketing by owning the full funnel and focusing on outcomes. Digital ROI has supported brands in healthcare, energy, education, and local services, helping them move from basic lead generation to building strong, predictable pipelines. Guided by values of radical honesty, respect for every person and rupee, and transparent, trackable performance, the team positions itself as the quiet engine behind clients’ growth. In the coming years, Digital ROI aims to refine its lead-to-sale systems, deepen category specialization, and become India’s most trusted lead generation expert.
  
**Role Description**
The Google Ads Executive will manage, optimize, and scale Google Ads campaigns for clients across diverse industries, ensuring performance aligns with business growth objectives. Day-to-day responsibilities include setting up campaigns, conducting keyword research, writing and testing ad copy, managing bids and budgets, and monitoring key metrics such as CTR, CPC, and conversion rates. The role involves analyzing performance data, preparing actionable reports, collaborating with account managers and other team members, and recommending improvements across the funnel to enhance lead quality and ROI. The Google Ads Executive will also stay current with platform updates and best practices, implement A/B tests, and ensure tracking and attribution are correctly set up. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Pune District.
  
**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated expertise in Google Ads campaign setup, optimization, and management, including Search, Display, and remarketing.
* Strong skills in keyword research, ad copywriting, and A/B testing to improve click-through and conversion performance.
* Ability to analyze campaign data using Google Ads, Google Analytics, and related tools, and translate insights into clear recommendations.
* Experience with conversion tracking, basic funnel understanding, and lead generation strategies for small and mid-sized businesses.
* Solid grasp of digital marketing fundamentals, including landing page best practices, basic SEO concepts, and integration with other channels.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain performance and strategy to non-technical stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in an agency or performance marketing role is an advantage; familiarity with lead generation for Indian markets is a plus.

title: Web Manager
description:
**Contract role: 11 months**

**About Us**

CBIZ is a leading professional services company providing accounting, tax, advisory, benefits, insurance, and technology solutions to middle-market organizations across the United States. We help clients navigate complexity, manage risk, and pursue growth through practical insight and disciplined execution.

With more than 9,500 team members across 23 major markets, CBIZ brings deep expertise and local understanding to every engagement, supported by integrated teams across the globe.

**Our Services**

CBIZ delivers a comprehensive range of professional services designed to help organizations grow, manage risk, and navigate complexity.

**Our Service Areas:**

* Accounting
* Tax
* Advisory
* Benefits & HR
* Insurance
* Technology

**Our Mission**

To provide exceptional advice and solutions that help our clients achieve their goals.

**Our Vision**

To be recognized by our clients as the premier provider of accounting, insurance, and other professional business services and by our team members as their employer of choice.

**Join Us on Our Journey**

As we continue to grow and expand our horizons, CBIZ remains committed to delivering exceptional service and value to our clients. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and explore the possibilities that we offer.

**Role Overview**

The Web Manager is responsible for the performance, health, and growth of the company website as a core marketing channel. The role leads search visibility across traditional search (SEO) and AI-driven discovery (AEO/GEO), ensuring the brand is found on Google and cited in AI-generated answers.

The position combines technical ownership with marketing impact, covering site maintenance, optimization, page development, analytics, governance, agency partnerships, and digital investments while connecting web performance to leads, pipeline, and business growth.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Build, edit, and publish pages, landing pages, and templates in the CMS using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Own the SEO, AEO, and GEO roadmap across technical, on-page, and content
* Run technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, sitemaps, canonicals, and internal linking
* Implement structured data (JSON-LD) and entity-led content so the brand is cited in AI-generated answers
* Track rankings, organic traffic, and AI visibility, and report on competitor benchmarks
* Manage day-to-day site health: uptime, security, backups, plugins, and updates
* Improve site speed and Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS)
* Run CRO programs including A/B tests, UX fixes, and form and CTA optimization
* Set up and manage GA4, GTM, Search Console, and heatmap tools with accurate event and conversion tracking
* Build dashboards and deliver regular reports that link web performance to leads and pipeline
* Manage external web, SEO, analytics, and digital agency partners to deliver projects on time, within budget, and aligned to business and website performance goals
* Manage website budgets, agency retainers, software subscriptions, and project investments to maximize efficiency and business impact
* Establish and maintain website governance, including content standards, accessibility requirements, SEO best practices, and publishing workflows

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* 8-10 years in website management, SEO, or digital marketing
* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Marketing, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field
* Hands-on expertise with a WordPress
* Strong technical SEO skills with Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and Search Console
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, schema markup, and page speed tools
* Proficiency in GA4 and GTM, with the ability to present data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* B2B, SaaS, or professional services experience
* Familiarity with Power BI for data analysis
* Experience with website migrations, multilingual SEO, or headless CMS setups

title: Creative Lead (B2B SaaS / Physical AI & Enterprise Drone Autonomy)

Job Title: Creative Lead (B2B SaaS / Physical AI & Enterprise Drone Autonomy)
  
  
Location: Pune, India (On-site)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
We are partnering with a global category leader in Physical AI and enterprise drone autonomy. Our client’s software platform powers mission-critical autonomous operations across 400+ large industrial sites in 70+ countries. Their customer roster includes Fortune 500 leaders across energy, utilities, security, and infrastructure (such as Shell, CSX, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett). With core engineering and business teams based in Pune, they are building the "nervous system" for large industrial sites worldwide.
  
  
The team operates at AI speed—where intelligence and autonomy are at the core of everything. They thrive in a high-agency, high-velocity environment where AI is not a side project, but the operating system for thinking, building, and growing.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a hands-on Creative Lead who will set the creative bar, shape briefs, challenge early concepts, and get their hands dirty building alongside designers, writers, video creators, and AI tools. This is not a review-only leadership role. We need someone with elite taste who can translate complex drone autonomy, enterprise software, and Physical AI into clear, memorable, high-impact creative work.
  
  
You will work across brand, product marketing, demand generation, events, sales enablement, and executive communications. One day you might define the visual direction for a global campaign; the next, you could be storyboarding a product video, rebuilding a high-stakes pitch deck, directing a photoshoot, or prototyping ten concepts with AI before lunch.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
Creative Direction: Set the quality bar across brand systems, campaigns, product storytelling, and customer-facing assets.
  
  
Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, coach, and develop a high-output creative team through clear briefs, sharp feedback, and collaborative execution.
  
  
Multi-Format Execution: Direct and design campaign concepts spanning visual design, motion, video, social, web, events, and sales enablement materials.
  
  
Simplifying Complexity: Translate technical, abstract enterprise software and drone automation concepts into compelling, intuitive stories.
  
  
AI-Native Operations: Use generative AI, automation, and modern creative tools as core parts of the ideation, production, and operational workflow.
  
  
Velocity with Judgment: Establish high-velocity review processes that protect quality without creating approval bottlenecks.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For (Best Suited For)**
Maker-Leaders: Creative leaders who still make, direct, edit, prototype, and present—rather than delegating from a distance.
  
  
Proven Range: Demonstrated taste across brand, campaign, digital, motion, video, or editorial work, backed by a portfolio showing deep judgment.
  
  
AI-Native Mindset: Creators who actively use generative tools to expand ideas, accelerate production, and raise the quality bar.
  
  
Technical Translation Skill: Ability to simplify complex B2B / enterprise concepts into compelling narratives.
  
  
High Agency: Comfort partnering directly with marketers, product teams, sales leaders, and executives in a fast-paced global business.
  
  
**Why Join?**
Massive Creative Surface Area: Shape how a category-defining brand shows up across 400+ enterprise sites in 70+ countries.
  
  
AI at the Core: Build an AI-native creative practice where modern tools and systems let a lean team produce outsized work at speed.
  
  
In-Person Pune Energy: Work closely with a sharp, ambitious team that values direct feedback and rapid iteration.
  
  
The Perks: Unlimited leave policy, flexible working hours, international exposure, no-cap budget for AI tools/courses, and the latest tech stack.

title: GN - SC&E - PRH - Process Excellence – Analyst
description:
***Archer**
is collaborating with
**Accenture**
to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.*
**Level 11: GN - SC&E - PRH – Process Excellence – Analyst**
**Accenture Strategy and Consulting**
**Business Unit:**
Strategy & Consulting, Global Network |
**Areas of Work:**
Process Excellence |
**Level:**
Consultant |
**Location:**
Gurugram, Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata |
**Overall Relevant Exp:**
1-4 years
  
  
As part of Accenture’s Process Excellence organization within Strategy & Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value — taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.
  
  
You are a process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes — working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations — turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
* Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps — and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
* Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
* Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
* Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
* Supports value identification and quantification — gathers baseline data and helps define KPIs and success metrics.
* Supports business development and client workshops — conducts research and prepares materials that convey the solution and its business impact.

**Desirable Skills**

* Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
* Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
* Process discovery & analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.

**Educational Qualification**
MBA or Master’s degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.
  
  
**Must-have Skills**

* Deep process design expertise across Business Process Design and Workflow Analysis & Design, with hands-on experience re-designing processes to be AI-native and AI-ready — building workflows for AI and automation from the ground up.
* Strong native AI fluency — NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
* Hands-on experience in Process Discovery and Process Analysis - ability to map and analyze current-state processes, identify optimization and automation opportunities, and drive Value Discovery that quantifies the business case for change.
* Domain Consulting depth in one or more industry sectors or functional areas — bringing process, operating-model, and industry knowledge to shape credible, context-aware solutions.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.

**About Accenture**
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.
  
  
Visit us at www.accenture.com

title: Facilitator
description:
What if the most important thing you brought to this role wasn't a lesson plan, but the willingness to knock on a door, sit with a family on their terms, and bring a child back into the room the next day?

We're looking for someone who understands that learning here doesn't start in the classroom. It starts with a relationship with a household, often one that has had a difficult or inconsistent history with formal education. This role has two halves that can't really be separated: going into the community to build the trust that gets children to show up, and then, once they're in the room, noticing who's holding back, who's ready to move ahead, and what each learner needs next.

This is not a role for someone who wants to simply “deliver sessions” to whoever happens to be present. It’s for someone who wants to build both the pipeline of trust that brings children from marginalised community households into the program, and the space where their learning can actually happen once they’re there. You’ll work closely with children of the age group of 10 and above, to strengthen foundational literacy and numeracy (FLN), build digital literacy, and create a learning environment where children can develop the confidence, skills, and agency to become independent decision-makers.

The Totto-Chan Club  

Totto-Chan Club is Foundation Without’s flagship education intervention, run in partnership with Apni Pathshala. The learning POD serves both children and adults from waste-picker and sanitation worker households, with 30+ learners currently enrolled. The program works on foundational English, Math, and digital literacy, with this role primarily focused on supporting the children’s learning, development, and engagement.

Learners are grouped into four bands, from pre-literacy through independent, aligned with ASER benchmarks. The 24-month goal is Grade 4 level foundational competency, but there's no fixed timeline for any individual learner; movement between literacy bands is based on fixed benchmark accomplishment and on the facilitator's judgment call.

Sessions run across four shifts, Tuesday to Friday and Sunday. The Facilitator will be the daily human anchor of this space, and just as importantly, its bridge into the surrounding community.​

Requirements

**What You’ll Do**

*Community mobilisation*

* Build and hold relationships with our 30-household cohort, many of whom have limited trust in formal institutions and formal learning
* Be a visible, familiar, trusted presence in the community
* Sit with parents and guardians to talk through a learner's progress, address hesitations, and explain what the Club offers and why consistency matters.
* Notice early when a learner's attendance is slipping, and follow up personally, in partnership with the Field Associate, before it becomes a pattern.
* Help families see Totto-Chan Club as something built with the community, not delivered at it

 

*Facilitation and Guidance*

* Facilitate English, Math, Digital Literacy sessions by integrating socio-emotional modes of learning.
* Adapt your teaching in real time so a room with learners in four different bands doesn't leave anyone behind or unchallenged.
* Observe and record where each learner sits on the band spectrum, based on sustained patterns, not a single assessment
* Run regular one-on-one check-ins to understand each learner's confidence and progress, not just their output.
* Use peer-paired exercises, role-plays, and reflection circles as the everyday vehicle for confidence and social-emotional growth, not as a separate add-on
* Maintain observation logs on behaviour, pacing, and confidence, and flag early patterns such as retention issues or confidence gaps
* Be the first point of contact when a learner or family raises a concern, and respond to it
* Contribute to a shared, evolving understanding of each learner's context and journey with the rest of the team

**What we are looking for**

* Prior experience in working with Marathi-speaking communities.
* Comfort in the community as much as in the classroom: you're as willing to sit on a doorstep as you are to run a lesson.
* Complete fluency in Marathi and professional proficiency in English are required. The facilitator should be able to read, write, and speak Marathi, Hindi, and English confidently and effectively.
* Genuine ease with the waste-picker and sanitation worker community's day-to-day realities.
* A facilitator's mindset: you guide, adapt, and respond, rather than lecture.
* Multi-level comfort: you can hold a room with learners at very different starting points without losing anyone.
* Sharp observation: you notice shifts in behaviour, confidence, and pace before they become a problem.
* Reflective practice: you're willing to document, question, and adjust your own approach.
* Patience with the process: some families and learners will take time to trust you, and that's expected, not a failure.
* Daily reliability: trust here is built through repetition, not intensity.

Schedule & Work Details

There are four learning sessions scheduled across the day, covering morning, afternoon, and two evening slots. The working days are Tuesday to Friday and Sunday.

Benefits

Compensation and Benefits

* Probation: There will be a 3-month mutual incubation period. Both you and we will have the option to end the agreement after three months if it isn’t working out.
* Working days and hours: 5 days a week. Work timings are from 10:00 am to 8:00 pm
* Location: Foundation Without office, MIDC, Bhosari, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune.
* Work mode: Fully onsite. The facilitator is expected to be present at the learning POD for sessions, learner support, and programme-related activities.
* Compensation: Annual Cost-to-Company (CTC) between INR 3 - 3.5 lakhs, based on experience and market standards, with provisions for variable compensation based on performance.
* Benefits: We provide benefits such as paid leave, health insurance reimbursement, unmonitored vacation, and travel reimbursements.

title: Functional Medicine Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
HealZen Clinic is a holistic health center focused on personalized, evidence-based functional medicine and nutrition. The clinic designs individualized treatment plans that address root causes rather than just symptoms, integrating functional nutrition, psychological support, and lifestyle modification. HealZen supports clients with a wide range of chronic conditions, including metabolic, hormonal, autoimmune, hematological, and complex digestive issues, as well as antenatal and postnatal functional nutrition care. By blending conventional medicine with traditional wisdom, the clinic uses science-backed formulations based on natural bioactive compounds to promote cellular balance and long-term well-being. Team members join a mission-driven environment dedicated to helping individuals achieve sustainable, holistic health outcomes.

**Role Description**
The Functional Medicine Consultant is a full-time, on-site role based at HealZen Clinic in Pune and upcoming Mumbai Center . The consultant will conduct detailed health assessments, review medical histories, and analyze laboratory and diagnostic data to identify root causes and functional imbalances. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing personalized functional medicine and nutrition protocols, collaborating with physicians and other care providers, and monitoring client progress through follow-up consultations. The role involves educating clients on lifestyle changes, therapeutic nutrition, and evidence-based interventions, while documenting care plans accurately and maintaining clear communication with both clients and the clinical team. The consultant will also support continuous improvement of clinic processes, contribute to case discussions, and stay current with emerging research in functional medicine and integrative health.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong analytical skills to interpret clinical data, lab reports, and complex health histories.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication skills for client counseling, education, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
* Candidates should possess consulting and business process skills to structure treatment plans, streamline workflows, and enhance patient experience.
* Candidates should possess basic finance and practice management awareness to support service planning and resource utilization.
* Relevant qualifications such as a medical degree (MBBS, MD), degree in AYUSH, naturopathy, nutrition, or allied health, with training or certification in functional medicine or integrative medicine.
* Experience working with chronic and lifestyle-related conditions, and familiarity with evidence-based functional nutrition and lifestyle interventions.
* Ability to work in a multidisciplinary clinical environment, demonstrate ethical, non-judgmental care, and maintain detailed, accurate documentation.
* Commitment to continuous learning, research literacy, and adherence to regulatory and professional standards of practice.

title: Physiotherapist
description:
**Company Description**
Livel, a wellness product of Nyle Health, is part of India’s first comprehensive platform focused on functional independence with age. The organization aims to shift healthcare from reactive disease treatment to proactive preservation of strength, balance, mobility, endurance, and resilience in older adults. Using evidence-based scientific assessments, Livel helps identify vulnerability gaps before they progress into disabilities, reducing emotional and financial strain on families and communities. Currently in pilot phase with early cohorts in India, the team is building scalable models to redefine how India ages. The mission is to make functional independence a measurable, preventable, and achievable outcome for every aging individual, contributing to a vision of a functionally independent India.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Physiotherapist role based in the Pune District. The Physiotherapist will conduct comprehensive functional assessments, including evaluation of strength, balance, mobility, and endurance for older adults and other clients. Responsibilities include designing and implementing individualized physiotherapy and exercise programs, monitoring progress, and adjusting treatment plans based on clinical outcomes and client feedback. The role involves educating clients and families on safe movement, fall prevention, and lifestyle changes that support long-term functional independence. The Physiotherapist will collaborate with multidisciplinary team members, maintain accurate clinical documentation, and contribute to developing and refining protocols aligned with Livel’s evidence-based approach.

**Qualifications**

* Formal qualification in Physiotherapy (Bachelor’s or Master’s in Physiotherapy or equivalent) with valid registration/licensure as required.
* Strong clinical skills in musculoskeletal and geriatric physiotherapy, including assessment of strength, balance, mobility, and endurance.
* Ability to design individualized treatment plans, prescribe therapeutic exercises, and use manual therapy or other appropriate modalities.
* Experience or interest in working with older adults, functional independence, fall prevention, and rehabilitation in community or clinical settings.
* Effective communication skills for explaining treatment plans, educating clients and caregivers, and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
* Good documentation and organizational skills, with comfort using digital tools and electronic health records.
* Empathy, patience, and a client-centered approach, with the ability to motivate individuals toward long-term adherence to therapy.
* Ability to work on-site in Pune District, including occasional home or community visits if required.
* Prior experience in evidence-based practice, data-driven care, or startup/innovative healthcare environments is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency in English and local languages spoken in Pune District is preferred.

title: Bid Coordinator & Quantity Takeoff Specialist – RCC, Formwork & Rebar
description:
**About the Position**

We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented
**Junior Quantity Takeoff Specialist**
to join our growing engineering and estimating team in Pune.

The successful candidate will be responsible for performing accurate quantity takeoffs for concrete, formwork, reinforcement steel, and related structural construction activities across residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional projects.

**This position involves responsibilities similar to those of a Senior Quantity Takeoff Specialist, with technical guidance, supervision, and opportunities for professional development.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Concrete Quantity Takeoffs**

* Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for foundations, footings, grade beams, columns, walls, slabs, stairs, and other structural concrete elements.
* Calculate concrete volumes using structural and architectural drawings.
* Identify drawing discrepancies, missing dimensions, and scope gaps.

**2. Formwork Quantity Takeoffs**

* Calculate formwork areas for footings, foundation walls, columns, beams, slabs, shear walls, elevator cores, and stairwells.
* Prepare detailed formwork quantity breakdowns by structural element and construction level.
* Assist with estimating formwork materials, accessories, and related quantities.

**3. Reinforcement Steel Takeoffs**

* Perform rebar quantity takeoffs using structural drawings and reinforcement schedules.
* Calculate reinforcement quantities by bar size, length, weight, and structural element.
* Review reinforcement details, lap lengths, spacing, and bar configurations.
* Assist in preparing rebar quantity summaries and bar bending schedules.

**4. Drawing Review & Quantity Verification**

* Interpret architectural, structural, and construction drawings.
* Review drawings, specifications, addenda, and revisions.
* Compare drawing revisions and identify quantity changes.
* Maintain accurate takeoff records and supporting calculations.

**5. Estimating & Tender Support**

* Prepare quantity takeoff spreadsheets and detailed measurement reports.
* Organize quantities according to project scope, work breakdown structures, and cost codes.
* Assist senior estimators with bid preparation, scope review, and tender documentation.
* Support quantity reconciliation and internal quality checks.

**6. Software & Documentation**

* Perform digital takeoffs using Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, or equivalent estimating software.
* Use Microsoft Excel for quantity calculations, summaries, and reporting.
* Maintain organized digital files, drawing registers, and takeoff documentation.
* Follow company estimating SOPs, quality standards, and submission deadlines.

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Technology, or Quantity Surveying.
* **7+ years of experience**
  in concrete, formwork, structural quantity takeoffs, or construction estimating.
* Good understanding of structural drawings and reinforced concrete construction.
* Working knowledge of Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, AutoCAD, and Microsoft Excel.
* Ability to calculate concrete volumes, formwork areas, and reinforcement quantities.
* Strong mathematical, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Good written and verbal English communication.
* Willingness to learn North American construction drawings, measurement practices, and estimating standards.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with residential high-rise, commercial, industrial, or institutional concrete projects.
* Familiarity with Canadian or North American structural drawings.

**Role Overview**

You will bridge the gap between low-level silicon firmware and high-level cloud management platforms, ensuring our APs deliver enterprise-grade performance, seamless roaming, high security, and cloud-driven scalability. If you have deep expertise in embedded Linux, 802.11 protocols, and cloud-managed networking, we want you on our team.

**Key Responsibilities**

   standards to deliver enterprise-grade performance.

  **Wi-Fi Mesh, Neighbor Awareness Networking (NAN), Fine Timing Measurement/Locationing (IEEE 802.11mc/az)**
  , and advanced enterprise roaming (
  **802.11k/v/r**
  ).
* ****Ecosystem Collaboration:****
  Partner closely with leading Wi-Fi chipset vendors for SDK integration, firmware customization, performance tuning, and hardware platform enablement.

**Edge-to-Cloud Integration**

* ****Cloud-Managed Infrastructure:****
  Design, optimize, and deliver cloud-managed and firewall-managed capabilities including Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), remote configuration, real-time monitoring, and centralized control.
* ****Network & Security Orchestration:****
  Ensure seamless data path orchestration between the AP firmware, local security firewalls, and cloud management dashboards.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Must-Have Technical Expertise**

* ****Wireless Domain Mastery:****
  Strong Wi-Fi Access Point product development experience with a deep understanding of IEEE 802.11 standards (a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be) and wireless security protocols (WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise).

  Hands-on experience developing core firmware/wireless applications for
  **Wi-Fi Mesh, NAN, 802.11mc, 802.11az**
  , and seamless roaming (
  **802.11k, 802.11v, 802.11r**
  ).
* ****Embedded Software Engineering:****
  Expert knowledge of
  **Embedded Linux**
  , Linux kernel internals, device drivers, hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, and system-level debugging.

  Strong proficiency in
  **C/C++**
   development for resource-constrained embedded networking platforms.

  Strong networking background including TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, QoS, and enterprise network protocols.
* ****Network Security:****
  Practical knowledge of network security integrations such as firewall systems, IDS/IPS, threat detection, and policy enforcement at the AP level.

**Good-to-Have (Preferred) Qualifications**

* ****Advanced Security & Data Path:****
  Knowledge of Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), malware detection, sandboxing, and Software-Defined Networking (SDN) in large-scale wireless deployments.
* ****Cloud & DevOps:****
  Direct experience with cloud-managed networking platforms, telemetry/analytics collection, and DevOps/automation frameworks.

  Solid understanding of RF concepts including DFS, dynamic channel planning, interference mitigation, and automated performance optimization.
* ****Next-Gen Tech:****
  Exposure to

  Prior technical leadership or architecture ownership experience shipping commercial carrier-grade or enterprise-grade networking products.

To design, maintain, test and continuously improve the organization's Disaster Recovery and technical resilience capabilities by ensuring that critical systems, applications and infrastructure can be restored within agreed Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) enabling uninterrupted business operations during disruptive events.

Continuous Improvement

* Recommend enhancements to recovery processes, automation capabilities, backup strategies, and recovery architectures.
* Support audit, compliance, and regulatory reviews related to Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity.

title: Dietitian
description:
**Company Description**
Livel, a wellness product of Nyle Health, is part of India’s first comprehensive platform dedicated to preserving functional independence as people age. Recognizing that functional decline often starts well before traditional medical tests detect issues, the organization focuses on proactive, evidence-based assessments to identify vulnerabilities early. With a large and growing senior population, Livel aims to reduce dependence in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), alleviating emotional, financial, and societal strain. Currently in a pilot phase with early cohorts in India, the team is building scalable models that shift healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive preservation. Guided by the mission of making functional independence measurable, preventable, and achievable, Livel works toward the vision of a functionally independent India.

**Role Description**
The Dietitian at Livel will play a key role in designing and delivering nutrition programs that support functional independence for older adults and other clients. This full-time, on-site position in Pune District involves conducting detailed nutritional assessments, developing individualized meal plans, and providing ongoing dietary counseling aligned with medical conditions and functional goals. The Dietitian will collaborate with physicians, physiotherapists, and other health professionals to integrate Medical Nutrition Therapy into comprehensive care plans. Day-to-day activities include monitoring client progress, adjusting interventions based on outcomes, documenting care in accordance with clinical standards, and contributing to educational materials and workshops on healthy aging. The role also involves engaging with clients and caregivers to promote sustainable dietary habits that support strength, mobility, and resilience.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess expertise in Dietetics and Nutrition, with the ability to translate scientific evidence into practical, culturally appropriate dietary recommendations.
* Candidates should possess strong Nutritional Counseling skills, including motivational interviewing and behavior-change techniques tailored to aging populations.
* Candidates should possess experience in Medical Nutrition Therapy, including managing nutrition for chronic conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and obesity.
* Candidates should possess skills in Weight Management, including designing safe and sustainable programs that preserve muscle mass and functional capacity.
* Relevant qualifications such as a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Dietetics, Nutrition, or a related field; registration or licensure as a dietitian/nutritionist where applicable.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team, with strong communication, documentation, and client-education skills.
* Experience working with older adults or in geriatric, rehabilitation, or community health settings is highly beneficial.
* Comfort with using digital tools for record-keeping and outcome tracking, and a commitment to evidence-based, non-discriminatory care.

title: Safety System Administrator (Required Argus Safety Systems, system configuration and safety data migration experience)
description:
**Company Description**
Medicine moves forward here. So will you.
  
  
At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.
  
  
We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.
  
  
That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.
  
  
If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
This role requires working as part of the Safety & MI System Administrator Team performing database administration activities; supporting creation and upgrade of database instances; change control and data migration activities; first line user support and troubleshooting; and training users on databases.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
The Safety System Administrator is primarily responsible for:
  
  

* Maintenance of database libraries
* Involvement in system validation activities
* Interrogating the database and generating outputs for internal and client use
* Training and providing database access to internal and client users

**Principle Functions For the Client (may include but is not limited to the following)**

* Set up and maintenance of project specific database libraries including:
* Products
* Licenses
* Studies
* Reporting destinations
* Documenting and validating any change to the project specific database
* Support during legacy data transfer e.g., validation
* Supporting/providing guidance to the Project Manager / Client / Project Start Up Team during the development of project specific data handling guidelines (to ensure project specific guidelines are necessary and will not impact line listings and report generation)
* Prepare line listings and tabulations and other database outputs for use in aggregate reports, signal detection, reconciliation and other activities as required
* Provide case processing metrics required for invoicing (e.g., number of submissions, number of spontaneous vs initial cases processed)
* Provide database training to clients
* Providing and documenting client / internal team access upon receipt of an approved access request.

**For the Company (may include but is not limited to the following)**

* Coordinate user access (including maintenance and revoking access)
* Maintain database procedures including core data handling conventions
* Provide database training and certification to PrimeVigilance users
* Provide user support
* Involvement in root cause investigation of database related deviations and ensure timely and complete documentation of resulting actions in line with Quality procedures
* Provide case processing quality and compliance metrics to the Quality Team
* Identify areas for improvement and address via training, clarifying changes to data handling guidelines, user guides etc.
* Execute business continuity periodic testing for database failure
* Ensure that existing software bugs, user requests, changes to regulatory requirements etc., are considered and appropriate changes are made and validated as required
* Support IT, database vendor and technical colleagues in troubleshooting and implementing software fixes and enhancements as required

**Other Supportive Responsibilities**
Assist PrimeVigilance senior management on an as needed basis. Potentially provide chargeable consulting / training activities to clients regarding Argus, and if required LSSMV.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Educated to degree standard
  
  
Demonstrated work experience within Argus Safety Systems.
  
  
**Additional Information**
When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
  
  
We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
  
  

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
* Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
* Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Technical Support Engineer**

SailPoint is the leading AI-driven security platform providing autonomous governance that best solves the needs of the modern enterprise. By harnessing the power of AI and machine learning, SailPoint automates and streamlines the complexity of delivering the right access to the right identities and technology resources at the right time. Delivered at the scale our enterprise customers demand.

We are proud of our team and the culture we have built, which has led to our employees voting us “best places to work” – 15 years in a row.

We are seeking a Technical Support Engineer to work directly with SailPoint field personnel and customers to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical problems. As a critical member of our Customer Support Team, you will deliver exceptional technical assistance and collaborate internally to improve product quality and service.

**To excel, the position requires a person:**

* Who is... an outstanding communicator who can explain complex technical concepts in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Who can... utilize aggressive troubleshooting techniques, testing, and creative problem-solving to resolve challenging issues without letting roadblocks stop progress.
* Who will... collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, and  Product Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success Management, and actively support on-call rotations to ensure customer success 24x7.
* Who demonstrates... deep empathy, responsiveness, and a meticulous attention to detail to guide and reassure customers during high-pressure technical situations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Resolve complex technical problems reported by SailPoint customers and field personnel via multiple channels (telephone, email, Microsoft Teams) to maintain high customer satisfaction.
* Escalate highly complex issues to the Engineering team in a timely, structured manner, ensuring that comprehensive details and diagnostic data are captured.
* Document problem solutions and case details meticulously throughout the support lifecycle, publishing solutions in the internal and customer-facing knowledge bases to drive self-service and team efficiency.
* Collaborate with Product Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success Management to provide actionable feedback that improves overall product service, design, and software quality.
* Participate in recurring support review meetings and share knowledge, presenting challenging cases and innovative troubleshooting ideas to continuously upskill the support team.
* Manage and provide 24x7 on-call support via a rotational schedule to ensure continuous coverage for critical incidents.

**The Path to Success (Milestones):**

**1-Month Milestones (The "Learning" Phase):**

* Absorb critical training on SailPoint's core products, architectures (including AWS cloud-native and event-driven microservices), and internal support systems.
* Begin handling P3/P4 cases with supervised mentoring and a set limit.
* Shadow senior support engineers on customer calls, case documentation, and initial troubleshooting sessions.

**2-Month Milestones (The "Connecting" Phase):**

* Gradually raise the number of cases and queues, and enable handling for high-priority cases.
* Independently perform routine troubleshooting activities and manage standard customer support cases.
* Prepare initial drafts of knowledge base articles for recently resolved common technical issues.

**3-Month Milestones (The "Contribution" Phase):**

* No capping on cases and queue dispatch.
* Become fully ramped on core troubleshooting tools and support ticket management processes.
* P1 ( Production down scenarios) enablement. Shadowing and assisting colleagues in their P1 cases.
* Successfully present a challenging case or a new troubleshooting methodology in the weekly support review meeting.

**4-6 Month Milestones (The "Performance" Phase):**

* Achieve or exceed support key performance indicators (KPIs), such as target case resolution time and customer satisfaction score (CSAT).
* Refine existing troubleshooting documentation and create Knowledge base articles.
* Participate independently in the 24x7 on-call rotation schedule, managing critical escalations with minimal supervision.
* Achieve internal SailPoint support certifications or relevant initial product badges.

**Education & Qualifications:**

**Must Haves:**

* 5+ years of professional software support experience, preferably in enterprise security software product companies.
* Proven track record of advanced, aggressive troubleshooting techniques and using various investigative resources.
* Experiance in SAP GRC
* Experience in Supporting Cloud-Based / microservice architecture-based products.
* REST API, Browser-based troubleshooting, OpenSearch/ Splunk, JSON awareness.
* Experience with Database Administration (Oracle, Sybase, MSSQL, DB2, MySQL).
* Strong familiarity operating across both Windows, Unix (Linux, Sun, HP, AIX) , Flatcar O.S and Dockerized container platforms.
* Experience writing or troubleshooting XML and JavaScript.
* Hands-on experience with J2EE / Java EE 5 Application Servers (such as Tomcat, JBoss, WebSphere, or WebLogic).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven empathy and interpersonal skills for handling stressful customer situations.

**Nice to Haves / Preferred:**

* Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, or equivalent experience.
* Some software development experience with an object-oriented language.
* Experience troubleshooting Java applications in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with Log4j or other logging system configurations.

**Browser compatibility testing experience**
.

* Version control systems experience (such as Subversion/SVN).
* Generating and reading HAR files.
* Knowledge of Java, Ant, XHTML, JSF, SPML/SOAP, and software build technologies.
* Familiarity with identity management provisioning systems (e.g., Sun, Oracle, IBM, Novell).
* Understanding of networking and application server clusters.

Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes. Identifies opportunities for service improvements, discuss with the customer and raise the request for change for assessment if appropriate Maintains the accuracy of service related standards, procedures and work instructions in a knowledge management system. Able to support the Service Owner when needed. Champions the use of ITIL Standards for IT Service Deliverables Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Request Fulfillment - Manages a service request through its life cycle with efficiency and professionalism using the required processes and tools to maintain customer satisfaction.
  
  
Service Asset and Configuration Management - Manages service assets and configuration items by maintaining accurate configuration records to support other service management processes with documented and verifiable information.
  
  
Service Catalog Management - Maintains a service catalog that contains all details of active and approved services in service operations using the required processes and tools to provide clear and relevant information to users.

title: Sr Engineer, Digital Workplace Engineering
description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**
Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.
  
  
Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
  
  
Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**
**Job Summary**
This role implements, manages and continuously improves Microsoft 365 technologies, Intune Suite, Purview, Copilot and integrations with adjacent technologies. The engineer seeks to automate or eliminate repeatable tasks and reduce administrative overhead for themselves and workplace operations, including configuration variations, performance issues on endpoint devices and security vulnerabilities. The engineer also collaborates with technology vendors, product managers, IT security and legal or compliance teams to ensure alignment with company policy and applicable legislation.
  
  
This role also builds automation and agentic AI–powered workflows—writing code and configuring AI agents—to reduce manual effort and scale the impact of the digital workplace team.
  
  
This is an individual-contributor role that executes within the engineering standards, architecture and AI governance guardrails established by Lead-level engineers. The Sr Digital Workplace Engineer focuses on hands-on implementation, testing and day-to-day operation of assigned systems, automation and AI agents.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Implement, monitor and operate digital workplace technologies (endpoint hardware, software, services and SaaS tools)
* Integrate digital workplace technologies with adjacent technologies (identity, security, vulnerability management, IT service and asset management, remote access, backup, directory services, etc.)
* Ensure stability and security of digital workplace technology through effective endpoint management and timely patching
* Support security operations processes by monitoring and reporting anomalies related to devices and identities
* Actively participate in resolving high-priority outages, troubleshooting efforts and capacity/availability planning sessions
* Work on various digital workplace technology projects
* Create, publish and communicate knowledgebase articles
* Assess criticality of services and applications and automate testing of those deemed critical before patching and upgrading
* Provide IT support for issues escalated from level 1 or level 2
* Participate in the major incident management process to investigate, diagnose and remediate digital workplace technology outages
* Write and maintain scripts, integrations and automation (PowerShell, Python, or similar) that reduce manual, repetitive work across digital workplace operations
* Build, test and operate agentic AI workflows using established templates, guardrails and platforms
* Document and share reusable automation and AI agent patterns through the team knowledge base to accelerate adoption across the organization

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years managing or supporting IT systems and platforms
* 3+ years of experience implementing digital employee experience (DEX), endpoint management, analytics and automation tools
* Experience with standard IT operations frameworks (e.g., ITIL)
* Experience with scripting tools and languages (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python)
* Experience with configuration management, identity and access management, active directory, desktop virtualization, collaboration platforms and other cloud-based services
* Experience implementing modern management of endpoint devices
* Experience with continuous engineering or other agile methods to keep pace with frequent changes and to reduce complexity
* Ability to write technical documentation
* Demonstrated proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (PowerShell, Python, or similar) with concrete examples of automation, integration or tooling delivered
* Working knowledge of agentic AI concepts (agents, tool/function calling, LLM integration) and experience configuring or extending agents on at least one low-code/no-code AI platform within existing organizational guardrails

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Natural excitement and ability to learn technologies and explain technical issues to a variety of audiences and levels
* Passionate about DEX, with an awareness of the latest digital trends
* Experience building a proof-of-concept AI agent or automation using a low-code AI agent platform
* Interest in or prior participation, as a contributor rather than a lead, in AI enablement initiatives, agentic AI pods, or similar cross-functional automation efforts

**Preferred Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft 365, Intune and related certifications

General Performance Criteria
  
  
As the
**Sr Digital Workplace Engineer**
, you will be required to fulfill your responsibilities while meeting the following general performance criteria for this position at this level:
  
  
**Expertise:**
You research, create proof of concepts, and introduce new methods
  
  
**Communication:**
You guide others through problem solving whether it is a technical issue, project impediment, or conflict
  
  
**Domain:**
You guide the delivery of your team to make a positive impact on other parts of the company based on detailed knowledge of the needs of those stakeholders and how those needs are supported by your team
  
  
**System:**
You own relevant segment of systems that are used regularly for the business to function and are well versed in the related KPIs
  
  
**Process:**
You question the status quo in a constructive manner to find areas for the team to improve
  
  
**Influence:**
You regularly make an impact to your entire team
  
  
To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of
**50 Mbps**
and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.

title: LMS (Learning Platform) Implementation/Administration Specialist
description:
**We're looking for a**
****LMS (Learning Platform) Implementation/Administration Specialist****
**This role is**
**Office Based, India**
**Certification Platform Specialist (LMS (Learning Solutions) Implementation/Administration Specialist | Hybrid | Hyderabad or Pune**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Certification Platforms Specialist owns the technology behind the Cornerstone Certification Program and is on the critical path for launching paid, proctored credentials in January 2027. You implement, integrate, and run the credentialing stack (Credly, the proctoring platform, the Cornerstone LMS, e-commerce, and Salesforce) so candidates can buy, take, pass, and renew credentials with minimal manual effort, and so credential data reaches partner and account records accurately. You also manage the vendors behind these platforms and turn program needs into clear functional requirements.
  
  
**In This Role You Will**
Implement and run proctoring on two Cornerstone LMS instances, working with the proctoring vendor’s implementation team to meet the January 2027 launch.
  
  
Configure e-commerce for paid exams on the internal certification portal, including pricing, checkout, and receipts.
  
  
Set up and manage voucher creation and redemption for partners in the Cornerstone partner program and its partner tiers.
  
  
Configure and maintain Training Models functionality in the LMS for certification paths, and own LMS maintenance for certification (configuration, testing, and release-driven updates) in partnership with LMS platform owners.
  
  
Administer Credly, including badge templates, issuance rules, expirations, and connections to program workflows.
  
  
Build and maintain integrations (APIs and webhooks) between Credly, the proctoring vendor, the LMS, and Salesforce so credential data reaches partner and account records, following the integration standards set by the Product Manager and Architect, Enablement Experiences.
  
  
Act as data steward for certification data: own data quality, definitions, and the data feed to the Strategy & Operations team.
  
  
Keep every exam and certification configuration compliant within 3 weeks of each major Cornerstone release, working with the Instructional Designer (Assessment Programs).
  
  
Manage relationships with Credly, the proctoring vendor, and other platform vendors, including service levels, escalations, renewals, and roadmap input, and translate program needs into functional requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Serve as the technical escalation point for certification issues raised through Cornerstone Community, the program mailbox, and ServiceNow, and document configurations, integrations, and runbooks.
  
  
Monitor proctoring for exam integrity, including AI identity verification results and signs of AI-enabled cheating, and escalate incidents to the Certification Team Lead.
  
  
Identify, test, and implement AI-enabled automation for routine operational work; measure impact and retire unnecessary manual processes.
  
  
Automate badge issuance, annual renewals, and reminder communications end to end, and review routine platform tasks each quarter to automate or retire them.
  
  
Build AI-assisted candidate support (such as a support assistant and suggested responses) to deflect routine technical tickets, with human oversight for complex cases.
  
  
Continuously maps the routine and repeatable tasks within this role, identifies automation opportunities using AI and workflow tools, proposes and implements solutions, and measures whether the automation delivers the expected time and quality improvement.
  
  
Perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Launch: Paid, proctored credentials live on both LMS instances by the January 2027 launch date.
  
  
Automation: Median time from passing result to badge issued under 48 hours, and 90% or more of renewals fully automated within 12 months of launch.
  
  
Release compliance: 100% of exams compliant within 3 weeks of each major Cornerstone release.
  
  
Support and AI transformation: First response to technical tickets within 1 business day and 85% resolved within 3 business days, with routine ticket volume down 30% through AI-assisted support.
  
  
Data quality: Accuracy of the credential data feed to the Strategy & Operations team and Salesforce: 100% of pass records result in a correctly issued badge and an accurate record in Salesforce within 48 hours of exam completion, with discrepancies flagged and resolved within 3 business days.
  
  
**You Have Got What It Takes If You Have**
5+ years administering and implementing learning or certification platforms (implementation, not only support).
  
  
Hands-on experience with digital badging (Credly or similar) and online proctoring platforms.
  
  
Experience building or maintaining integrations using REST APIs and webhooks, including Salesforce data.
  
  
LMS administration experience, including configuration and release testing.
  
  
**Experience Managing Vendors And Writing Functional Requirements.**
Strong data management skills with attention to accuracy.
  
  
Ability to evaluate AI outputs and apply sound judgment about when a human must decide.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Cornerstone LMS administration.
  
  
E-commerce or payment configuration for training or certification.
  
  
Experience with AI identity verification and remote proctoring security.
  
  
Scripting or workflow automation experience (such as Python or Power Automate).
  
  
Experience launching a new certification or credential program.
  
  
AI & Continuous Learning
  
  
Automates issuance, renewals, and reminders, builds AI-assisted candidate support that deflects routine tickets, and understands AI identity verification and AI-enabled cheating risks in proctoring.
  
  
Uses AI tools every day in their own work and can show an example where AI changed how the work is done, not just how fast.
  
  
Evaluates AI output critically for accuracy, bias, privacy and data handling, and knows when a human must decide.
  
  
Actively explores internal (Cornerstone AI) and external tools, brings recommendations to the team, and retires tools and processes that do not earn their place.
  
  
Keeps skills current through communities, certifications, hands-on experimentation and industry learning, and shares what they learn with the team.
  
  
How You Work
  
  
Customer obsessed: Start with the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
  
  
Innovate and transform: Challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that do not earn their place.
  
  
Proactive leadership: See problems and act before being asked.
  
  
Get it done: Ship, measure and iterate.
  
  
Forward looking: Plan for where technology and the business are going.
  
  
AI native: Use AI daily to rethink work, not just accelerate it.
  
  
Get uncomfortable to succeed: Take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.
  
  
**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. description:

This position provides opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders and support API modernization, cloud transformation and operational excellence initiatives.

* Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions on GCP, AWS, or Azure

**Additionally, Good To Have**

description:
**Job Description**
Job Title: Observability & Monitoring Lead
  
  
Location: Pune, India
  
  
Love making complex systems feel simple and reliable? We’re looking for an Observability & Monitoring Engineer who is equal parts builder and detective—someone who instruments services end-to-end, shines a light on blind spots, and turns noise into actionable signals. You’ll help us evolve a modern RunOps capability that improves reliability, reduces toil, and elevates the employee experience across Zendesk.
  
  
**About Zendesk**
At Zendesk, we believe outstanding customer and employee experiences start with great service and resilient platforms. We lead with empathy, innovate with purpose, and celebrate diversity and inclusion in everything we do. Join our global team and help us build an observability practice that others want to copy.
  
  
The Role: We are seeking a highly experienced Observability & Monitoring Lead with 6+ years of industry experience to spearhead our SRE and observability strategy. You will be responsible for maturing our monitoring ecosystem, driving operational excellence, and reducing system downtime through proactive detection and incident management. You will bridge the gap between engineering and operations, ensuring that observability data directly translates into improved reliability, SLA compliance, and reduced MTTR.You will design and operate the telemetry backbone for our internal platforms and business-critical applications. This role spans metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, RUM, and event correlation—instrumenting services, building dashboards, tuning alerts, and partnering with Incident/Problem/Change to drive measurable reliability outcomes.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

+ Design the observability stack: Define and implement standards for metrics, logs, traces, and profiling (e.g., OpenTelemetry collectors, exporters, and context propagation).
+ Instrument what matters: Establish golden signals, SLIs/SLOs, and health checks for priority services; automate baselining and anomaly detection.
+ Build actionable visibility: Create executive and on-call views (dashboards, service health, dependency maps) for Apps, Network, Collaboration tools, HRIS, and integrations.
+ Engineer signal > noise: Develop alerting policy as code; reduce false positives; implement suppression, deduplication, and auto-
+ Security & compliance: Ensure monitoring data is handled per policy; implement role-based access and guardrails for sensitive logs/metrics
+ Incident Reduction: Develop and execute strategies to systematically reduce the volume of high-priority incidents through trend analysis and proactive stability improvements.
+ Incident Automation: Lead the engineering of automated response workflows and self-healing capabilities to minimize manual intervention and accelerate resolution times.
+ Strategy & Architecture: Design and coordinate with engineering teams for comprehensive observability strategies, including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems.
+ Tooling Enhancements : End-to-end management of observability stacks (Data Dog) and its integration with ITSM tools (Ticketing Tools) and applications. Seek assistance from product and engineering team for any tool enhancement use cases to build a robust observability platform integrated with the ticketing tools.
+ Application Onboarding: Responsible and accountable for onboarding relevant observability and monitoring necessities for new applications which are onboarded and handed over to operations.
+ Incident & SLA Management: Oversee the operational lifecycle of monitoring tickets and Lead the monthly analysis and reporting of performance metrics (Eg - Mean time to detect, Mean time to restore,Mean time to Respond/Accept, First touch resolution) and ensure SLA compliance .
+ Continual Service Improvement: Liaise with technical and level 2 teams to improve and mature the current monitoring state of applications in scope.
+ Process Automation: Drive the automation of incident reporting, alert correlation rules, and "alert fatigue" reduction. Transform raw telemetry data into actionable executive insights.
+ SRE Leadership: Responsible for managing the L1 SRE Engineers who will be handling the automated monitoring incidents in day to day operations.
+ Governance & Leadership: Manage governance calls, lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reviews, and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB).
+ Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with domain team leads to define SLOs/SLIs, align on capacity planning, and ensure documentation (Runbooks/HLD/LLD) is maintained to "single point of failure" (SPOF) standards.

What You Bring
  
  

+ Experience: 6+ years in Observability/SRE/Platform/Monitoring roles supporting SaaS or enterprise applications.
+ Telemetry tools: Hands-on with monitoring and logging tools.
+ Tracing & metrics: Strong grasp of distributed tracing, RED/USE/golden signals, SLI/SLO/SLA, and error budgets.
+ Automation & code: Proficient in common languages such as Python.
+ Cloud & platforms: Experience with AWS
+ ITSM fluency: Comfortable operating within Incident/Problem/Change frameworks; adept at runbooks, RCAs, and post-incident reviews.
+ Data mindset: SQL or log query languages; can translate telemetry into insights and narratives.
+ Soft skills: Clear communicator, collaborative partner, bias to action, and calm during outages.

Nice to Have
  
  

+ Service maps/dependency modeling, synthetic/RUM design, APM transaction tuning, log schema governance.
+ Experience integrating observability with CMDB/service catalog and feature flag systems.
+ Certifications (e.g., AWS, Datadog).

Working Model
  
  

+ Hybrid role in India collaborating with global teams; core hours aligned to IST with occasional off-hours participation for major incidents or change windows.
+ Part of an on-call rotation with follow-the-sun support.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

The IT Ops DBA team provide Database Platform delivery and support for TU UK.
  
  
As part of the DBA Team, you will play a critical role in ensuring that systems are tuned and built to scale with proper controls in place to ensure high availability.
  
  
Working alongside and collaborating with Product Delivery and support teams on a daily basis, you will be focused on helping to deliver new and key capabilities into the business.
  
  
Your role will entail building and maintaining optimised and highly available database platforms, automating all manual steps to ensure that deployments are repeatable, reliable and rapid. The role will not just see you provide this as an initial service, but you will then provide the means to which the development function can self serve to perform these installations via performant automated pipelines.
  
  
Along the way, you will be required to proactively lead or assist Product Delivery teams to troubleshoot issues within the database environments, provide consultancy in the area of Route to Live pipelines and their ongoing maintenance, plus ensuring that teams understand the critical importance of oversight in how data is managed and secured.
  
  
As solutions develop you will assist development teams ensure the operability of those solutions often providing a bridge between development and operational teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

* Building and maintaining optimised and highly available database platforms.
* Building and continuously improving CI/CD Pipelines to ensure databases are deployed and configured using automation technologies.
* Establish consistent standards for providing highly available and fault tolerant systems.
* Identify and execute on opportunities to automate and streamline processes.
* Troubleshooting data issues, providing consultancy in the area of data growth and ongoing maintenance.
* Proof of Concept development to enhance and support the work of the UK IT Ops DBA team.
* Contribute to community best practices.
* Ensure that systems are secure and compliant (SOX, PCI etc.).
* Provide supervisory and technical leadership for other engineers in the team.
* Provide UK business hours support for TU UK database platforms.

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* At least five years experience working as a Senior SQL Server DBA, with MS SQL Server (2014-current)
* Experience of supporting PostGreSQL in an enterprise environment
* Experience with planning and delivering on database migrations and upgrades.
* Advanced use of T-SQL (stored procedures, SQL Agent Jobs, Deployment automation)
* Experience of configuring and supporting High Availability / Disaster Recovery technologies (Mirroring, Always On Availability Groups)
* Experience of configuring and supporting Replication (especially transactional with centralised distribution)
* Proven experience of working with sensitive data in a secure manner.

* Familiarity with use of source control, especially around database projects (including branching, workflow, peer reviews etc.)
* Good technical understanding of TFS/Azure DevOps Server and Octopus Deploy.
* Good level of experience of PowerShell scripting and automation.

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. **This opportunity**
will allow you to model leadership principles,
**provide coaching and training to technicians**
, and accelerate your career growth in the process.
  
  
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

**Responsibilities**
