title: Senior Integration Health Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Integration Health Engineer to ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of our system integrations. This role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing integrations between various applications, platforms, and third-party services. The ideal candidate will proactively identify potential issues, resolve system errors, and work closely with development and operations teams to maintain seamless data flow and system connectivity. They will build and maintain secure Claude Code and Glean tooling that improves integration triage, troubleshooting, documentation, and QA while applying evidence-based verification, human review, and measurable quality controls. In addition to technical responsibilities, this role also includes leadership in process improvement, training, and communication across teams and stakeholders.
  
  
A Day in Your Life
  
  

* Monitor Integration Performance – Continuously oversee system integrations to detect anomalies, latency, or failures.
* Develop AI-Assisted Tooling – Build, maintain, and continuously improve secure internal tooling and AI-assisted workflows using approved tools such as Claude Code and Glean.
* Troubleshoot & Resolve Issues – Diagnose and resolve integration errors, API failures, and data flow disruptions in real-time.
* Maintain System Health – Ensure integrations remain functional, efficient, and up to date with minimal downtime.
* Log Analysis & Reporting – Review logs and alerts to identify root causes of failures and document resolutions.
* Optimize Existing Integrations – Identify inefficiencies in data processing and recommend improvements to enhance performance.
* Coordinate with Engineering Teams – Work closely with developers, DevOps, and IT teams to implement fixes and improvements.
* Ensure Compliance & Security – Adhere to industry standards and best practices, including data protection policies and system security.
* Document Processes & Solutions – Maintain thorough documentation of troubleshooting procedures, integration updates, and system workflows.
* Team Leadership & Communication:

+ Owns Training Initiatives – Develops and leads training sessions to elevate team knowledge and performance.
+ Acts as a Point of Escalation – Handles complex technical issues, providing expert guidance and resolution support.
+ Performs QA Activities – Reviews ticket management, client and cross-department interactions, and technical troubleshooting, providing both real-time and written feedback.
+ Leads Daily Standups – Facilitates team check-ins to align on progress, blockers, and priorities.
+ Contributes to Weekly Project Planning – Participates in roadmap discussions, ensuring integration priorities are accounted for.
+ Drives Cross-Team Communication – Ensures effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, and proactively “closes the loop” on outstanding issues or updates.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4-7 years of experience with API monitoring, system health checks, integration, and network troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, PowerShell, or Bash for log analysis and automation.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Datadog, or Prometheus.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to issue resolution.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with developers and stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize issues effectively.
* Ability to combine technical depth with judgment, confidence, and EQ.
* Strategic thinking, understanding priorities and dependencies, ability to contribute to broader team planning.
* Experience working in integration support or system operations. (Preferred)
* Experience with QA and mentorship. (Preferred)
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) (Preferred)
* Knowledge of incident management best practices. (Preferred)

**Benefits**
An incredible team of smart and supportive people
  
  
A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
  
  
Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.

The Microsoft Purview SME will be responsible for the implementation, administration, monitoring, and operational management of Microsoft Purview solutions. * Deploy, configure, and administer Microsoft Purview solutions in accordance with organizational security, compliance, and data governance requirements.
* Design, configure, and maintain sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption settings, and protection controls across Microsoft 365 services.
* Implement and manage manual, recommended, and automatic data classification and labeling capabilities.

* Monitor and investigate DLP alerts, policy matches, data leakage incidents, and user-reported data protection concerns.
* Analyze false-positive and false-negative DLP detections and perform policy optimization and tuning.

* Support Records Management requirements, including regulatory records, event-based retention, disposition reviews, and proof of disposition.

* Support Communication Compliance policies and investigations in coordination with authorized business stakeholders.
* Manage Microsoft Purview Audit capabilities and assist with audit log searches, compliance investigations, and evidence collection.
* Develop and maintain data classification schemas, sensitive information types, trainable classifiers, exact data match configurations, and keyword dictionaries.

* Troubleshoot Microsoft Purview policy behavior, configuration issues, service limitations, and integration-related problems.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Security, or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of experience in Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Compliance, Information Protection, Data Governance, or related technologies.
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience implementing or administering Microsoft Purview solutions.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Purview Information Protection, including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto-labeling, and data classification.
* Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and tuning Data Loss Prevention policies across Microsoft 365 workloads and managed endpoints.

* Experience integrating Microsoft Purview capabilities with Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM, or security monitoring platforms.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, KQL, and Microsoft 365 administrative tools.
* Experience in incident management, change management, service request fulfilment, root-cause analysis, and technical problem resolution.
* Experience working with Legal, Compliance, Risk, HR, Security Operations, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to translate compliance and business requirements into scalable technical controls.
* Experience producing technical designs, governance standards, operational reports, SOPs, runbooks, and audit evidence.

description:

**So, what's the role all about?**
As a Specialist Advanced Engineering Technical Support Engineer, you will provide senior-level L2/L3 engineering support for AI-powered solutions in production environments. This role combines deep troubleshooting expertise with software engineering capabilities, supporting agentic AI applications, cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, and automation frameworks.
  
  
You will be responsible for diagnosing complex incidents, performing root-cause analysis, implementing code-level fixes, improving platform reliability, and partnering with architects, developers, and business stakeholders to ensure high availability and performance of critical AI solutions.
  
  
**How will you make an impact?**

* Monitor system health using observability and LLMOps tools, proactively identifying reliability risks.
* Support automation frameworks, event-driven workflows, and data pipelines to ensure consistent operations.
* Improve operational maturity through runbooks, alerts, knowledge articles, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, product, and business teams to drive successful AI solution adoption.
* Ensure governance, security, auditability, and safe execution of autonomous AI workflows.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 8-12 years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps, Data Engineering, or Advanced Technical Support.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python development, SQL, REST APIs, and distributed systems.
* Experience supporting production applications in cloud environments, preferably AWS.
* Strong understanding of Snowflake data platform, query optimization, security controls, and data operations.
* Experience troubleshooting APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and workflow orchestration platforms.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, testing frameworks, and automation practices.
* Knowledge of observability tools, logging, monitoring, tracing, and incident management.
* Experience with IAM, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, secrets management, and enterprise security practices.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI, AutoGen, CrewAI, or Semantic Kernel.
* Hands-on experience with LLM platforms including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock, Snowflake Cortex, or Google Gemini.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) implementations and AI tool integrations.
* Knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex Agents, Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, and Snowpark.
* Experience supporting AWS services such as Lambda, ECS/Fargate, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.
* Familiarity with Airflow, Temporal, dbt, or other enterprise orchestration platforms.
* Experience with ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.
* Exposure to AI guardrails, governance frameworks, and secure autonomous workflows.

**What's in it for you?**
Join an innovative, fast-growing team building next-generation AI-powered solutions that directly impact business operations. You will work alongside AI architects, engineers, and business leaders on cutting-edge Agentic AI initiatives while gaining exposure to modern cloud technologies, GenAI platforms, and enterprise-scale data systems.
  
  
At NiCE, every day presents opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. You'll have access to challenging projects, career advancement opportunities, and a collaborative environment that encourages continuous improvement and technical excellence.

title: Copilot Agents -M365 Power platform
description:
Join us as a “Copilot Agents -M365 Power platform" at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with, skills to meet business requirement as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
To be successful as a “Copilot Agents -M365 Power platform", you should have experience with:
  
  
**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, with a working understanding of tenant architecture, service interdependencies, licensing and admin controls, and practical knowledge of how Microsoft 365 Copilot grounds on tenant data through Microsoft Graph and the semantic index.
* Building and deploying Copilot agents — declarative agents covering the manifest and agent definition, instructions, knowledge sources, API plugin actions with OpenAPI specifications, packaging and the M365 admin approval process — together with an informed view of when a custom engine agent is the right choice.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID: users, groups and licensing, app registrations, enterprise applications and service principals, delegated versus application permissions and admin consent, and conditional access concepts.
* A sound practical grasp of authentication and token exchange — OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect flows, access, refresh and ID tokens, scopes and claims, token lifetime and validation, the on-behalf-of flow, and single sign-on within Teams and Copilot agent scenarios.
* Practical experience with the Microsoft Graph API, including the permissions model, authenticating in code, pagination, throttling and error handling.
* Strong competence in at least one development language such as C#, Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, with REST and JSON fluency, PowerShell for administration, and sound engineering discipline across source control, code review, testing and secure coding.
* Proven delivery within an Agile team — backlog refinement, estimation, sprint commitment, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives, using Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to contribute to design and architecture: producing and reviewing high- and low-level designs and authentication and integration flow diagrams, and assessing non-functional requirements such as availability, resilience and security.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to engage stakeholders outside the immediate team and explain technical detail to a non-technical audience.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Building and publishing agents in Copilot Studio — topics, generative orchestration, knowledge sources, actions, channel publishing and solution management.
* Exposure to Copilot Cowork or other agentic, task-based working patterns, including the governance and data-handling considerations around them.
* Building Microsoft Graph connectors to bring external content into the Copilot grounding surface, and working with change notifications and webhooks.
* Teams app development using the Teams Toolkit, Adaptive Cards or the Bot Framework.
* Azure fundamentals and hosting experience — App Service, Functions, API Management and Key Vault — along with Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry exposure.
* Retrieval-augmented generation concepts, prompt engineering, evaluation and responsible AI practice.
* Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Power Platform capability across Power Apps, Power Automate, custom connectors and Dataverse.
* Familiarity with M365 guardrails and compliance controls, including data loss prevention, retention and sensitivity labelling, external and guest access, and app consent policy.
* Microsoft certifications such as SC-300, MS-700, AI-102, PL-200, PL-400, AZ-104 or AZ-204.
* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.

This role will be based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

The role involves conducting quality audits, identifying process improvement opportunities, analyzing quality trends, driving corrective actions, and supporting governance activities to ensure delivery of high-quality services in accordance with client and organizational requirements.

Quality Assurance & Governance Execute quality frameworks, audit plans, and quality control mechanisms across RTR and Royalty processes.
  
  
Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), accounting standards, client requirements, and internal controls.
  
  
Monitor quality performance and identify areas for improvement.
  
  
Conduct calibration sessions to ensure consistency in quality evaluations.

Review journal entries, reconciliations, month-end close activities, financial reporting outputs, and royalty transactions for accuracy and compliance.
  
  
Identify control gaps, process risks, and quality issues.
  
  
Ensure effective implementation and closure of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  
  
Reporting & Analytics Analyze audit findings, quality scores, defect trends, and process performance metrics.
  
  
Prepare dashboards, scorecards, and periodic quality reports for management review.
  
  
Provide actionable insights to improve accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.
  
  
Track and report quality KPIs and improvement initiatives.

Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or Related Field.
  
  
M.Com, MBA (Finance), CA Inter, CMA Inter, or equivalent qualification, Preferred Work Experience in Finance & Accounting, Shared Services, BPO, or BPM environments.

description:
**Role: L2 Security Specialist**

**Location:**
Pune / Hyderabad

3 to 5 years

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an analytical and vigilant
**L2 Security Specialist**
to join the cybersecurity operations team supporting the
**Project**
. The infrastructure is a complex hybrid environment spanning native
**Microsoft Azure**
,
**Azure VMware Solution (AVS)**
, and
**on-premises data centers**
.

In this role, you will be the core technical guardian of the project’s security boundaries. You will secure workloads across public cloud, virtualized VMware software-defined data centers (SDDCs), and legacy physical hardware. Your mission is to implement zero-trust network configurations, manage hybrid identities, ensure strict vulnerability governance, and lead the technical response to security events across all environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Hybrid Network Security & Micro-segmentation**

* **NSX-T & Cloud Firewalls:**
  Manage and audit distributed firewall rules within
  **VMware NSX-T**
  for the Azure VMware Solution (AVS) cluster, as well as native Azure Network Security Groups (NSGs) and Application Security Groups (ASGs).
* **Micro-segmentation Strategy:**
  Define and implement granular micro-segmentation policies to isolate application workloads across native Azure, AVS guest environments, and on-premises physical servers.
* **Cross-Boundary Encryption:**
  Ensure all transit data moving over VPNs, ExpressRoute, and Azure Global Reach is securely encrypted using IPsec or TLS protocols.

**2. Identity & Access Governance**

* **Hybrid Identity:**
  Administer and monitor identity syncs and federations between Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS).
* **Access Control (RBAC):**
  Enforce the principle of least privilege by configuring and maintaining Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across Azure subscriptions, AVS vCenter instances, and on-premises virtualization hosts.
* **MFA & Conditional Access:**
  Implement and audit Conditional Access Policies, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) for project personnel.

**3. Vulnerability & Threat Management**

* **Vulnerability Scanning:**
  Schedule and evaluate regular vulnerability scans across hybrid VM operating systems, containerized workloads, and hypervisor management interfaces using tools like Microsoft Defender for Cloud or Qualys.
* **Patch Compliance Governance:**
  Work closely with the DevOps and Infrastructure teams to track patch compliance and prioritize remediations for CVEs affecting virtual machines in Azure and AVS.
* **Secrets Management:**
  Securely manage certificates, connection strings, API keys, and cryptographic keys using
  **Azure Key Vault**
  and on-premises hardware security modules (HSMs).

**4. Security Monitoring & Incident Response**

* **SIEM Management:**
  Collect, analyze, and query security logs (using KQL) inside
  **Azure Sentinel**
  (SIEM/SOAR) and on-premises syslog servers to detect lateral movements or anomalies.
* **Incident Containment:**
  Act as the Tier-2 incident responder for security alerts, following playbook actions to isolate compromised virtual machines (e.g., placing VMs in isolated NSX-T segments).
* **Compliance Auditing:**
  Perform regular compliance audits against frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, NIST, or ISO 27001 to ensure the hybrid infrastructure meets organizational policies.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required:**

* **Experience:**
  3+ years of experience in Cyber Security, Security Operations (SecOps), or Cloud Security.
* **Cloud Security Knowledge:**
  Hands-on experience securing workloads in
  **Microsoft Azure**
  (utilizing Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Network Security Groups, and IAM).
* **Virtualization Security:**
  Solid understanding of VMware security concepts (vSphere hardening, vCenter access controls) and
  **VMware NSX-T**
  firewall configurations (essential for securing
  **AVS**
  workloads).
* **Identity Management:**
  Experience managing hybrid authentication models (Azure AD / Active Directory).
* **Log Analysis:**
  Proficiency in querying log data (such as using Kusto Query Language -
  **KQL**
  in Log Analytics or Azure Sentinel).

**Preferred:**

* **Certifications:**
  **Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)**
  ,
  **CompTIA Security+**
  , or
  **VMware Certified Professional - Security (VCP-SEC)**
  .
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Security:**
  Familiarity with static code analysis tools (such as Checkov or tfsec) to scan Terraform templates for security flaws.

description:

Pune, on-site

Full-time

**About the role**

We're hiring a SOC Analyst to join our Security Operations Center. You'll monitor, investigate and respond to security events across client environments, using enterprise tools and cloud platforms.

This role needs technical depth and clear communication in equal measure. During an incident, you're the person clients and internal teams hear from, and your written reports need to be as sharp as your investigations.

**What you'll do**

• Monitor alerts across SIEM, EDR, email security and DNS filtering platforms

• Triage and investigate events, separating true and false positives with documented reasoning

• Contain incidents using defined runbooks, and escalate Sev 1 and Sev 2 events to senior analysts and the CISO

• Write clear incident reports for both technical teams and executives with no security background

• Keep clients updated during active incidents: status, containment actions, next steps and timelines

• Analyse phishing emails and report findings through defined channels

• Analyse logs across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, AWS CloudTrail and endpoint management platforms

• Keep ticket documentation accurate and current throughout every investigation

• Take part in post-incident reviews and help improve runbooks

• Track vulnerabilities and coordinate patch updates with system owners

**What we're looking for**

Experience

• Level 1: 1 to 3 years in a SOC, security helpdesk or IT security role

• Level 2: 3 to 5 years

**Technical skills**

• Hands-on experience with a SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk or similar)

• Microsoft 365 security tools: Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Purview Audit, Entra ID sign-in logs

• MITRE ATT&CK and kill chain methodology

• Networking fundamentals: DNS, HTTP/S, TCP/IP, firewall logs

• Reading Windows Event Logs, Azure/Entra sign-in logs and email headers

• AWS or Azure experience is a plus

**Communication (non-negotiable)**

• Clear, professional written English, without jargon when the audience doesn't need it

• Can write an incident summary a CEO can act on, and a technical timeline an engineer can follow

• Comfortable giving live updates to clients during incidents, including delivering bad news calmly

• Responds promptly and transparently, so stakeholders always know what's happening

• Understands that communication during an incident is itself a security control

**Mindset**

• Calm under pressure. No going quiet, no public speculation.

• Curious and methodical. Follows evidence, not assumptions.

• Owns tickets end to end and never hands off without context

• Asks questions when scope is unclear instead of guessing

• Works well across time zones with US and India teams

title: Senior TAC Engineer – Core Networking, Application Load Balancing & DDoS
description:
Company Description

Incedo Inc. is a global AI and data transformation company that helps organizations drive sustainable business impact and measurable ROI from AI at scale. As a long-term partner from strategy through execution, Incedo combines AI & Data, digital engineering, and operations transformation with deep domain expertise. With over 4,000 professionals across the US, Canada, Latin America, and India, Incedo serves Fortune 500 enterprises and fast-growing clients across banking and payments, wealth management, telecom, hi-tech, and life sciences.

Role Description

We are looking for a Senior TAC Engineer with a strong
**core networking background**
and hands-on expertise in
**application load balancing, DDoS protection, and Wireshark packet analysis**
.

Based in Pune, this role provides advanced technical support for complex customer environments. The ideal candidate understands end-to-end application client–server workflows and can correlate packet captures, logs, and configurations to isolate issues across the network, load balancer, security infrastructure, and backend servers.

You will own customer incidents through resolution, collaborate with product and engineering teams, and contribute to technical knowledge and team development.

Key Responsibilities

* Own complex technical support cases and escalations from initial investigation through resolution, maintaining clear and timely customer communication.
* Troubleshoot core networking issues involving routing, switching, TCP/IP, VLANs, NAT/SNAT, DNS, and asymmetric traffic paths.
* Diagnose Layer 4–7 load balancing issues involving virtual servers, backend server pools, health monitors, persistence, SSL/TLS offloading, and high availability.
* Investigate DDoS incidents, analyze traffic patterns, and troubleshoot detection, mitigation policies, and false positives.
* Analyze application client–server workflows, including DNS resolution, TCP connection establishment, TLS negotiation, HTTP/HTTPS requests, and server responses.
* Use Wireshark and tcpdump to identify packet loss, retransmissions, resets, timeouts, latency, and protocol-related failures.
* Reproduce customer issues in lab environments and work with engineering teams on suspected defects, providing diagnostic evidence and clear reproduction steps.
* Recommend configuration changes and work with customers to validate fixes through established change management processes.
* Create troubleshooting guides and knowledge articles, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to incident reviews and service improvements.

Required Qualifications

* Strong experience in core networking and customer-facing technical support, with demonstrated ownership of complex incidents.
* Hands-on expertise in configuring and troubleshooting
  **load balancers or Application Delivery Controllers (ADCs)**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **DDoS protection and mitigation**
  , including volumetric, protocol, and application-layer attacks.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing and switching, subnetting, VLANs, ARP, NAT/SNAT, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and SSL/TLS.
* Thorough understanding of
  **application client–server communication**
  , with the ability to distinguish network, load balancer, security, and backend application issues.
* Proficiency in
  **Wireshark packet analysis**
  , including display filters, TCP stream analysis, and comparison of packet captures across different points in the traffic path.
* Familiarity with Linux, system logs, and troubleshooting tools such as tcpdump, curl, dig, traceroute, and OpenSSL.
* Experience supporting enterprise or service provider networks in TAC, escalation support, or similar technical roles.
* Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics/Telecommunications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

description:
Title - Mechanical Design Engineer

Exp - 3-15 yrs

Location- Pune

Work mode - WFO 5 days

Our Client is looking for a mechanically strong engineer who can take ownership of assigned machine modules and progressively own complete mechanical subsystems—from understanding the requirement and developing concepts through detailed design, fabrication, assembly, testing and design release. The person should be more than a CAD operator: he/she should

understand why a design works, how it will be manufactured, and how to troubleshoot it when the machine does not perform as expected.

2. Ideal technical profile

• 3–5 years of hands-on experience in machine design, special-purpose machinery, industrial automation, equipment development or a closely related field.

• Experience personally designing mechanical assemblies or machine modules from concept through working prototype; exposure to production release is strongly preferred.

• Strong fundamentals in machine design, mechanics, engineering calculations, component sizing, materials, fits, tolerances and practical GD&T.

• Strong 3D CAD capability (SolidWorks preferred), including part modelling, assemblies, engineering drawings, BOMs and design revisions.

• Practical understanding of mechanisms, linear motion, bearings, shafts, couplings, actuators, pneumatics, machining, fabrication, assembly and manufacturability.

• Ability to investigate failures systematically, identify root causes and implement practical design improvements rather than simply making CAD changes.

• Experience with pumps, valves, metering, fluid handling or dispensing mechanisms is particularly valuable.

Academic profile

• BE/B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering required; preference for reputable institutions with strong mechanical engineering departments, including IITs, NITs, IIITDMs, established government and other respected engineering colleges.

• ME/M.Tech. in Machine Design, Mechanical Design, Mechanical Engineering or closely related specialisation is highly preferred, but not compulsory.

Key responsibilities

• Design mechanical parts, assemblies and machine modules based on application and system requirements.

• Develop concepts, mechanisms, layouts and detailed designs; perform basic engineering calculations and component selection.

• Prepare accurate 3D models, manufacturing drawings, BOMs and design documentation.

• Work with production, procurement, vendors and senior engineers to ensure designs are manufacturable, practical and cost-effective.

• Take increasing ownership of complete modules/subsystems and eventually complete machines as capability develops.

• Work closely with the Mechanical Engineering Lead, CTO and automation/electrical/software teams.

What success looks like

• Assigned designs are delivered on time with accurate drawings, BOMs and documentation.

• Designs work reliably in prototype and production environments with low rework.

• The engineer understands the physical machine—not just the CAD model—and actively participates in fabrication, assembly and testing.

• Problems are approached through engineering analysis and structured troubleshooting rather than trial-and-error redesign.

• The engineer progressively takes ownership of larger and more complex machine modules.

• Within a few years, the person is capable of independently driving substantial mechanical development work.

title: PlantPAx Ignition Engineer
description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We’re one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**PlantPAx Ignition Engineer**
to design, program, test, and support industrial control systems in regulated environments. This role requires strong hands-on expertise with Rockwell Automation platforms, Ignition SCADA, and networked control systems, with a working understanding of biopharmaceutical, GMP, and building management systems.
  
  
**You will:**

* Independently program and configure Allen-Bradley CompactLogix and ControlLogix PLCs, including related I/O systems
* Develop, configure, and maintain Rockwell PlantPAx 4.x and 5.x control modules and equipment modules
* Independently program Ignition 8.x, including:

+ Alarming
+ Reporting
+ Historian modules

* Design, develop, and test Ignition Perspective HMI graphics
* Develop and execute test forms, including FAT/SAT and commissioning documentation
* Integrate vendor-provided equipment and devices using:

+ Ethernet/IP
+ BACnet IP
+ Modbus TCP/IP

* Support and apply control system network topology best practices
* Interface with process, facilities, and validation teams to support compliant system delivery
* Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

**You have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of hands-on industrial automation or controls engineering experience
* Strong understanding of biopharmaceutical manufacturing and GMP processes
* Experience working independently in automation system design and implementation
* Familiarity with regulated environments and documentation-driven projects
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills
* A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

**You may have:**

* Emerson DeltaV
* OSIsoft / AVEVA PI Historian
* SQL (queries, data extraction, reporting support)
* Node-RED for integration or data workflows

title: Senior Specialist, Customer Experience Design
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. **Title And Summary**
Senior Specialist, Customer Experience Design
  
  
Our Purpose
  
  
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Title and Summary
  
  
Senior Specialist, Product Experience Design
  
  
**Overview**
We are looking for an experienced User Experience/Interaction Designer passionate about the possibilities of data and data-driven experience design with good knowledge and experience of User Interface Design to join our rapidly growing, highly-innovative data and services Product Development team at our development center in Pune.
  
  
The design function works as part of wider cross-functional teams that form organically around data product ideas – collectively contributing to the rapid iteration of Prototypes and MVPs (Minimal Viable Product), mainly in the B2B and B2B2C arenas. Each design iteration is exposed to end-users at each cycle of our rapid design-test-redesign process, to ensure optimum user traction. Prototype and MVP outputs include dashboards; widgets; chatbots; web applications; mobile applications; VUI voice interfaces; digital assistants; etc. – all in service of solving complex business challenges and with an ever increasing emphasis on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).
  
  
Role
  
  

* Design of Proof-of-Concepts and Minimum Viable Data Products (MVPs) using human-centric design principles and rapid prototyping (Lean UX and Design Thinking)
* Participate in "Design Thinking" workshops – collaborating cross-functionally with industry verticals, regional leads and end-users to ensure optimal digital data products
* Explore the “art-of-the-possible” in the era of Big Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) – whilst always maintaining regulatory compliance
* Leverage existing – and contribute net new – design patterns to Mastercard’s design pattern library
* Help define the next generation of data and data-driven products – and through doing so, help shape the future of Mastercard and its growth
* Creation of a cohesive and compelling visual language across diverse form factors: web, mobile and internet of things
* Work on future state conceptual designs, driving experimentation that improves the quality of product design overall.
* Work closely with key partners from brand & marketing, alongside the broader user experience team to drive delightful and highly usable transactional experiences leveraging the broader visual language for MasterCard.
* Work closely with our technology team to define implementation standard for our products leveraging modern presentation layer practices such as adaptive/responsive web and current and forward thinking technologies.
* Ensure that designs deliver an appropriate balance of optimizing business objectives & user engagement, in close partnership with product managers.
* Liaise with regional and country teams to ensure that designs are reflective of the diversity of needs for a global user base
* Drive VXD design across a broader ecosystem, where experiences will require tailoring to meet the needs of both MasterCard customers and end consumers
* Help define the next generation of data and data-driven products and their visualization – and through doing so, help shape the future of Mastercard and its growth

**All About You**
Required Experience / Knowledge / Skills (Core)
  
  
**Interaction Design**

* Experience developing User Archetypes and Personas and user journeys to inform product design decisions
* Experience in rapid prototyping (Lean UX and Design Thinking)
* Experience in articulating elegant and engaging experiences using sketches, storyboards, information architecture blueprints and prototypes
* Experience in the implementation of creative, useable and compelling visual mockups and prototypes.
* Experience working with complex information architectures
* Experience of design-experiences across multiple media
* Experience using prototyping/wireframing tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe Experience Design, Adobe Illustrator etc.
* An understanding of complex information architectures for digital applications

**Visual Design**
Additional Experience / Knowledge / Skills
  
  

* Experience in articulating elegant and engaging visual experiences using sketches, storyboards, and within prototypes
* Highly proficient in the creation of useable, compelling and elegant visual mockups and prototypes.
* Experience of visual design across multiple media and form factors: web; mobile; Internet-of-Things (IOT)
* Extensive and demonstrable experience using leading VXD software packages such as Adobe Creative Cloud / Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator etc.) / Experience Design, Serif DrawPlus, Corel DRAW Graphics Suite / PaintShopPro, Art Rage, Xara or equivalent
* An understanding of complex information architectures for visual representation
* Any experience in motion graphic design is a strong plus
* Any experience in 3D modeling also a strong plus

**Research**

* Experience consuming UX research
* Experience in leading “Design Thinking” workshops with customers to identify requirements and ideate on potential product solutions.
* Ability to identify best-in-class user experience through competitor analysis
* Experience of iterative “design-test-re-design” methodology to collect real user feedback to incorporate back into the design

Candidate
  
  

* Prior experience working in a world-beating UX team
* Experience working/multi-tasking in an extremely fast-paced startup-like environment
* Experience in client-facing engagements, preferably in leading them
* Empathetic champion of the user – passionate about the detail of great usability, interaction design and aesthetics to give the best possible UX
* Passionate about the possibility of data driven experiences – so-called “emergent ontologies” (patterns in the data) driving UX and UI. Passionate about the potential for data, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning ML)
* Defensible point-of-view on and Adaptive v Responsive v Liquid/Fluid UI
* Defensible point-of-view on gamification
* Interest in VUIs (Voice Interfaces)
* Demonstrable knowledge of UX and Interaction Design heuristics and best practices: e.g. Lean UX; Mobile First etc.
* Demonstrable knowledge of ergonomic and usability best practices
* Bachelors or Masters Degree in Design for Interactive Media, or equivalent experience
* World-beating portfolio covering multiple form-factors: desktop; tablet; mobile; wearable; other
* Demonstrable commitment to learning: insatiable to discover and evaluate new concepts and technologies to maximize design possibility.

Corporate Security Responsibility
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Google Ads & Paid Media Specialist
description:
Company Description

Outreach Digital Marketing is a full-service, end-to-end marketing agency based in Pune, India, serving clients across the USA, UK, and India. The agency specializes in digital marketing services including SEO, social media marketing, PPC, content creation, and video ads. Outreach Digital Marketing focuses on building comprehensive digital strategies that help businesses grow and strengthen their online presence. Team members collaborate with diverse clients and industries, contributing to impactful campaigns and measurable results.

Role Description

The Google Ads & Paid Media Specialist is a remote, full-time role — day-to-day campaign operations are managed remotely, with in-person strategy sessions roughly once a month (or as scheduled). This is a full-time commitment, not a freelance arrangement: candidates who intend to take this on as a side project, or alongside other full-time work or clients, are asked not to apply. Only immediate joiners will be considered. We're looking for honest, dedicated execution — not a trial run. The specialist will take proactive, end-to-end ownership of the paid media campaign lifecycle: from strategy and multi-platform execution (Google Search, Performance Max, and paid social) through to the technical setup of conversion tracking — and, most importantly, following through and delivering on that plan. Success in this role means translating campaign data into measurable business outcomes — qualified leads and ROI — rather than reporting on surface-level metrics like clicks. A strong track record with US healthcare market clients is a priority, as is the ability to act as an analytical communicator who bridges technical performance marketing with clear, client-facing growth objectives. Simply put: we're hiring for execution, not just strategy — someone with the hunger to actually get campaigns built, running, and optimized. Compensation: CTC 4.8 LPA – 6 LPA.

Qualifications

- Candidates should possess strong hands-on experience managing Google Search and Performance Max campaigns, including bid strategy (manual and automated, e.g. tCPA/tROAS) and campaign structure.

- Candidates should possess experience running and optimizing paid social campaigns (Meta/LinkedIn), building full-funnel, not just top-of-funnel, structures.

- Candidates should possess proficiency with GA4 conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, and ideally server-side tracking (CAPI) — able to connect platform data to real business outcomes like leads and ROI, not just clicks.

- Candidates should possess experience managing campaigns for the US market, including comfort coordinating across US time zones.

- Candidates should possess strong ownership instincts — managing the full campaign lifecycle proactively, from strategy through execution to optimization, without needing to be chased.

- Candidates should possess awareness of healthcare-industry advertising compliance (e.g. HIPAA-adjacent considerations) given the agency's US healthcare client base.

- Proficiency in English communication is a must, with the ability to translate technical performance-marketing detail into clear, outcome-focused updates for clients, and to work collaboratively in a remote team environment.

- Should be passionate, responsible, proactive, and take ownership — this is a full-time, dedicated role, not a freelance or side engagement.

Requirements added by the job poster

- 3+ years of work experience with Google Ads

- 2+ years of US Healthcare Marketing experience

- Immediate joiners only

- CTC: 4.8 LPA – 6 LPA

title: Product Associate
description:
**Job Role - Product Associate**
**Location - Pune**
**What The Work Is Like**
Nobody will hand you a finished spec. You'll get a customer with a problem, a rough idea of what good looks like, and
  
  
people who will help if you ask. You talk to the customer, work out what is actually wrong, decide what to build, get it
  
  
built (with engineers, or with AI tools yourself), and check that it worked. Then you do the next one.
  
  
You'll own one area of the product and the customers who use it. We decide which area together, once you've joined,
  
  
based on what you're good at.
  
  
**You'll do well here if**

* You've started something nobody asked you to: a project, a small business, an event, a fix at work, an app
* When instructions are unclear, you make a sensible assumption, say it out loud, and get moving
* You'd rather ship something that works on Friday than something perfect next month
* You go and ask the person with the problem instead of guessing
* You pick up new things quickly, whether that's a new industry, a codebase or a customer's business

**You probably won't enjoy it if**

* You do your best work when the task is fully defined before you start
* You want a large team and a fixed process around you

**What We Don't Require**
A particular degree or college, a product title, or years of experience. Some of our best people came from customer
  
  
support, operations or a family business.
  
  
**How To Apply**
We don't start with your CV. The application form asks for:
  
  

* A link to something you built, ran or fixed that nobody asked you to. Any form counts: an app, a spreadsheet,

an event, a process, a video.
  
  

* What was broken, what you did, and what happened. At most 100 words, with at least one real name, number

or date.
  
  

* One time nobody told you what to do. What did you do in the first hour? At most 100 words.
* When you can start, and a link to your CV or LinkedIn.

Applications without a link, or with answers over 100 words, are not read. The limits are part of the test.
  
  
Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfKHxjoKx3sOvBijnnloJQqE3ywMJpyP9T0GoR7\_kB\_5FKQfQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=104777260577875084657
  
  
What happens next: a 30-minute written exercise, a 20-minute call, a take-home (AI tools allowed) and a conversation about
  
  
it, then a final conversation with our CEO.
  
  
**About CrelioHealth**
CrelioHealth is a fast-growing health-tech product company delivering cloud-based LIMS, RIS, CRM, and Inventory solutions to diagnostics labs and hospitals globally. We are building scalable systems that power modern healthcare operations.
  
  
**Website**
: www.creliohealth.com

description:

This role combines deep technical expertise with strong customer engagement skills and is responsible for driving customers from technical discovery through successful production deployment.
  
  
As a Lead Implementation Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical owner during implementation engagements, collaborating with customers, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Technical Support to deliver successful business outcomes.

.

* Build trusted relationships with customer Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and IT Operations teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong customer-facing experience working with enterprise IT and Security organizations.
* Hands-on experience integrating enterprise platforms using REST APIs.
* Experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to automate deployments, integrations, operational workflows, or troubleshooting tasks.

* Ability to independently lead multiple enterprise implementation engagements.

* Container Security
* Web Application Security
* External Attack Surface Management

title: L1 Production Support – Fixed Income Trading
description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. ## Overview

We are looking for a proactive and highly responsive L1 Production Support Analyst to join our global Fixed Income Technology Support team.

The role will provide first-line support for trading applications used by Rates and Investment Grade Credit trading desks across the APAC region, primarily supporting traders in Tokyo and Singapore. The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring platform health, managing production incidents, troubleshooting application issues, and ensuring a stable trading environment.

## Key Responsibilities

### Trading Application Support

• Provide first-line support for the ION Fixed Income trading platform and associated applications.

• Support front-office users including Rates and Investment Grade Credit traders.

• Investigate and resolve production incidents impacting trading, pricing, trade capture, and downstream trade flows.

• Monitor trading workflows and identify issues before they affect business users.

• Escalate incidents promptly to Level 2 support, development teams, infrastructure teams, or external vendors when required.

### Platform Monitoring & Operations

• Monitor application, server, and infrastructure health across the trading platform ecosystem.

• Monitor batch jobs, interfaces, trade feeds, and market data connectivity.

• Review system alerts and take appropriate action based on defined operational procedures.

• Perform start-of-day and end-of-day health checks.

• Ensure critical trading services remain available during market hours.

### Incident & Problem Management

• Manage incidents from identification through resolution.

• Communicate effectively with traders and support teams during outages and service degradation.

• Maintain clear records of incidents, actions taken, escalations, and resolutions.

• Follow up on outstanding issues and ensure closure within agreed service levels.

• Assist with root cause investigations and post-incident reviews.

### Stakeholder Communication

• Build strong working relationships with traders, technology teams, and operations teams.

• Provide timely updates on production issues and service incidents.

• Demonstrate ownership and accountability throughout the support lifecycle.

## Required Skills & Experience

### Business Knowledge

• Good understanding of Fixed Income products, including:

- Government Bonds / Treasuries

- Interest Rate Swaps

- Corporate Bonds

- Investment Grade Credit products

• Understanding of the trade lifecycle and front-office trading environment.

• Awareness of electronic trading workflows and market data concepts.

### Technical Skills

• Experience supporting the ION Fixed Income trading platform is strongly preferred.

• Strong Linux troubleshooting and operational support skills.

• Experience with Microsoft SQL Server.

• Ability to write SQL queries for analysis and troubleshooting.

• Ability to analyze logs, error messages, and application alerts.

• Familiarity with monitoring tools, production support processes, and incident management practices.

• Understanding of interfaces, trade feeds, and STP processes is desirable.

### Professional Skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to act quickly and remain calm during production incidents.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Detail-oriented with disciplined follow-up and ownership.

• Strong escalation management skills.

• Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced trading environment.

• Self-motivated with a strong sense of accountability and urgency.

---

## Preferred Qualifications

• 5 years of Production Support / Application Support experience.

• Experience supporting Front Office trading applications.

• Exposure to Fixed Income trading environments.

• Familiarity with Bloomberg, Tradeweb, MarketAxess, or similar trading platforms.

• Basic scripting knowledge (Shell, Python, or PowerShell) is advantageous.

---

**Key Traits:**

• Sense of urgency

• Strong communicator

• Proactive and accountable

• Detail-oriented

• Team player

• Effective under pressure

• Escalates appropriately and follows through relentlessly until resolution

This role directly supports front-office trading activities and plays a critical part in maintaining the stability and reliability of the firm's fixed income trading platform.

Mizuho Global Services (MGS), Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, MGS Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Collaboration with external vendors and internal service management teams is a key part of the daily routine, ensuring timely analysis and resolution of technical issues to support business continuity and operational efficiency.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
A mid-level Windows Administrator with hands-on experience in managing enterprise Windows Server environments. This role independently handles L2 tickets, participates in change management, and contributes to infrastructure improvement initiatives. The candidate is expected to demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills and familiarity with virtualization platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
L2 Incident & Problem Management
  
  
Own and resolve L2 incidents involving Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, and related services
  
  
Manage and execute change requests following ITIL change management processes
  
  
Coordinate scheduled maintenance windows and execute assigned changes
  
  
Proactively identify recurring issues and propose permanent fixes or workarounds
  
  
Advanced System Administration
  
  
Manage and troubleshoot Windows Failover Clustering, DFSR, and load-balanced services
  
  
Manage certificate lifecycle including SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal via PKI/CA
  
  
Perform capacity planning activities and report on infrastructure health metrics
  
  
Configure and manage Windows Server roles: File Server, Print Server, WDS, and Remote Desktop Services
  
  
Administer virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere / Hyper-V) at a beginner level
  
  
Security & Compliance
  
  
Implement and enforce security hardening standards (CIS Benchmarks) on Windows Servers
  
  
Manage antivirus/EDR tool deployments and ensure compliance across the server fleet
  
  
Assist in vulnerability assessment activities and coordinate remediation
  
  
Ensure servers comply with organizational security and audit policies
  
  
Mentorship & Collaboration
  
  
Participate in problem management meetings and contribute to knowledge base articles
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Network, Storage, Applications) for integrated issue resolution Contribute to internal documentation, SOPs, and runbook improvements
  
  
**Required Skills & Competencies**
Technical Skills
  
  
Windows Server 2012R2 through 2022 – Administration and troubleshooting
  
  
Windows Clustering (WSFC) – administration and basic troubleshooting
  
  
Virtualization – VMware vSphere or Hyper-V intermediate administration
  
  
SCCM/MECM – software deployment, patch management, imaging
  
  
PowerShell scripting – basic to intermediate automation for admin tasks
  
  
Security hardening – CIS Benchmarks, vulnerability scanning basics
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
Strong troubleshooting and analytical thinking
  
  
Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  
  
Ability to manage multiple incidents and priorities simultaneously
  
  
Proactive attitude toward identifying infrastructure gaps
  
  
Certifications
  
  
**Preferred / Advantageous Certifications**
Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800/801) – preferred
  
  
VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV) – advantageous
  
  
ITIL Foundation Certification – preferred
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Windows Server Administration.
* Experience with server installation, configuration, and maintenance.
* Knowledge of system security practices and disaster recovery procedures.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues related to Windows Server environments.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation tools to streamline administrative tasks.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Microsoft Windows Server Administration.
* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

In addition to administering core enterprise platforms including Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Confluence, Jira CMDB (Assets), and Statuspage, this role designs and implements AI powered automations, intelligent workflows, and predictive insights to enhance operational performance and user experience.

* Create and communicate knowledgebase articles to support IT staff and minimize support overhead

* 3+ years of experience in IT operations, SaaS administration, and supporting cloud-based Atlassian applications (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence)

* Experience working with audit, privacy, and security requirements, including SOC2, and HIPAA

title: Associate Applications Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Our clients need their systems to be reliable, secure, and available. As an Applications Engineer, you will help ensure that their applications and hosting environments run smoothly.
  
  
You will act as a bridge between our clients, technology, and engineering teams. You will understand client requirements, configure and deploy applications, troubleshoot technical issues, and support production environments.
  
  
This role is not limited to application support. It requires a combination of application support, troubleshooting, deployment, infrastructure knowledge, database skills, and basic coding/scripting knowledge. You will work with different technical teams to identify problems, implement solutions, automate repetitive tasks, and continuously improve application reliability.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Application Setup and Deployment**

* Install, configure, and deploy applications on servers and application services.
* Support application releases, code deployments, and environment setup.
* Handle client requests such as certificate installations, new sites, site updates, overwrites, and vanity URLs.
* Perform functional and integration testing before releases.
* Support application configuration and environment-related changes.

**Troubleshooting and Production Support**

* Investigate and resolve application errors, access issues, and performance problems.
* Analyze application and server logs to identify root causes.
* Monitor applications and servers and respond to production incidents.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, server, database, and network layers.
* Help maintain application availability, performance, and security.
* Follow change management procedures for installations, upgrades, and maintenance activities.

**Client and Team Collaboration**

* Act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal teams regarding hosting and application requests.
* Understand client requirements and communicate technical solutions clearly.
* Manage and prioritize cases in the hosting queue.
* Assign, update, and follow up on cases while keeping clients and hosting partners informed.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) when handling support cases.
* Review case backlogs and ensure timely updates and resolution.
* Manage shared mailboxes and communication with hosting partners.

**Technical Skills, Coding, And Automation**

* Work with APIs, databases, and other systems integrated with application.
* Use basic coding or scripting skills to troubleshoot issues and automate repetitive tasks.
* Write or modify simple scripts using technologies such as PowerShell, SQL, or other scripting languages.
* Develop automation where possible to improve application reliability and reduce manual effort.
* Understand application configuration, web applications, and basic software development concepts.

**Documentation and Continuous Improvement**

* Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and technical notes for client environments.
* Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to processes and applications.
* Learn and support Momentive's association management products.
* Work closely with developers, DevOps, infrastructure, QA, and business teams.
* Participate in the rotational on-call support schedule.

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience in application support, application implementation, or a similar technical role.
* Good understanding of application troubleshooting and production support.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server, IIS, Remote Desktop, and Domain Controllers.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Nagios, CloudWatch, or Pingdom.
* Basic understanding of backups and recovery processes.
* Basic SQL Server knowledge, including writing and understanding simple SQL queries.
* Basic coding or scripting knowledge and the ability to understand or modify scripts.
* Experience with cloud-hosted applications or cloud environments.
* Experience using ticketing or IT service management systems.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting client environments, applications, servers, and networks.
* Experience supporting clients through phone, email, or ticketing systems.
* Understanding of change management and controlled deployment processes.
* Ability to analyze logs and troubleshoot technical issues systematically.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Engineering degree, MCA, MCM, or equivalent technical qualification.

**Nice to Have**

* AWS, Azure, or Microsoft certifications.
* PowerShell scripting experience.
* Knowledge of ITIL or Microsoft Operations Framework.
* Experience with change management tools.
* Experience monitoring and maintaining distributed applications or systems.
* Knowledge of security best practices and client data protection.
* Experience setting up websites and web applications.
* Basic understanding of firewalls, networking, DNS, and certificates.
* Experience working with APIs and application integrations.

**How You Work**
You build strong relationships with clients and colleagues and can work effectively both independently and as part of a team. You take ownership of issues, communicate clearly, and focus on delivering reliable solutions.
  
  
You are comfortable working on technical problems, learning new technologies, and going into the details when an issue is complex. You have a client-first mindset and are willing to support a rotational schedule and participate in on-call responsibilities.
  
  
**About Us**
Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. description:

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. description:

description:

Area(s) of responsibility

Security Hardening & Misconfiguration Management

Document exceptions and risk acceptance with proper justification and approvals.

Implement and validate registry-level changes and system hardening controls.

Execute and analyze Windows commands and scripts for configuration validation.

Identify and validate insecure services, permissions, and system-level misconfigurations.

title: Specialist, Technical Support
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**Your Impact on our Mission**
Zocdoc’s most important asset is our people. As a Specialist, Technical Support, you’ll play a key role in ensuring our employees have the technology, tools, and support they need to do their best work. You’ll provide hands-on technical support to both onsite and remote employees, troubleshoot hardware and software issues across PC and Mac environments, and support critical IT operations including onboarding and offboarding, asset management, account administration, and workplace technology.
  
  
You’ll also have the opportunity to work with technologies such as Google Workspace, Azure AD, Intune, JAMF, Jira, Slack, and BetterCloud, while exploring how AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Glean, and Gemini can improve troubleshooting, documentation, automation, and everyday IT operations.
  
  
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, delivering an excellent employee experience, and continuously learning new technologies. You’ll have the chance to take ownership of day-to-day IT support while identifying opportunities to automate and improve processes at scale—all while helping Zocdoc teams stay productive and focused on our mission to give power to the patient.
  
  
**Your day-to-day is**

* Work within the IT Support Team to provide excellent customer service, effective response times and expert insights into general and sometimes complex support issues.
* Working in Night shift (6 pm-3 am) Providing WFH/On-site.
* Experience in Google Workspace admin is a must.
* Supporting on-site/remote desktop computing issues (PCs/Macs) as well as submitting repair requests to manufacturers for damaged machines.

* Ensure quality of service guidelines for dealing with customers, completing services, and overall customer satisfaction are adhered to.
* Assist other IT support staff with operational procedures and troubleshooting issues.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation for systems and processes managed by the Enterprise IT team, for both end-users and other IT staff.

* Work with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Glean, and Gemini to support troubleshooting, research, documentation, and day-to-day IT operations.
* Identify and use AI-powered solutions to automate repetitive/manual IT support tasks and improve operational efficiency.
* Assist with integrating approved AI tools into internal applications, workflows, and support processes while following security and privacy requirements.
* Hardware and software asset management.
* Staff onboarding and off-boarding, including machine imaging and account creation/configuration.

**You’ll enjoy this role if you are…**

* A self starter and have an entrepreneurial mindset
* Excited about learning new technologies
* Excited to use technology to enhance the consumer experience

**You’ll be successful in this role if you have…**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field or a mixture of IT-related certifications and relevant experience.
* 2+ years experience in a progressively responsible technical support or helpdesk role
* Strong customer service background required.
* Experience with AzureAD, Intune Endpoints
* Ability to identify common user experience issues and analyze root causes, delivering and implementing viable solutions at scale.
* Experience with some of the following: G Suite Apps, JIRA, Confluence, Slack, and Bettercloud.
* On-site and remote desktop troubleshooting skills for PC and Mac, software and hardware.
* Proficiency with MS Windows domain environment (Windows Server, Active Directory, LDAP, DHCP, license management, workstation imaging, access controls)
* Proficiency with Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor authentication.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Glean, Gemini, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of how AI can be used for technical troubleshooting, documentation, research, and workflow automation.
* Ability to use AI responsibly, validate AI-generated outputs, and identify opportunities to improve IT support processes through automation.
* Familiar with JAMF/JSS Suite.
* Scripting experience (BASH, PowerShell, or similar).

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Flexible, hybrid work environment
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace

* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
* Competitive PTO

**Location**

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need.
