description:
**Company Description**
As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals, and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
With over 4,400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries, our people are our advantage. We foster a culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration to create an environment where everyone can thrive and do their best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business, or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we’re looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you’re ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking a
***PUNE***
based
***VP Database Operations Manager***
to join our
***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
in Global Technology & Operations.
  
  
**Team/Group Description**
This position operates in a fast-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
  
  
**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real-time global decision-making, powers enterprise-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent & ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long-term organizational objectives.

**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise-scale data infrastructure.
  
  
You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high-impact challenges.
  
  
With global scope, mission-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
  
  
**Professional development value of this role**
Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization - such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
  
  
**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
  
  

* Demonstrated success leading large-scale, global or multi-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission-critical system reliability.

**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.

**Skills**

* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase & IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.

**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**

* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

title: Principal Test Engineer
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a
**Principal Test Engineer (Test PE) / QA Lead**
to partner directly with the Sonicwall Firewall development team. In this high-impact technical role, you will lead feature testing, complex defect reproduction, test plan architecture, and automation development across critical Sonicwall Firewall networking and security components.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* ****Dev Partnership & Defect Triage:****
  Work closely with firmware and software developers to reproduce intricate customer and field issues, isolate root causes, and verify bug fixes.
* ****Test Strategy & Planning:****
  Architect end-to-end test strategies, author detailed test plans, and design comprehensive functional, system, and regression test suites.
* ****STLC & Quality Governance:****
  Drive the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)—identifying, filing, prioritizing, and tracking defects to closure in an Agile environment.
* ****Test Automation Engineering:****
  Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, and system) using Python to integrate into continuous testing pipelines.
* ****Component & Feature Qualification:****
  Deep-dive into Sonicwall Firewall  subsystems to validate new feature requirements, performance limits, and edge-case handling.
* ****Technical QA Mentorship:****
  Guide and mentor team members on test methodologies, test tool development, and network security validation.

**Core Skills & Requirements**

* ****Domain & SQA Experience:****
  10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls.

* ****Domain & Network Security Expertise:****

+ Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.
+ Strong expertise in Network Security and Next-Generation Firewalling: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS, IPSec/SSL VPN, and access rules.

* ****Test Automation & Scripting:****

+ Strong hands-on programming/scripting proficiency in
  **Python**
  (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation).
+ Experience utilizing traffic generators and test tools (e.g., IXIA, Spirent, Scapy, tcpreplay).

* ****Troubleshooting & Issue Reproduction:****

+ Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to capture and analyze network packets (Wireshark, tcpdump).
+ Experience analyzing system logs, core dumps, and device diagnostics to triage complex system/firmware behaviors.

* ****Methodologies & Processes:****

+ Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices.
+ Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies.

* ****Professional Experience:****

+ 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams.
* Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.

description:

**About the Role**

  

We are hiring a GTM Engineer to own our lead and account data pipeline end to end, keep our email sending infrastructure healthy, and build scalable GTM workflows. This person will ensure our CRM and outbound systems run on clean, enriched, deduped, and usable data, while building automations in n8n and Clay, and using tools like HubSpot, Apollo, Cognism, Lemlist, NeverBounce, and Bright Data.

  

This role is a mix of data hygiene, GTM engineering, email deliverability and domain management, and scraping and enrichment operations.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Run enrichment waterfalls (email, phone, LinkedIn, firmographics)
  
* Manage scraping workflows using Bright Data and Apollo exports
  
* Prepare outbound lists and ensure they are campaign-ready with low bounce rates
  
* Reduce duplicate and stale records across CRM and data sources
  
* Implement and manage email validation workflows
  
* Maintain reporting on list health, data completeness, and coverage metrics
  
* Document workflows and create repeatable, scalable processes
  
* Run light scripts or technical executions where needed
  
  

**Requirements**

  
* 3+ years in RevOps/Sales Ops/GTM Ops/Data Ops
  
* Strong hands-on HubSpot CRM
  
* Strong hands-on n8n
  
* Strong hands-on Clay
  
* Experience with data enrichment tools (Lusha, Apollo, etc.)
  
* Experience with Smartlead
  
* Understanding of email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up)
  
* Ability to troubleshoot automation workflows and light scripting
  
  

**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Bounce rate consistently under target (for example, under 2%)
  
* Domain and inbox health stable, with no deliverability incidents (blacklisting, spam flags)
  
* CRM data completeness improved (email, LinkedIn, and firmographics)
  
* Reduced duplicates and stale records
  
* Reliable, repeatable n8n and Clay workflows for list building, enrichment, and segmentation
  
* Faster turnaround time on outbound ready lists
  
  

  
**Benefits**

  
* Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  
* No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
  
* Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  
* Support That Matters:Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  
* True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

title: Mobility Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Mobility Specialist**
**Position Summary**
The Mobility Specialist provides operational support for enterprise mobile services, including mobile device provisioning, carrier support, eSIM management, and user assistance. This role works with employees, mobile service providers, and internal teams to ensure reliable mobile connectivity and timely resolution of mobility-related requests.
  
  
The ideal candidate is customer-focused, organized, and experienced in supporting mobile devices, wireless services, and telecommunications processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Position Location & Regional Coverage**
We are currently hiring multiple Mobility Specialists to support employees across the following regions:
  
  

* North America (NAM)
* Latin America (LATAM)
* Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA)
* Asia Pacific (APAC)

Each Mobility Specialist will serve as the primary mobility operations resource for their assigned region, providing support for mobile services, carrier relationships, eSIM administration, provisioning activities, mobile number management, and end-user mobility support. While aligned to a specific region, team members will collaborate globally to ensure a consistent mobility experience and service delivery model across the organization.
  
  
**Mobile Service Administration**

* Process mobile service requests including new activations, upgrades, line changes, suspensions, and disconnects.
* Coordinate mobile device replacements and service transfers.
* Maintain accurate records of mobile numbers, devices, and service information.
* Assist with mobile inventory tracking and asset management activities.

**SIM & eSIM Support**

* Provision and activate physical SIMs and eSIMs.
* Support users with eSIM setup and activation.
* Troubleshoot common SIM and eSIM issues.
* Coordinate SIM replacements and device upgrade activities.

**User Support**

* Provide day-to-day support for mobile phones, tablets, and wireless services.
* Troubleshoot mobile connectivity, voice, text messaging, and data service issues.
* Assist users with device setup and carrier-related issues.
* Support requests involving lost, stolen, or damaged devices.
* Provide white-glove support for VIP users when required.

**Carrier Coordination**

* Submit support requests and service orders with mobile carriers.
* Track carrier tickets and follow up on outstanding issues.
* Escalate service-impacting issues when necessary.
* Assist with number porting and mobile service changes.

**Security & Account Support**

* Assist users with PIN and PUK code requests.
* Support carrier verification and account authentication processes.
* Coordinate SIM swap requests using approved procedures.
* Report suspected mobile fraud or unauthorized activity.

**Operational Support**

* Maintain mobility documentation and knowledge articles.
* Assist with reporting and inventory audits.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Participate in mobility-related projects and service enhancements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Associate degree or equivalent work experience.
* 1-3 years of experience supporting mobile devices, telecommunications services, or end-user technology.
* Experience working with mobile phones, tablets, and wireless carriers.
* Basic understanding of eSIM technology and mobile service provisioning.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise mobile phone programs.
* Experience working with wireless carriers such as Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Vodafone, Orange, or Telefónica.
* Familiarity with telecom inventory management systems.
* ITIL or customer support experience.
* Experience supporting corporate mobile device deployments.

**Key Competencies**

* Customer Service
* Mobile Device Support
* eSIM Administration
* SIM Management
* Carrier Coordination
* Problem Solving
* Inventory Management
* Attention to Detail
* Communication Skills
* Organization and Planning

**Success Measures**

* Timely completion of mobility requests
* User satisfaction with mobility services
* Accuracy of device and service inventories
* Resolution of carrier and connectivity issues
* Successful device provisioning and activations
* Compliance with service-level expectations

**Reporting To:**
Mobility Services Lead / EUC Manager
  
  
This role serves as the primary operational resource for employee mobility services, ensuring users receive timely support for mobile devices, carrier services, eSIM activation, and mobile connectivity needs. This version will typically attract Mobility Analysts, Telecom Analysts, Service Desk Leads, and junior Mobility Specialists rather than senior telecom administrators or mobility architects.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
Based on the scope described for this role, you will have the opportunity to:
  
  

* Work with business-critical DB2 and Informix database environments
* Contribute to service stability, availability and continual operational improvement
* Develop expertise across database optimisation, automation, observability and SRE practices
* Collaborate closely with application and operations teams on critical production services
* Contribute to AI-driven optimisation initiatives across CRM and end-to-end operations

The responsibilities of the role provide opportunities to further develop skills in:
  
  

* Advanced DB2 and Informix database administration and optimisation
* Database migration, upgrades, high availability, backup and recovery
* SRE principles and service reliability practices
* Monitoring and observability, including alert tuning, log analysis and dashboarding
* UNIX and scripting-based operational automation
* Security auditing and SOX compliance
* Database performance diagnostics and SQL tuning
* AI-driven approaches to operational optimisation

**Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant**
**Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services**
help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.

* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.

* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.
* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

* ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.

* Perform environment validation, deployment verification and patch-coordination activities
* Drive middleware performance tuning and service optimisation

Automation, observability and continual improvement

* Apply automation, SRE practices and AI-driven operational insights to improve efficiency
* Use operational trends to reduce Mean Time To Restore (MTTR), recurring incidents and manual operational effort
* Improve monitoring coverage, alert thresholds and proactive issue detection

**10+ years of experience in Telecom IT, Middleware, Integration or Enterprise Application Operations**
, with substantial hands-on responsibility for Oracle Fusion Middleware production environments.

* Oracle SOA Suite administration and production support
* Oracle Service Bus (OSB)
* Oracle WebLogic Server administration
* Oracle WebCenter Content (WCC)
* Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)
* BPEL processes, Mediators and Adapters
* SOAP and REST services
* API and message-based integration
* Middleware performance tuning
* High availability and disaster recovery

**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Middleware professional to provide senior subject-matter expertise and end-to-end operational ownership across Oracle Middleware, Enterprise Integration and Enterprise Content Management services.

You will lead production support, major incident recovery, service transitions and platform stabilisation while advancing observability, automation, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and AI-driven operational optimisation. Candidates should bring 12+ years of relevant experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for Oracle Fusion Middleware production environments, together with technical leadership and service-governance experience.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Middleware and integration operations
  
  

* Own the operational health, availability, performance, resilience and supportability of Oracle SOA Suite, OSB, WebLogic and WCC platforms
* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex middleware, integration, service orchestration and content-management incidents
* Govern critical integration flows, messaging frameworks, service orchestration processes and enterprise content services
* Maintain service-level commitments across middleware and integration platforms
* Lead capacity planning, performance optimisation and technology lifecycle activities

Incident, problem and service management
  
  

* Lead P1/P2 major-incident recovery and coordinate troubleshooting across application, infrastructure, database and network teams
* Lead root-cause analysis, corrective actions and known-error management to reduce recurring disruption
* Maintain SLA and KPI performance across Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request and operational-risk processes
* Establish proactive support practices focused on resilience and reduced service downtime
* Conduct post-incident reviews and translate findings into continual-improvement actions

Service transition and operational readiness
  
  

* Lead due diligence, knowledge acquisition, service transition and operational takeover
* Coordinate shadowing, reverse-shadowing and knowledge-transfer activities
* Establish operational-readiness requirements covering documentation, monitoring, runbooks, access management, escalation procedures, capacity planning, security controls and disaster recovery
* Own early-life support and stabilisation of transitioned services

Platform governance and administration
  
  

* Monitor and maintain the operational reliability of interfaces, APIs, web services, message flows and enterprise integrations
* Manage Oracle WebLogic domains, clusters, managed servers and application deployments
* Support Oracle SOA composites, BPEL processes, Mediators, Adapters and OSB services
* Administer and support WCC repositories, content workflows, storage utilisation and service availability
* Perform environment validation, deployment verification and patch-coordination activities
* Identify performance degradation, integration failures and bottlenecks and coordinate appropriate remediation
* Maintain middleware compliance with applicable security and audit requirements

Automation, observability and continual improvement
  
  

* Automate health checks, deployment verification, service validation, housekeeping and operational reporting using Shell Scripting, WLST, SQL and relevant automation technologies
* Develop proactive monitoring, dashboards and alerting using enterprise observability platforms
* Apply operational insights and AI-driven approaches to improve efficiency and reliability
* Use service trends to reduce Mean Time To Restore (MTTR), repeat incidents and manual operational effort
* Improve alert thresholds, event correlation and proactive issue detection

* Partner with Business, Enterprise Architecture, Service Management, Infrastructure, Database, Security, Application and Vendor teams
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to L2/L3 support engineers
* Support knowledge management, cross-skilling and succession planning
* Facilitate operational reviews, governance forums and service-improvement initiatives
* Maintain clear stakeholder communication during outages, service changes and transition activities

**12+ years of experience in Telecom IT, Middleware, Integration or Enterprise Application Operations**
, with substantial hands-on experience supporting Oracle middleware in highly available, mission-critical production environments.
  
  
Essential technical knowledge
  
  

* Oracle SOA Suite administration and production support
* Oracle Service Bus (OSB)
* Oracle WebLogic Server administration
* Oracle WebCenter Content (WCC)
* Enterprise Application Integration (EAI) and Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)
* BPEL, Mediators and Adapters
* SOAP and REST services
* API and message-based integration
* Middleware performance tuning
* High Availability and Disaster Recovery
* Unix/Linux administration and Shell Scripting
* Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
* WebLogic Scripting Tool (WLST)
* Middleware and application log analysis
* Interface troubleshooting and monitoring
* Oracle Database fundamentals
* SRE practices and AI-driven operational optimisation

Service and operational expertise
  
  
You have demonstrable experience in major incident and problem management, service recovery, service transition, operational readiness, ITIL-aligned service management, observability, automation and operational improvement. You can apply independent judgement to complex production issues while coordinating effectively across technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
Knowledge of managed-service governance, vendor management, audit and compliance readiness, business continuity, disaster recovery, capacity and availability management, and operational risk management is also relevant.
  
  
Desirable exposure
  
  
Experience with one or more of the following would complement the core requirements:
  
  

* Oracle API Gateway and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* Oracle Identity Management, Oracle Access Manager and Oracle Internet Directory
* Apache Web Server and load balancers
* Control-M
* Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix

title: ServiceNow SecOps SIR - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant**
**Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services**
help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.
  
  
**Work you will do**
As a
**Consultant / Senior Consultant**
, you would be expected to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.
* Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service.
* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.
* Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen.
* Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration.
* Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations.
* Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities.

**Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)**

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.
* Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions.
* Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling.
* Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities.
* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation.
* Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload.
* Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management.
* Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response.
* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

**Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)**
Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.
* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.
* Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion.

**Core Skills**
ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.
  
  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**

description:

**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Company: Attron Automotive Private Limited

Location: Pune

Experience: 0 to 2 years

Department: Mechanical Design / Product Development

Role Type: Full-time

About the Role

Attron Automotive is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer with strong fundamentals, good design thinking, and hands-on interest in CAD, FEA, and product development.

The role is suitable for freshers or early-career engineers who are eager to work on real engineering products, understand design constraints, and contribute to mechanical design, analysis, prototyping, validation, and manufacturing support.

* Key Responsibilities
  Work on mechanical design of motor, controller, powertrain, and related EV components.
* Create 3D CAD models, assemblies, and detailed manufacturing drawings.
* Support design calculations, tolerance stack-up, material selection, and design reviews.
* Perform basic FEA simulations for structural, thermal, and vibration-related requirements.
* Coordinate with manufacturing, vendors, production, and quality teams for design execution.
* Support prototype development, assembly trials, fitment checks, and validation activities.
* Prepare BOMs, design documentation, technical reports, and test observations.
* Improve existing designs for manufacturability, cost, weight, reliability, and ease of assembly.
* Support root-cause analysis for mechanical failures, fitment issues, or performance concerns.
* Maintain proper version control and documentation of drawings, CAD files, and design changes.
* Required Skills
  Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals.
* Good understanding of machine design, strength of materials, engineering materials, and manufacturing processes.
* Hands-on knowledge of 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Creo, CATIA, or equivalent.
* Basic understanding of 2D drawings, GD&T, tolerances, fits, and manufacturing drawings.
* Basic exposure to FEA tools such as ANSYS, SolidWorks Simulation, Abaqus, or equivalent.
* Ability to perform basic engineering calculations before relying on simulation.
* Good problem-solving ability and design thinking.
* Willingness to work hands-on with prototypes, assembly, testing, and production teams.
* Preferred Skills
  Experience with EV components, motors, controllers, enclosures, shafts, housings, cooling systems, or sheet metal parts will be preferred.
* Knowledge of thermal management, vibration, sealing, IP ratings, and DFM/DFA will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to prototyping, machining, casting, sheet metal, aluminium parts, or plastic components will be useful.
* Internship or project experience involving CAD, FEA, product design, automotive, robotics, EVs, or mechanical systems will be preferred.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be someone who:

* Has strong engineering fundamentals.
* Can think from first principles before directly jumping to CAD.
* Is comfortable designing parts, assemblies, and mechanisms.
* Understands that CAD is a tool, not the complete design process.
* Can learn quickly from testing, manufacturing, and field feedback.
* Is detail-oriented in drawings, fits, tolerances, and documentation.
* Is excited to work in a fast-moving product development environment.
* What We Are Not Looking For
  Someone who only knows CAD commands but does not understand design logic.
* Someone who depends only on FEA without basic engineering calculations.
* Someone who is not comfortable with hands-on prototype and manufacturing interaction.
* Someone who is not willing to document design decisions properly.

**Position Type: Full-time**

**Work Preference: Onsite**

**Job Description**

We’re looking for an experienced
**Senior Hardware Design Engineer**
with
**7-10 years**
of experience to design and develop automated test equipment, functional test fixtures, interface electronics, and validation hardware used in manufacturing environments for fire alarm panels, control boards, and related electronic assemblies.

This role focuses on development of robust, production-ready electrical test platforms that improve repeatability, reduce operator dependency, and make test processes more automated, reliable, and error-proof. The engineer will own hardware design and implementation for fixture electronics, instrument interfacing, safety interlocks, DUT programming interfaces, and test system integration, while supporting prototyping, validation, and manufacturing deployment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Hardware Architecture & Fixture Electronics**

* Design and develop electrical architecture for automated test fixtures and production test stations used for PCBAs and assembled electronic products.
* Create schematics, interface boards, wiring architectures, and electrical documentation for manufacturing test systems.
* Define hardware partitioning between fixture electronics, DUT interface boards, instrumentation, power switching, safety circuits, and operator indicators.
* Participate in cross-functional design reviews with firmware, mechanical, manufacturing, and quality teams.

**DUT Interface, Measurement & Control**

* Design circuits for safe and repeatable interfacing to DUT power rails, digital IO, analog signals, communication ports, relays, indicators, sensors, and user-interface elements.
* Develop switching, signal routing, conditioning, and measurement interface circuits for validation of voltage rails, current draw, startup behaviour, sequencing, protection features, communications, and functional IO.
* Support implementation of test coverage for analog, digital, timing, communication, and safety-related behaviour.
* Design firmware programming and debug interfaces for DUT flashing, configuration, and diagnostic access.

**Instrumentation & Production Test Integration**

* Select and integrate instruments and interface electronics such as DMMs, programmable power supplies, DAQ modules, relays, multiplexers, oscilloscopes, and communication adaptors as required.
* Develop robust harnessing, connector strategies, pogo-pin or fixture interconnect concepts, and serviceable field wiring for production use.
* Ensure repeatable electrical performance with appropriate grounding, shielding, ESD protection, isolation, and noise mitigation techniques.
* Support integration with production systems, serial number scanning, traceability requirements, and manufacturing application interfaces.

**Safety, Interlocks & Error-Proofing**

* Design guarded, interlocked, and operator-safe electrical systems that prevent exposure to hazardous voltages and support safe-state behaviour.
* Implement lid interlock circuits, zero-potential safety logic, emergency stop or fault handling provisions, and pass/fail visual indication hardware.
* Support poka-yoke / error-proofing mechanisms to reduce incorrect loading, incorrect connections, and operator misinterpretation of results.
* Design for diagnostic visibility, serviceability, and maintainability in production environments.

**Prototyping, Debugging & Validation**

* Support fixture bring-up, electrical debugging, root cause analysis, and pilot-line validation.
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power analysers, and other lab instruments to debug fixture behaviour, measurement issues, noise, timing, or interface problems.
* Validate accuracy, repeatability, false-fail performance, and robustness of test hardware across known-good and known-bad DUTs.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and quality teams during pilot runs and release to production.

**Documentation & Delivery**

* Create complete hardware development documentation including schematics, BOMs, wiring diagrams, interface definitions, test hardware drawings, validation summaries, and release files.
* Support ECO/change-control workflows and maintain clear revision history for fixture hardware.
* Deliver prototype hardware, debug updates, and final production-release design files.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 7-10 years in embedded hardware, test hardware, industrial electronics, or manufacturing test system development.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline.
* Strong expertise in mixed-signal circuit design, measurement interfaces, power distribution, protection circuits, switching, and industrial-grade hardware design.
* Hands-on experience with board bring-up, debugging, instrumentation integration, communication interfaces, and production test environments.
* Experience with fixture electronics, DUT interfacing, programming interfaces, or automated test systems preferred.
* Strong understanding of grounding, shielding, ESD protection, isolation, and noise mitigation for repeatable measurements.
* Ability to work across hardware, firmware, mechanical, quality, and manufacturing teams to deliver practical factory-ready systems.
* Strong documentation, problem-solving, and system-level thinking skills.

**Tech Stack & Tools**

* Schematic Capture & PCB Layout: Altium Designer
* Analysis & Debug: Oscilloscope, logic analyser, DMM, power analyser, DAQ tools, LTSpice
* Interfaces & Protocols: UART, I2C, SPI, CAN, RS485/RS232, Ethernet, USB, GPIO-based fixture control
* Test System Elements: Programmable power supplies, switching/relay cards, measurement interfaces, DUT programming tools, barcode / serial scanning interfaces
* Version Control & Documentation: Standard engineering documentation and release control tools
* Lab / Validation: Harness validation tools, ESD controls, calibration support tools, pilot-line debug equipment

**Core Competencies**

Systems Thinking | Test Hardware Architecture | Mixed-Signal Design | Measurement Integrity | Production Test Automation | Safety Interlocks | Error-Proofing Mindset | Debugging Excellence | Manufacturing Support | Documentation Discipline | Ownership Mindset | Collaboration | Accountability | Continuous Improvement

title: Executive Assistant to CEO | Founder's Office
description:
**Company:**
Peppermint

**Location:**
Pune | Work from Office | 6 Days a Week

**Experience:**
3-5 years preferred

**Reporting to:**
CEO

**About Peppermint**

Peppermint is a growing kidswear brand with a presence across 350+ large-format retail stores, independent retailers, our own stores, and online marketplaces. With substantial in-house manufacturing capabilities, we're building a stronger, more scalable, technology-driven consumer business. We're investing heavily in technology, automation, and operational excellence, including our own enterprise platform that will transform how we run the business.

We're a company of builders who value ownership, resourcefulness, speed, and getting things done.

**The Opportunity**

**We're looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant who is organized, resourceful, proactive, and takes ownership without needing to be chased.**

* You'll work directly with the CEO, helping manage priorities, commitments, communications, and day-to-day execution across a fast-moving and complex business.
* This is not a conventional administrative or secretarial position. We're looking for someone who can think independently, anticipate requirements, exercise sound judgment, and ensure that important things get done.
* Your responsibilities will range from managing the CEO's schedule and communications to coordinating with senior stakeholders, following through on critical commitments, conducting research, supporting recruitment, and independently driving special assignments.
* You won't be expected to make every important decision independently. But once something is entrusted to you, we'll expect you to take responsibility for driving it forward, navigating obstacles, and ensuring it gets done.

**The goal is simple: Make the CEO more effective by bringing structure, reliability, and exceptional execution to everything you own.**

**What You'll Do**

* **Manage the CEO's priorities:**
  Own calendar management, daily agendas, meeting preparation, scheduling, travel arrangements, expense reporting, and administrative coordination. Proactively anticipate requirements and resolve scheduling conflicts.
* **Own communication and correspondence:**
  Act as a first point of contact across emails, calls, messages, and meeting requests. Prioritize incoming communications, draft correspondence, respond on behalf of the CEO where appropriate, and ensure timely follow-through.
* **Drive follow-through:**
  Track commitments, decisions, and action items across meetings and conversations. Monitor progress on key initiatives, follow up proactively with stakeholders, and ensure nothing important falls through the cracks.
* **Be a trusted coordination partner:**
  Work with internal teams, senior stakeholders, external partners, and vendors. Manage interactions with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment.
* **Take ownership of special assignments:**
  Independently drive research, analysis, vendor evaluations, planning, problem-solving, and smaller business projects from initiation to completion.
* **Support recruitment and hiring:**
  Assist with candidate sourcing, resume screening, interview scheduling, candidate communication, and coordination of the hiring process.
* **Manage travel and logistics:**
  Independently handle domestic and international travel planning, detailed itineraries, flight and accommodation bookings, visa applications, and related arrangements.
* **Bring structure to complexity:**
  Organize information, prepare concise briefs, maintain trackers, manage competing priorities, and ensure the CEO has the right information at the right time.
* **Anticipate and solve problems:**
  Identify potential issues before they become urgent, find practical solutions, and handle routine decisions independently while escalating important matters appropriately.
* **Improve the way things work:**
  Leverage technology, automation, productivity tools, and better processes to simplify recurring tasks and improve personal and organizational efficiency.

This is a hands-on role that requires equal comfort with detailed administrative coordination, independent problem-solving, and working with people across all levels of the organization.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who combines
**strong intellectual ability, exceptional organizational skills, a genuine service-oriented mindset, and an unusually high sense of ownership.**

**Education & Professional Background**

* Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record, preferably from a reputed institution. A postgraduate qualification is an advantage, but not essential.
* Typically 3-5 years of professional experience, ideally including at least 2 years supporting senior leadership, founders, or business owners in a fast-paced organization.
* Experience in executive assistance, business coordination, founder's office, operations, or cross-functional project management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi, with the confidence to interact professionally with senior stakeholders.
* Strong logical and analytical ability, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to independently prioritize competing demands.
* **Excellent tech proficiency:**
  Strong command of Google Workspace (particularly Gmail and Google Calendar), Microsoft Office (especially Excel and Word), task management applications, and modern productivity tools. Comfortable learning new software and systems.
* Experience coordinating domestic and international travel, including bookings, itineraries, and visa documentation.
* A demonstrated track record of independently managing responsibilities, handling confidential information, and delivering outcomes reliably.
* Experience in entrepreneurial, founder-led, or operationally complex businesses is an advantage.

**Personal Attributes**

* **Extreme Ownership:**
  You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks, and follow through without reminders.
* **Proactiveness:**
  You think ahead, anticipate needs, and act before being asked.
* **Exceptional Organization:**
  You manage numerous moving parts with meticulous attention to detail, using effective systems to ensure nothing slips through the cracks.
* **Service-Oriented Mindset:**
  You genuinely enjoy enabling others to perform at their best and take pride in making the people you support more effective.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  You figure things out, even when problems are unfamiliar or instructions are incomplete.
* **Persistence:**
  You're a natural follow-up master who navigates obstacles and ensures commitments translate into results.
* **Discretion & Judgment:**
  You handle sensitive information responsibly and understand when to act independently and when to seek guidance.
* **Adaptability & Low Ego:**
  You're a flexible team player, comfortable handling everything from important business matters to the smallest operational details without hesitation.

**What You Should Know Before Applying**

We believe in being upfront about what working here looks like.

* **This is an intense, high-trust role:**
  We're in an ambitious phase of building and transforming Peppermint. The next 2-3 years will involve significant operational change, new technology, and a lot of execution. This is not a conventional 9-to-6 role. We're a
  **six-day-a-week, work-from-office organization**
  , and the role requires flexibility and commitment beyond fixed working hours when business priorities demand it. If you're looking for a strictly five-day workweek or highly predictable hours, this probably isn't the right opportunity.
* **We're building the environment, not just working in it:**
  We value people who are comfortable with imperfect environments, can create order from ambiguity, and enjoy being part of the transformation. There will be ambiguity, competing priorities, and situations where the answer isn't immediately obvious. You'll need to get involved, speak to people, understand the details, and drive solutions rather than simply recommend them.
* **You'll need to be proactive, not just responsive:**
  This role requires someone who can think ahead, independently solve problems, and take responsibility for ensuring things happen. We value people who take initiative, anticipate what needs to be done, and move things forward independently without needing constant direction or follow-up.

**Why Join Us?**

* **A business with enormous potential:**
  Join one of India's leading kidswear brands at an exciting stage of growth, with significant opportunities in D2C expansion (online and offline), boyswear, and a strong foundation of vertically integrated manufacturing.
* **Build the next generation of Peppermint:**
  Help transform a complex, established business through technology, automation, better processes, and modern operating systems, including our in-house enterprise platform.
* **Meaningful responsibility and impact:**
  Play a pivotal role in keeping important priorities moving, solving problems, and making the leadership team and organization more effective.
* **An entrepreneurial environment:**
  Work in a high-agency culture where initiative, resourcefulness, and execution matter more than hierarchy. As you deliver results, your responsibilities and opportunities will grow with the business.

**If you're someone who naturally takes charge, thinks two steps ahead, enjoys solving problems, and takes pride in making things happen, we'd love to hear from you.**

* Design, build, and maintain robust data analytic reports and processes to support Service Assurance reporting and analytics needs.

* Utilise Claude (Anthropic) and other AI-assisted tools to automate reporting, generate data summaries, and produce actionable interpretations of complex datasets.
* Write and maintain SQL scripts, Python scripts, and LLM prompts to support data extraction, transformation, and analysis tasks.
* Perform trend analysis and data storytelling, not just producing reports, but interpreting what the data means and communicating findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate business questions into data solutions.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Proven experience as a Data Engineer or in a closely related data role (e.g. BI Developer, Analytics Engineer).
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake, including Snowflake Cortex for advanced analytics and AI-powered SQL functions.
* Strong proficiency in SQL — writing complex queries, optimising performance, and working with large datasets.
* Experience developing reports and dashboards in BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.
* Proven experience designing and optimizing ETL pipelines and data architectures, with demonstrable focus on performance and cost efficiency.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude (Anthropic) for data interpretation, prompt engineering, and automated reporting workflows.
* Ability to write and maintain Python scripts for data processing, automation, and analysis.
* Experience creating and refining LLM prompts to extract structured insight from unstructured data or to automate narrative reporting.
* Strong analytical mindset — able to interpret what data trends and patterns mean in a business context, not just produce numbers.
* Proven ability to present data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Guest Relations Executive
description:
**About the job**

**Get to know us better**

We are Gera Developments Private Limited (GDPL), a brand known by our five-decade history as one of the pioneers in the Real Estate business in Pune. Innovation, transparency, and enhanced customer experience is how we have created award-winning, premium residential and commercial projects in Pune, Goa, Bengaluru, and California. We live and work by “Let’s Outdo”, a philosophy that defines everything we do to raise the standards of Real Estate in the country.

There are many ‘firsts’ that stand to our credit. Way back in 2004, we introduced India’s first 5-year Warranty on Real Estate, that RERA mandated only in 2017. We then introduced India’s first and only 7-year warranty in Real Estate. In 2014, we designed and launched the award-winning ChildCentric® Homes, which revolutionised the Real Estate sector for both, the developer, and the home buyer. IntelliplexesTM, SkyVillasTM, and The Imperium series are our other highly successful product lines. In our 50th Year, we launched yet another first-of-its-kind industry initiative—Gera’s Home Equity Power—a means to provide financial flexibility to customers to meet financial emergencies.

**How the world sees us**

It has been an honour to be recognised as an innovative business leader, and an employer to build a career with by some of the best talent in the country.

We’re the only Real Estate company to be recognised in the top 10 mid-size organisations six times in a row by the Great Places to Work® Institute, and we continue to feature amongst the Top 50 Great Mid-Size WorkplacesTM 2024 in India. In 2024, we have also been proudly recognised as one of India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Real Estate, and India’s Best WorkplacesTM in Building a Culture of Innovation for All. As we raise the bar on service orientation, product innovation, real estate marketing, and brand building, we are consciously creating a workplace where our employees achieve new heights in their areas of expertise.

**Our people-forward culture**

How did we achieve this? By cheering for our outdoers. We care about our people, and invest in their success. We cultivate a culture of innovation, inclusiveness, high growth and rewards, inspiring our employees to challenge themselves, and besting their own past performance to achieve their professional goals and their self-development objectives.

We are looking for a Guest Relation Executive for our projects in Pune East & West

* Multitasking time-management skills are essential.
* Familiarize with Front Office policies and procedures.
* Receive inbound calls and visitors. Give brief project information and handout collateral to prospects.

Personality Dimensions:

* Multi-tasking with high levels of tenacity
* Good interpersonal skills
* Proactive & Self driven
* Result Oriented

Candidates from hospitality or aviation may apply.

If you love 'OUTDOING', this is the place to be!

title: IR & Forensics - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join the Cyber Incident Response & Forensics team at Deloitte as a Senior Consultant supporting organizations through complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders while helping lead rapid-response incident management, forensic analysis, and threat hunting activities. This position requires sound judgment, immediate responsiveness during active incidents, and the ability to work independently in high-pressure situations.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Incident Response team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Lead incident response activities for malware, ransomware, data breach, and insider threat investigations across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Perform triage, containment, and forensic analysis across endpoints, networks, cloud environments, and identity infrastructure, including Windows, Linux, and macOS systems
* Conduct threat hunting, log analysis, malware analysis, and investigation activities across security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, and network security platforms
* Document incident timelines, indicators of compromise, attack methodologies, findings, and remediation actions, and prepare post-incident reports and reviews
* Serve as a technical advisor to client stakeholders during active incidents, support tabletop exercises and incident response planning, and contribute to internal playbooks and knowledge assets

**The team**
Deloitte’s Cyber Incident Response team helps organizations investigate, contain, and recover from complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. The team supports clients through forensic analysis, threat hunting, incident management, and recovery planning during high-impact events. Professionals in this practice work across industries to strengthen incident response readiness, improve detection and response capabilities, and reduce the impact of future attacks.
  
  
**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Based on client / project needs**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a comparable technical field, or equivalent experience
* 6-10 years of cybersecurity experience, including at least 2+ years of incident response experience
* Experience responding to ransomware, business email compromise, or advanced persistent threat incidents
* Experience supporting enterprise clients in a consulting environment
* Experience with security information and event management platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or Chronicle
* Experience with forensic tools such as Magnet Axiom, EnCase, FTK, Volatility, X-Ways, or Autopsy
* Experience with endpoint detection and response or extended detection and response platforms, network analysis tools, threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK or STIX/TAXII, scripting in Python, PowerShell, or Bash, and Active Directory attack techniques

Preferred:
  
  

* GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
* GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
* GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or equivalent certification
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)

#Cyber\_Defense & Resilience

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
