title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Description**
At
**Relatient**
, we help healthcare organizations optimize patient access through AI-powered workflows, real-time automation, and flexible access tools. Trusted by more than 50,000 providers, we modernize the patient experience and have been recognized by Forbes and Deloitte for our innovative, inclusive culture.
  
  
**Your Role at Relatient:**
We’re seeking an
**Infrastructure Engineer**
to join our team at
**Amar Tech Park**
.
  
  
In this role, you’ll manage and optimize Relatient’s AWS infrastructure to support the stability, performance, and security of our healthcare SaaS platform. You’ll partner with architects, developers, DevOps engineers, and operations teams to maintain core services, resolve pipeline issues, and respond quickly to incidents.
  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Manage, optimize, and support AWS services, including EC2, SQS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Cognito, CloudFront, Fargate, ECS, and RDS.
* Use Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code practices to improve consistency, scalability, and reliability.
* Support daily infrastructure operations and escalate unresolved issues appropriately.
* Use DevOps tools such as Nexus, GitLab, Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Service Catalog to automate deployments, strengthen CI/CD pipelines, and manage infrastructure.
* Monitor system health with CloudWatch and related tools, responding quickly to incidents and alerts to support service continuity.
* Partner with development and operations teams to diagnose and resolve pipeline issues with minimal disruption.
* Apply security patches and updates to maintain a secure, compliant infrastructure environment.
* Administer PostgreSQL and MySQL databases to support data integrity, performance, and high availability.
* Configure and maintain Nginx and Asterisk PBX to support load balancing and reliable VoIP services.
* Use Linux systems administration and networking knowledge to troubleshoot and optimize infrastructure components.
* Write scripts in Bash, Python, or similar languages to automate routine tasks, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency.
* Maintain clear documentation for infrastructure configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.

**What You Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, B.E./B.Tech, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or similar role.
* Experience supporting a healthcare SaaS environment hosted on AWS preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect, Kubernetes certifications, Azure Administrator, RHCE, VCP, CCNP, MCSE, CompTIA Network+, or ITIL Foundation are a plus.
* Hands-on experience managing AWS and cloud infrastructure services, including EC2, Lambda, Route 53, VPC, SQS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Cognito, CloudFront, Fargate, ECS, and RDS.
* Strong knowledge of DevOps, automation, and infrastructure-as-code tools, including Nexus, GitLab, Jenkins, Git, Bitbucket, Terraform, Kubernetes, Service Catalog, Docker, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, and CloudFormation.
* Experience with incident management, pipeline issue resolution, patch management, logging, monitoring, alerting, and system performance troubleshooting.

**Mindsets That Matter:**
We’re always looking for ways to grow and take pride in what we do. You’ll thrive here if you:
  
  

* Act with purpose, focus, and accountability
* Collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
* Keep innovating and automate what slows you down

**Benefits Include (India):**

* INR 5,00,000 in life insurance coverage for all full-time employees and their immediate households.
* INR 15,00,000 in accident coverage.
* Education reimbursement.
* 10 national or state holidays, plus one floating holiday.
* Flexible hours and a hybrid work environment.

**Equal Opportunity at Relatient:**
We’re building a team as diverse as the communities we serve.
**Relatient**
is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need accommodation during the application process, just let us know.
  
  
To learn more about our organization, visit
**www.relatient.com**
**Ready to Join Relatient?**
If you’re looking for work that matters and a team that makes it count, we'd love to hear from you!

* Basic knowledge of networking
* Ability to read technical drawings and specifications

* Working knowledge of

We are looking for someone who is technically curious and interested in developing expertise across

**Job Summary**
The SSO & Access Management Senior Consultant is responsible for providing operational support, administration, and continuous improvement of enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role supports global IAM operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application onboarding, access governance, and platform optimization activities.
  
  
The consultant will work across industry-leading SSO technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and service management standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, and access-related issues.
* Monitor platform health, availability, integrations, and security events to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Manage incident, service request, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes and SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Support user lifecycle management activities, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access modifications, and entitlement management.
* Lead and support onboarding of enterprise applications to SSO platforms.
* Configure and troubleshoot SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and WS-Federation integrations.
* Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders during onboarding and enhancement activities.
* Manage certificates, metadata updates, federation configurations, and authentication policies.
* Support periodic access reviews, certification campaigns, and audit activities.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards, compliance requirements, and IAM best practices.
* Assist in implementation and maintenance of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and access governance processes.
* Maintain operational and technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Identify automation opportunities for repetitive operational tasks and reporting.
* Provide recommendations for improving authentication and access management processes.
* Collaborate closely with business application owners, security teams, infrastructure teams, and IAM stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior analysts and team members.
* Participate in governance meetings, operational reviews, and client/service management discussions.
* Prepare operational reports, dashboards, KPI metrics, SLA performance reports, and management updates.

**Preferred Skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in identity and access management, with a strong focus on Okta/Ping Federate or similar IAM platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of IAM principles, SSO, MFA, directory services, and cloud identity management.
* Proven track record of managing complex user provisioning and de-provisioning scenarios.
* Familiarity with IT security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong leadership abilities and experience mentoring junior staff.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with various stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, Okta Certified Professional) are highly desirable

* Willingness to participate in on-call support rotations.

**Senior Team Leader - Human Resources, India**

**Pune, India · Work from office · Leads a team of Junior HR Generalists**

**About CloudLex**

CloudLex is a leading cloud based legal technology platform for litigation firms in the United States. Headquartered in New York, with engineering, product, and marketing in Pune, India. Reaching 300 professionals globally. Backed by prestigious venture capital and growth private equity, including Aligned Capital, Rosepark Advisors, and The Riverside Company.

**We run two centers in India. The technology division is in Pune., MH. The services division is in Jabalpur, MP. This role covers both. ~100 in Pune and ~200 in Jabalpur.**

**Your Role**

**Run recruitment for both divisions**

* Plan roles and budget with the business leaders in tech and services dvision
* Manage the entirerecruitment process from sourcing to onboardig
* Run the offer stage: negotiate, issue the letter, start background verification, and close
* Manage recruitment consultants where you use them, including fees and quality

**Run campus recruitment for Pune and Jabalpur**

* Build and maintain the list of target institutes for both cities, with a named contact at each
* Call and visit placement officers, and build the relationship before you need the slot
* Negotiate placement dates and slots, and get on the calendar early enough to matter
* Organize pre-placement talks end to end, including panel, travel, material, and logistics
* Run the on-campus test and interview process on the day
* Run the internship program operationally, from intake through the pre-placement offer decision
* Organize hackathons and campus events, including budget, vendors, and the people who will attend

**Lead a team of HR Generalists**

* Set weekly priorities and run a weekly review on open positions
* Coach them on screening, on closing candidates, and on the conversations they find hard
* Review their work rather than assume it, especially on offer letters and candidate communication
* Spend time at Jabalpur Service Center in person on a regular basis, including short stints. The company pays for it

**Run the employee lifecycle**

* Run onboarding: documentation, induction schedule, asset and system access coordinated with IT, and a first week that is planned before the person arrives
* Run the appraisal cycle end to end: calendar, forms, manager chasing, normalization discussions, and letters out on schedule
* Handle resignations, run exit interviews, and coordinate full and final settlement
* Keep HRMS records, leave data, and personnel files accurate for both offices
* Coordinate statutory requirements such as provident fund and state insurance with the finance team

**On experience, read this carefully**

1. 5 to 8 years in HR
2. Of which at least 3 years must be spent directly managing a team, with people reporting to you and their performance your responsibility
3. Total years in the profession is not the measure. We will ask who reported to you, for how long, what you were accountable for, and what you did when one of them was not performing

**Must have**

* Hands-on recruitment ownership, not oversight of a process somebody else ran
* Campus recruitment you can evidence: institutes, programs, numbers
* Experience hiring for more than one kind of role. This job is technical hiring and operations hiring both
* Practical use of AI tools in your own work. Not awareness. Use
* Appraisal and lifecycle processes run end to end
* Experience managing people you do not sit with every day
* Working knowledge of an HRMS and of Indian statutory requirements
* Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to hold a position with senior leadership

**Compensation**

Fixed compensation of 9 LPA to 14 LPA depending on experience

Based in Pune, work from office

Reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer inthe interim. As we build the department we will seek senior leadership at director and vice president level

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.
* Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew — architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager.
* Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures.
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself.
* Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests.
* Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination.

**About Riveron**
At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.

title: Compressor Service Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Compressor Service Engineer**
**Objective**
: To perform efficient troubleshooting, maintenance, overhauling, testing, and commissioning of HVAC compressors, including screw, centrifugal, and magnetic bearing compressors, ensuring maximum equipment reliability, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality and safety standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities Compressor Overhauling & Repair
  
  
Establish and lead a world-class HVAC Compressor Overhaul & Service Center capable of independently handling Screw, Centrifugal, and Magnetic Bearing Compressors through development of overhaul processes, troubleshooting expertise, tools & test facilities, technical documentation, spare part management, and customer support, ensuring high equipment reliability, reduced turnaround time, and superior service quality.
  
  
Perform complete dismantling, inspection, overhauling, and assembly of: o Oil Flooded Screw Compressors o Centrifugal Compressors o Magnetic Bearing Oil-Free Compressors

Measure critical dimensions and clearances using precision instruments.
  
  
Prepare inspection reports with recommendations for component repair or replacement.
  
  
Execute compressor rebuilding as per OEM standards. Magnetic Bearing Compressor Expertise
  
  
Diagnose and troubleshoot magnetic bearing systems.
  
  
Understand operation of: o Active Magnetic Bearings (AMB) o Variable Speed Drives (VSD) o Position Sensors o Magnetic Bearing Controller Systems
  
  
Perform health checks and analysis of magnetic bearing compressor data logs.
  
  
Support commissioning and fault diagnosis of oil-free centrifugal chillers. Troubleshooting & Failure Analysis

Develop corrective and preventive action plans. Assembly, Testing & Commissioning
  
  
Precision assembly of compressor rotating components.
  
  
Rotor runout and clearance verification.
  
  
Alignment and balancing activities.
  
  
Witness and perform: o Leak Tests o Hydro Tests o Pneumatic Tests o Mechanical Run Tests o Performance Tests

Prepare service reports and customer recommendations.
  
  
Provide technical guidance to service technicians and customers. Required

Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
  
  
Minimum 7 ~9 years hands-on experience in HVAC compressor overhaul.

title: Senior Engineer-Water
description:

Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we deliver solutions that create a more connected and sustainable future. Here's what you'll need

* 8+ years of experience in water and wastewater conveyance planning, modelling, and design.

+ Water distribution networks

Armor is seeking an Incident Response and Security Operations Technical Leader to serve as the senior technical authority for our managed security practice in Pune. * Define and continuously evolve incident response methodology, detection strategies, and consultation frameworks across the practice.
* Lead strategic customer engagements requiring senior technical consultation on incident response, threat landscape, and security architecture.
* Actively lead the most complex and highest-impact projects to operationalize new customer-facing SOC capabilities; set delivery standards across the practice.
* Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for the most complex triage or incident investigations requiring advanced forensic analysis or threat research.
* Architect detection and response capabilities: SIEM optimization, SOAR workflow design, and threat detection use-case strategy.
* Build agentic AI capabilities to automate operations and drive the level of effort of the team towards supporting higher value customer engagement and decision making.
* Consult with customer executives on security strategy, risk posture, and program maturity.
* Evaluate and recommend, considering build vs. buy modalities, emerging technologies including AI/ML-assisted detection, automated response, and cloud-native security capabilities.
* Own the practice-level knowledge management strategy; ensure the SOC's collective knowledge is captured, current, and continuously enriched.
* Define cross-functional handoff standards and escalation protocols between the SOC and Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams.
* Mentor the entire security operations organization; technical talent development needs and build programs to address them at scale in cooperation with management.
* Champion professional development across the practice; define certification roadmaps and create continuing education structures for all tiers.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to align service capabilities with customer needs and market direction.
* Develop and deliver advanced training on analytical techniques, consultation skills, and emerging threats.
* Represent Armor's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and industry forums.
* Engage customers directly via video, phone, chat, and executive briefings; model the consultative standard for the entire team.

**Required Skills**

* Expert-level incident response expertise, including detection engineering and security architecture.
* Deep cloud security experience across Azure, AWS, and VMware, including cloud-native threat detection and response.
* Hands-on expertise with security platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, QRadar, and other enterprise security tools.
* Advanced threat hunting and forensic analysis skills with experience leading investigations into sophisticated cyber threats.
* Strong scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, and KQL) for automation, detection engineering, and security tooling.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with agentic AI tools (Claude, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent) and AI/ML integration within security operations.
* Experience with additional security technologies such as Microsoft Purview, F5 WAF, and ChaosSearch.
* Expertise in vulnerability management, control validation, security technology management, and policy management.
* Strategic vision for evolving a SOC from reactive incident response to a proactive security consultancy.
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong executive communication and customer consulting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication, including incident reports, presentations, and customer deliverables.

**Education And/Or Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in incident response, security consulting, or detection engineering with progressive technical leadership.
* Required certifications within 12 months: AZ-500, SC-200, SC-300, SC-401
* Certifications required: GCIH and GCFA, or equivalent.
* Certifications preferred: CISSP, GREM, GNFA, OSCP.
* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field required; Master's preferred; equivalent experience accepted.
* Sustained record of growing technical talent and advancing team capabilities through mentoring, training design, and continuing education.

title: Manager_Oracle Siebel CRM
description:
Who we are
  
  
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Siebel CRM application operations professional**
to manage the day-to-day operational health and technical support of Oracle Siebel CRM and associated platforms from
**SP Infocity, Pune**
.
  
  
This hands-on role focuses on service stability, SLA adherence, major incident and problem resolution, proactive monitoring, technical troubleshooting, automation, operational governance and continual service improvement. You will act as a technical escalation point for complex production issues and work across Siebel CRM, Oracle BSS and connected technology teams.
  
  
You should bring
**7–10 years of Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations experience**
, including at least
**5 years of hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience**
. Working knowledge of SRE practices, observability and automation is important for improving reliability, service performance and operational efficiency.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Application support and technical operations
  
  

* Manage day-to-day support and operational health of Oracle Siebel CRM services
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex incidents, service degradation and cross-system issues
* Coordinate P1/P2 incident triage, technical analysis, service restoration and timely stakeholder communication
* Perform detailed troubleshooting using Siebel logs, workflow and component analysis, Oracle SQL, Unix/Linux utilities and monitoring data
* Coordinate end-to-end diagnosis across FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, database, infrastructure and network teams

SLA, service management and governance
  
  

* Track adherence to agreed incident response, restoration and service request SLAs
* Review service KPIs including availability, SLA compliance, incident trends, MTTR, MTTD, backlog and recurring failures
* Support weekly and monthly service reviews with concise reporting covering operational performance, risks, actions and dependencies
* Keep operational controls, runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures and audit evidence current and ensure agreed processes are followed
* Support change and release governance through risk assessments, readiness checks, validation evidence and post-change monitoring

Problem management and continual improvement
  
  

* Lead technical investigations into recurring incidents and contribute to high-quality root cause analysis and preventive actions
* Maintain and prioritise a service-improvement backlog using incident trends, monitoring gaps and operational risks
* Identify opportunities to automate health checks, alert responses, reporting, housekeeping and repetitive support activities
* Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, dashboards and early detection to reduce customer impact and operational effort
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure and validate that improvements deliver sustainable results

Team and stakeholder coordination
  
  

* Provide technical guidance, work-allocation support and knowledge sharing for application support engineers
* Collaborate with Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners
* Escalate risks, capacity concerns, vendor dependencies and unresolved service issues through agreed governance channels

Who you are
  
  
Technical knowledge and experience
  
  

* You have 7–10 years' experience in Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations
* You have at least 5 years' hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience
* You have strong knowledge of Siebel CRM architecture, server components, configuration, Workflows, eScript, Business Services, EAI, Integration Objects, inbound/outbound web services and Open UI troubleshooting
* You understand Siebel administration, including component health, tasks, sessions, logs, parameters and environment checks
* You have strong Oracle SQL/PLSQL skills for data analysis, troubleshooting and performance investigation
* You can use Unix/Linux and Shell scripting for log analysis, health checks, housekeeping and operational automation
* You understand telecom order management, product catalogue, customer and service-request flows
* You can troubleshoot integrations involving FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic and downstream systems
* You have hands-on experience with one or more observability tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix
* You understand cloud, containers and Kubernetes/OKE operations, including pod health, logs, events, resource usage and restart validation
* You have awareness of CI/CD, configuration control and rollback principles in an application-operations environment
* You have experience supporting business-critical services and resolving complex production incidents within SLA

Service management and collaboration
  
  

* You understand Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Request management
* You have working knowledge of the ITIL framework and production-operations controls
* You have experience with SLA/KPI tracking, service reporting and operational governance
* You can contribute to effective RCA, risk management and continual service improvement
* You can coordinate effectively with stakeholders, vendors and cross-functional teams
* You communicate technical and operational information clearly in writing and verbally
* Experience delivering measurable improvements through automation, monitoring or continual-service-improvement initiatives is important

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**

* ITIL Foundation certification
* Exposure to Kubernetes/OKE, cloud operations, DevOps/SRE practices and enterprise observability tools
* Experience with telecom order management and Oracle BSS integrations

Not a Perfect Fit?
  
  
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
The opportunity to work hands-on with business-critical
**Oracle Siebel CRM and Oracle BSS services**
.Exposure to complex, cross-platform telecom operations spanning FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, databases, infrastructure and networks.Opportunities to contribute to service reliability through
**SRE practices, observability, automation and continual service improvement**
.Experience influencing improvements measured through availability, SLA compliance, MTTR, MTTD, incident recurrence and change stability.Collaboration across Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Through the scope of this role, you will have opportunities to further develop:
  
  

* Advanced Siebel CRM production troubleshooting and service-stability practices
* Observability, monitoring and early-detection techniques across enterprise applications
* Operational automation using scripting, health checks and repeatable support procedures
* SRE and continual-service-improvement practices focused on reliability and reducing operational effort
* Kubernetes/OKE and cloud-operations knowledge, including pod health, logging, events and resource monitoring
* Cross-platform diagnosis across Oracle BSS and associated technologies
* Major incident coordination, problem management, RCA and operational governance

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.” #JDEnhancedByTARA

title: Data Service Excellence Specialist, IT
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
As part of our IT team, your expertise will help deliver reliable, customer-focused support for Edwards' global Data & Analytics platforms. We are seeking a Data Service Excellence Specialist to provide Level 3 support, access governance, incident resolution, user guidance, and operational coordination across Power BI, Qlik, Snowflake, and related services. This role is a hands-on escalation and resolution point that works directly with business users and partners with deeper platform and engineering specialists when a change to the underlying product or platform is required.
  
  
Shift Time - 3 PM IST to 12 AM IST
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Provide Level 3 functional and technical support for Data & Analytics platforms, including Power BI, Qlik, Snowflake, and related services, resolving complex incidents and requests within the role’s area of expertise.
* Investigate incidents and service requests by gathering evidence, reproducing issues, analyzing business impact, troubleshooting root causes, implementing appropriate resolutions, and documenting outcomes.
* Own access requests and provisioning activities while ensuring alignment with security, governance, compliance, and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Act as the escalation point for front-line and offshore support resources, validating prior troubleshooting, improving escalation quality, and engaging platform engineering or product teams only when deeper code, infrastructure, or design changes are required.
* Monitor, prioritize, and coordinate incident and request workloads through ServiceNow, Jira, and established service management practices, with clear communication through resolution.
* Serve as a liaison among business users, technical teams, and Pune-based or offshore support resources to maintain effective communication and dependable service delivery.
* Coordinate day-to-day operational activities across distributed support resources, including work prioritization, knowledge transfer, onboarding, and readiness for new or changing services.
* Create, maintain, and improve knowledge articles, FAQs, runbooks, support documentation, onboarding materials, and operational procedures.
* Coach support team members on troubleshooting methods, platform knowledge, service standards, and effective customer communication without direct people-management responsibility.
* Analyze recurring incidents and support trends, perform root cause reviews, and recommend or implement improvements that reduce repeat demand and improve the user experience.
* Support training and enablement for analytics users and new support team members across technical and non-technical audiences.

**What You Will Need (Required)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in data and analytics support, business systems analysis, application support, or a related role; or a Master's Degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience.
* Hands-on experience supporting analytics platforms, with Power BI experience required and experience with Qlik, Tableau, Snowflake, or comparable platforms strongly valued.
* Experience resolving escalated application or platform incidents beyond basic intake and routing, including root cause investigation, documented resolution, and effective engagement of engineering teams when needed.
* Familiarity with ITIL service management practices, including Incident, Request, and Problem Management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret incomplete or conflicting information.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical users and manage multiple priorities independently.
* Strong documentation, organization, time management, stakeholder management, and customer service skills.
* Experience coordinating work, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness across geographically distributed teams.
* Ability to facilitate onboarding, training, and knowledge-sharing activities.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

* Experience working in a global or matrixed environment and coordinating offshore or vendor-based support resources.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake roles and permissions and the ability to use simple SQL queries for investigation.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, GitLab, or comparable service management and version control tools.
* Understanding of data governance principles, analytics workflows, and access-control practices.
* Basic SQL or DAX knowledge, including simple queries, measures, or calculated columns.
* Experience developing runbooks, knowledge articles, support metrics, and service improvement plans.

**Additional Information**

* Works independently on Level 3 support activities with general supervision and applies judgment to select the appropriate resolution or escalation path based on technical findings and business impact.
* May provide functional guidance to lower-level or front-line support personnel while partnering with people managers or vendor leadership on formal people-management matters.
* Travel may be required up to 5%.

**Benefits And Equal Opportunity**
Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

title: Docebo Technical Support & Software Testing
description:
Unlock your potential with Dassault Systèmes, a global leader in Scientific Software Engineering as a
**Docebo Technical Support & Software Testing**
in Pune!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically inclined Technical Support & Software Testing professional to support our Docebo Learning Management System (LMS) projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing day-to-day technical support, troubleshooting user issues, assisting with LMS configurations, and performing software testing to ensure the platform operates smoothly and meets business requirements. The candidate should have good analytical and communication skills, an understanding of software testing processes, and an interest in learning and working with LMS platforms.
  
  
**Role Description & Responsibilities:**
**Docebo Technical Support**

* Provide first-level technical support for the Docebo LMS and related applications.
* Troubleshoot user, course, enrollment, access, notification, reporting, and configuration-related issues.
* Investigate reported issues and identify root causes.
* Coordinate with internal teams and technical teams to resolve complex issues.
* Maintain and update support tickets with accurate issue descriptions, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
* Assist with user administration, roles, permissions, course assignments, and other LMS configurations.
* Support LMS integrations and basic troubleshooting of data synchronization/API-related issues.
* Prepare a technical documentation where required.
* Basic Exposure to support tools for managing Incidents & requests and understanding of support processes and SLAs

**Software Testing**

* Perform functional and regression testing of LMS features, configurations, and enhancements.
* Understand business requirements and convert them into test scenarios and test cases.
* Execute test cases and document test results.
* Identify, reproduce, and report software defects with clear steps and supporting evidence.
* Perform retesting after defects are resolved.
* Conduct basic UAT support and coordinate with business users for issue validation.
* Verify UI, workflows, notifications, reports, user permissions, and integrations.
* Maintain testing documentation and defect-tracking records.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in technical support, software testing, application support, LMS support, or a similar role.
* Basic understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Experience creating and executing test cases and documenting defects.
* Good troubleshooting and analytical/problem-solving skills.
* Basic knowledge of SQL/database concepts is preferred.
* Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, HTTP requests, or system integrations is an advantage.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.

title: Senior Technical Support Consultant
description:
**About Armor Defense Inc**
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
  
  
Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
  
  
Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
  
  
**Summary**
The Technical Program Manager owns Armor’s problem-management program and the analytical work that drives down the volume of issues customers experience. This is a program and analysis role, not a day-to-day ticket-resolution role: rather than working individual customer tickets, the Technical Program Manager digs into the data behind them to find the systemic problems that generate recurring work, and drives those to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework. That work is grounded in understanding how data flows into Armor’s systems—the connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines behind platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender—so root causes and data-quality issues can be identified, not guessed. The role partners closely with Engineering, SRE, and support delivery teams and thinks in terms of measurable, repeatable outcomes rather than one-off fixes—an approach that matters deeply for a cybersecurity company where recurring problems carry real customer risk. Based in Pune, India, the role works primarily on India business hours and carries the flexibility to overlap with US Central hours as needed to collaborate with Armor’s Dallas-based Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams. It reports to and takes strategic direction from the Head of Global Support.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Analyze incident and ticket data to identify the systemic drivers of ticket volume, and target measurable reductions in recurring work and customer-impacting incidents.
* Investigate how data flows into Armor’s systems—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines from Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Qualys/VMDR, log/SIEM sources, and Azure and cloud telemetry—to surface data-quality issues and the root causes behind recurring problems.
* Work through ambiguity: develop hypotheses about recurring and systemic problems, validate root cause with data, and ensure problems are genuinely understood before solutions are pursued.
* Consolidate recurring incidents and service requests into managed problem records and drive them to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework—without taking over day-to-day ticket execution, which is owned by dedicated delivery teams.
* Build the queries, dashboards, and reports that surface trends and quantify customer and business impact (e.g., KQL over Sentinel/Defender, SQL, Power BI, and Jira reporting).
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major and recurring problems; document root causes, workarounds, and known errors so delivery teams resolve recurrences consistently.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams to land systemic fixes, and coordinate permanent fixes that require change through Armor’s change process.
* Define and report the metrics that matter—reduction in recurring customer-impacting incidents and ticket volume as the headline, with operational signals (recurring-problem count, MTTR, RCA compliance, and SLA adherence) as supporting measures.
* Run problem-review cadences, maintain and drive down a prioritized problem backlog, and track held known errors so workarounds do not quietly become permanent technical debt.
* Identify automation and process-improvement opportunities and program-manage their delivery to reduce manual, repetitive work.
* Maintain authoritative documentation and a known-error knowledge base in Confluence, and provide clear, executive-level status, risks, and escalations.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10-12 years of experience in technical program management, security or IT operations, data and analytics, or service/problem management; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional programs and drive outcomes across multiple teams without direct authority.
* Hands-on data analysis: able to query operational and security data using KQL (Microsoft Sentinel/Defender) and SQL, and to build reports and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Jira) that surface trends and quantify impact.
* Working understanding of data integrations—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines—and how security telemetry reaches a SIEM or analytics platform (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender).
* Solid grounding in problem management and root cause analysis, aligned to ITIL (Problem, Incident, and Service Management).
* Familiarity (conceptual, not hands-on delivery) with the security domains Armor operates: vulnerability management (Qualys/VMDR), endpoint and EDR (Microsoft Defender), and cloud and identity (Azure, Okta/Entra).
* Ability to read incident and ticket data and translate it into prioritized, measurable action.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management in English, including executive-level reporting and clear RCAs and resolution frameworks.
* Proficiency with Jira and Confluence.
* Strategic, systemic thinker with a bias for repeatable, automation-assisted solutions over one-off fixes.
* Self-directed, taking strategic direction and prioritization from the Head of Support.

****Alignment to Armor Core Values****

* COMMITMENT TO GROWTH
* INTEGRITY ALWAYS
* EMPATHY IN ACTION
* IMMEDIATE IMPACT
* FOLLOW-THROUGH

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Depth in KQL/Kusto, Power BI, or Power Automate, or exposure to data engineering and pipeline troubleshooting.
* Experience building or troubleshooting API-based integrations and data connectors.
* PMP, ITIL v4, or Microsoft security/Azure certifications.
* Experience in a cybersecurity or managed-security services (MSSP) environment.

description:

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a dedicated and knowledgeable Application Packaging Engineer to manage the end-to-end packaging, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise applications. **What You’ll Do**

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

* Exposure to large-scale global application deployment and lifecycle management environments
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams across engineering, security, testing, and operations
* Opportunities to contribute to automation and continuous improvement initiatives

title: UX Researcher (Behavioural, Anthropology, Ethanography) (GB03/04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

The User Researcher is responsible for generating deep, psychology-backed insights into user behavior, motivations, and decision-making within fintech and digital financial products. The role focuses on applying behavioral science, cognitive psychology, and quantitative/qualitative research methods to uncover latent user needs and translate them into actionable inputs for design, product, and business strategy. The role ensures user-centric, evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

**A - Minimum required Accountabilities for this role-**

* Conduct in-depth moderated and unmoderated user interviews using psychological frameworks (e.g., Prospect Theory, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & 2) to uncover latent motivations, emotional drivers, and behavioral barriers.
* Design, deploy, and analyze quantitative research studies (surveys, questionnaires, experiments) grounded in validated psychological models such as Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), Big Five Personality Traits, and Self-Determination Theory.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights by identifying underlying cognitive and behavioral patterns (e.g., loss aversion, anchoring bias, trust erosion).
* Translate research findings into structured outputs such as personas, mental models, journey maps, and behavioral frameworks that predict user behavior.
* Test UI/UX prototypes through usability and concept validation studies using tools like Figma, Maze, and UserTesting, leveraging models such as Fogg’s Behavior Model.
* Own end-to-end research execution including study design, participant recruitment, psychometric segmentation, data analysis, and insight storytelling.

**B - Additional Accountabilities pertaining to the role-**

* Partner closely with design, product, and business teams to convert behavioral insights into bias-aware recommendations, nudges, and experience improvements.
* Monitor fintech and behavioral science trends (e.g., hyperbolic discounting, decision fatigue) through diary studies, ethnographic research, and secondary analysis.
* Support business KPIs such as conversion, engagement, retention, and trust through evidence-backed research inputs.
* Contribute to the development of internal research standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Behavioral Research / Behavioral Insights / Consumer Behavior Research Profiles
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 2+ years of experience in Behavioral Research, Consumer Behavior Analysis, Behavioral Science, or Market Research, focusing on understanding user motivations, decision patterns, and digital behavior
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have hands-on experience conducting primary and secondary research, including qualitative and quantitative research methods such as interviews, ethnographic studies, surveys, behavioral experiments, and observational research
* Mandatory (Experience 3) : Experience analyzing user behavior patterns, engagement trends, and digital interaction journeys to generate insights that influence product design, feature development, or platform experience improvements
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have exposure to data analysis or data mining of user behavior datasets, combining research insights with behavioral data to identify patterns, anomalies, or opportunities for product innovation
* Mandatory (Skills 1): Strong understanding of Behavioral Science principles such as Cognitive Bias, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & System 2 Thinking, Decision Science, or Consumer Psychology
* Mandatory (Skills 2): Experience in testing concepts, prototypes, or product ideas through usability testing, concept validation, or behavioral experimentation to evaluate user response and product effectiveness
* Mandatory (Skills 3): Ability to synthesize research findings into actionable insights, hypotheses, and recommendations for Product, Design, or Business teams
* Mandatory (Skills 4): Basic understanding of UI/UX and digital product journeys, including how users interact with mobile apps or web platforms, though this is not a design role
* Candidates from institutes with strong behavioral research exposure are preferred
* Mandatory (Company): Candidates from B2C consumer product organizations where user behavior is closely tracked and analyzed, such as consumer tech, fintech, e-commerce, or digital platforms
* Mandatory (Note):This is not a pure UX Researcher or Data Analyst role. The client is looking for Design Thinking–oriented Behavioral Researchers who combine behavioral science, research methodologies, and behavioral data analysis to generate insights
* Preferred (Skills): Exposure to behavioral experimentation, usability testing, journey analysis, or consumer psychology frameworks used to improve digital product experience
* Preferred (Education): Background in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Ethnography, Cognitive Science, or related fields (BA/MA/MSc/BSc)
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years

Experience: 2–7 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  

Our people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

title: Quantitative UX Researcher (ContentSquare, Maze) (GB04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and conduct quantitative UX research studies to evaluate user behavior and product usability.
* Plan, execute, and analyze A/B tests and controlled experiments.
* Define research objectives, hypotheses, success metrics, and measurement frameworks.
* Analyze product metrics, user engagement, conversion funnels, retention, and feature adoption.
* Extract and analyze data using SQL and product analytics tools.

* Identify issues and propose process improvements to enhance planning efficiency and effectiveness.
* Build, maintain, and mentor Analysts and Associates, providing guidance, training, and project leadership to support team development and capability building.
* Participate in new business efforts as required.

**Required Qualifications**

* A full-time graduate degree
* 2-4 years of media planning or buying experience and an understanding of planning principles and media math
* Proven understanding of media planning and buying processes, including planning principles, media math, and cross-channel considerations
* Proven experience across digital media channels, including Display, Video, Native, and Social, with an understanding of how channels work together within an integrated plan
* Communication: Proven examples of strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly structure responses, present ideas logically, and contribute confidently to client-facing presentations, documentation, and plan updates
* Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to interpret client briefs and synthesize planning inputs such as competitive analysis, syndicated research, and campaign performance learnings to inform media recommendations
* Data & Metrics: Strong understanding of key channel proxy or direct performance metrics, including reach, frequency, grps, impressions, click-through rate (CTR), viewability, and video completion rate (VCR), and how they are used to evaluate and track campaign performance
* Documentation & Tools: High attention to detail with proficiency in Excel and planning documentation, as well as basic experience with media and research tools such as Mediatools, , Nielsen, MediaRadar, Comscore, and Prisma as house agency tools and systems like Omni.
* Project Execution: Proven ability to manage production timelines, coordinate creative handoffs, and support campaign launches while working across multiple internal teams
* Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Investment, Analytics, Ad Operations, and Billing teams to ensure smooth plan execution

title: UX Researcher (Behavioural, Anthropology, Ethanography) (GB03/04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

The User Researcher is responsible for generating deep, psychology-backed insights into user behavior, motivations, and decision-making within fintech and digital financial products. The role focuses on applying behavioral science, cognitive psychology, and quantitative/qualitative research methods to uncover latent user needs and translate them into actionable inputs for design, product, and business strategy. The role ensures user-centric, evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

**A - Minimum required Accountabilities for this role-**

* Conduct in-depth moderated and unmoderated user interviews using psychological frameworks (e.g., Prospect Theory, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & 2) to uncover latent motivations, emotional drivers, and behavioral barriers.
* Design, deploy, and analyze quantitative research studies (surveys, questionnaires, experiments) grounded in validated psychological models such as Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), Big Five Personality Traits, and Self-Determination Theory.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights by identifying underlying cognitive and behavioral patterns (e.g., loss aversion, anchoring bias, trust erosion).
* Translate research findings into structured outputs such as personas, mental models, journey maps, and behavioral frameworks that predict user behavior.
* Test UI/UX prototypes through usability and concept validation studies using tools like Figma, Maze, and UserTesting, leveraging models such as Fogg’s Behavior Model.
* Own end-to-end research execution including study design, participant recruitment, psychometric segmentation, data analysis, and insight storytelling.

**B - Additional Accountabilities pertaining to the role-**

* Partner closely with design, product, and business teams to convert behavioral insights into bias-aware recommendations, nudges, and experience improvements.
* Monitor fintech and behavioral science trends (e.g., hyperbolic discounting, decision fatigue) through diary studies, ethnographic research, and secondary analysis.
* Support business KPIs such as conversion, engagement, retention, and trust through evidence-backed research inputs.
* Contribute to the development of internal research standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Behavioral Research / Behavioral Insights / Consumer Behavior Research Profiles
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 2+ years of experience in Behavioral Research, Consumer Behavior Analysis, Behavioral Science, or Market Research, focusing on understanding user motivations, decision patterns, and digital behavior
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have hands-on experience conducting primary and secondary research, including qualitative and quantitative research methods such as interviews, ethnographic studies, surveys, behavioral experiments, and observational research
* Mandatory (Experience 3) : Experience analyzing user behavior patterns, engagement trends, and digital interaction journeys to generate insights that influence product design, feature development, or platform experience improvements
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have exposure to data analysis or data mining of user behavior datasets, combining research insights with behavioral data to identify patterns, anomalies, or opportunities for product innovation
* Mandatory (Skills 1): Strong understanding of Behavioral Science principles such as Cognitive Bias, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & System 2 Thinking, Decision Science, or Consumer Psychology
* Mandatory (Skills 2): Experience in testing concepts, prototypes, or product ideas through usability testing, concept validation, or behavioral experimentation to evaluate user response and product effectiveness
* Mandatory (Skills 3): Ability to synthesize research findings into actionable insights, hypotheses, and recommendations for Product, Design, or Business teams
* Mandatory (Skills 4): Basic understanding of UI/UX and digital product journeys, including how users interact with mobile apps or web platforms, though this is not a design role
* Candidates from institutes with strong behavioral research exposure are preferred
* Mandatory (Company): Candidates from B2C consumer product organizations where user behavior is closely tracked and analyzed, such as consumer tech, fintech, e-commerce, or digital platforms
* Mandatory (Note):This is not a pure UX Researcher or Data Analyst role. The client is looking for Design Thinking–oriented Behavioral Researchers who combine behavioral science, research methodologies, and behavioral data analysis to generate insights
* Preferred (Skills): Exposure to behavioral experimentation, usability testing, journey analysis, or consumer psychology frameworks used to improve digital product experience
* Preferred (Education): Background in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Ethnography, Cognitive Science, or related fields (BA/MA/MSc/BSc)
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years

Experience: 2–7 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  

Our people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.
  
  
**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:
  
  

* Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* Shipping code: AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content: AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* Code review: Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* Test coverage: AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* Competitive intelligence: AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*
**What You'll Own**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.
* Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Shipping code to production: you have the agency to ship code all the way to production, not just creating prototypes.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
* Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
* Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in product management, UX design, or a closely adjacent role, with a demonstrated track record of shipping products customers use.
* Demonstrated experience building and implementing Access Control systems at scale, including working with internal stakeholders to onboard new products.
* Ability to conduct and synthesize customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized roadmap decisions.
* Proactively identifies challenges and communicates issues early; strong written and verbal skills.
* Connects different functional areas and understands their interdependencies within the broader organization.
* Comfortable defining user experience flows and working within a design system.
* Proficient or actively developing proficiency in AI-native workflows.
* SaaS product experience required; B2G background welcome.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Linux Administrator
description:
**Job Title: Linux Administrator (AWS Cloud Migration)**

**Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Hybrid)**

**Shift Time: 2PM-11PM IST / 3PM-12AM IST**

**Key responsibilities**

**Discovery and planning**

* Inventory on-prem Linux servers (RHEL), applications, dependencies, storage and network flows using tools such as AWS Application Discovery Service or Migration Evaluator.
* Classify workloads by migration strategy (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire) and group them into migration waves.
* Define target-state designs: instance sizing, OS versions, EBS/EFS/FSx storage, VPC placement and security groups.

**Migration execution**

* Migrate servers with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), plus rsync, LVM snapshots or image-based methods where needed.
* Move file shares and data using AWS DataSync, Snowball or S3 transfer as appropriate.
* Upgrade or re-platform legacy OS versions (e.g., RHEL ) during migration.
* Plan and run cutovers, including DNS changes, rollback plans and post-migration validation with application owners.

**AWS Linux operations**

* Build, patch and maintain Linux on EC2 using AMIs, Systems Manager (Patch Manager, Session Manager, Run Command) and Auto Scaling.
* Manage users, sudo, SSH keys and directory integration (Active Directory / SSSD / AWS Managed Microsoft AD).
* Monitor health and performance with CloudWatch metrics, logs and alarms; tune kernel, memory, disk I/O and network settings.
* Set up backup and DR with AWS Backup, EBS snapshots and cross-region copies; test restores.

**Automation and infrastructure as code**

* Provision infrastructure with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Automate configuration and builds with Ansible, Bash and Python; build golden AMIs with EC2 Image Builder or Packer.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or CodePipeline) for infrastructure changes.

**Security and compliance**

* Apply CIS benchmarks and OS hardening; manage IAM roles and instance profiles on least privilege.
* Encrypt data at rest and in transit (KMS, TLS); manage secrets with Secrets Manager or Parameter Store.
* Support audits with evidence from CloudTrail, AWS Config, Security Hub and Inspector.

**Hypercare and handover**

* Provide post-cutover support, resolve incidents and drive root-cause analysis.
* Write runbooks, architecture diagrams and SOPs; hand over to steady-state operations teams.
* Track cost and right-size instances using Cost Explorer and Compute Optimizer.

**Required qualifications**

* 6+ years administering enterprise Linux (RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, Amazon Linux) in production.
* 2+ years hands-on with AWS: EC2, VPC, EBS, EFS, S3, IAM, Route 53, ELB, CloudWatch and Systems Manager.
* Completed at least one on-prem to AWS migration, including server rehost with AWS MGN or an equivalent tool.
* Strong troubleshooting across boot, kernel, filesystems (LVM, XFS, ext4), networking (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalld/iptables) and performance.
* Scripting in Bash and Python; configuration management with Ansible.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Working knowledge of VMware or other on-prem virtualization as a migration source.
* Experience with Git-based workflows and change management (ITIL, ServiceNow or Jira).

**Preferred qualifications**

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Solutions Architect – Associate (Professional level a plus).
* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Engineer (RHCE).
* Familiarity with the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and the Well-Architected Framework.
* Exposure to containers (Docker, Amazon ECS or EKS) and serverless services.
* Experience migrating databases or middleware hosted on Linux (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Tomcat, JBoss, Apache, NGINX).
* Hybrid connectivity: Site-to-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway.
* Background in regulated environments (financial services, SOX, PCI DSS).
* Deliver runbooks and a clean handover to operations.

title: Sr. Support Engineer, ERP
description:

**Company Description**
