**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
The Senior Support Engineer, ERP role is a cornerstone within our organization, focused on delivering exceptional technical support for QAD and Progress products. In this role, you will engage directly with customers and partners through various communication platforms, such as CRM, telephone, email and internet-based tools, to address complex technical issues and inquiries related to QAD applications and Progress databases.
  
  
As an ERP Support Engineer, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, ensuring seamless installations, upgrades, and configurations of QAD products. You will leverage your expertise to perform Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backups, and troubleshooting. This role also demands strict adherence to quality standards, processes, and tools established by the company, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality support.
  
  
Your responsibilities extend to managing highly complex and escalated cases, requiring innovative problem-solving and a deep understanding of QAD and Progress Products. You will play a pivotal role in creating and maintaining detailed documentation of issues and resolutions, which will serve as a foundation for developing training materials and reusable solutions. These resources will be shared globally to empower customers, partners, and internal teams with actionable knowledge.
  
  
Collaboration is a key component of this role, as you will work closely with team leads, peers, and cross-functional teams, including R&D and Product Management, to devise effective solutions and uphold superior support standards. Additionally, you will contribute to team growth by developing and sharing training content, focusing on complex case resolution and technical troubleshooting.
  
  
Given that our support organization operates 24/7, this position demands a flexible approach to scheduling. You will be expected to participate in shift rotations, along with weekend shifts and potential on-call coverage as required. These elements are vital to providing continuous support to our global customer base. Your willingness to adapt to these scheduling requirements is crucial for the role.
  
  
In a structured team environment, you will be encouraged to engage in continuous learning and regular practice of existing product knowledge. This is necessary to stay prepared for any new challenges that might arise. As a Sr. Functional Analyst, you have a unique opportunity to grow professionally while significantly contributing to the success of our clients and the organization
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technical Support and Troubleshooting:
* Provide comprehensive technical assistance for QAD products, including installations, configurations, upgrades, and administration tasks.
* Analyze and resolve technical issues, applying advanced troubleshooting skills and root cause analysis to deliver effective and timely resolutions.
* Handle complex and escalated cases that require innovative problem-solving, ensuring adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Perform Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backup/restore operations, and monitoring database performance to prevent disruptions.
* Incident Handling:
* Manage incoming support requests through established ticketing systems and communication channels, ensuring accurate categorization and prioritization of issues.
* Escalate unresolved issues appropriately, collaborating with team leads and cross-functional departments to ensure timely resolutions.
* Proactively monitor incidents to identify recurring patterns, applying preventive measures to reduce repeat occurrences.
* Ensure that support incidents are resolved in line with established Service Level Agreements.
* Documentation and Knowledge Sharing:
* Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of all troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and best practices for every case handled.
* Contribute to the organization's knowledge base by documenting verified solutions, technical insights, and reusable resources.
* Develop comprehensive guides and FAQs to support customers, partners, and internal teams, ensuring quick access to relevant information.
* Customer Engagement and Communication:
* Communicate effectively with customers and partners to provide regular updates on issue resolution progress.
* Explain technical concepts in a clear and concise manner, ensuring that both technical and non-technical stakeholders understand the issue and the resolution.
* Foster trust and transparency with customers by maintaining a proactive approach and ensuring their concerns are addressed promptly.
* Collaboration and Teamwork:
* Work closely with team leads, peers, and cross-functional departments, such as R&D and Product Management, to resolve complex issues.
* Engage with engineering teams to facilitate effective knowledge transfer and gain insights into product updates that may impact support processes.
* Actively participate in team meetings to share knowledge, discuss challenges, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Training and Development:
* Assist in developing and delivering training materials and sessions to enhance the skills and technical knowledge of team members.
* Mentor junior team members, providing guidance on complex cases and fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
* Stay updated on the latest developments in QAD and Progress products, engaging in continuous learning to improve personal expertise.
* Shift Coverage and Flexibility:
* Participate in shift rotations, weekend shifts, and on-call coverage to provide uninterrupted global support.
* Adapt to varying scheduling requirements to ensure timely assistance for customers in different time zones.
* Any Other Duties as Assigned:
* Fulfill additional responsibilities as needed to support organizational goals and priorities, ensuring alignment with the overall mission of delivering high-quality support.

**Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.

**Experience**

* 3-4 years of relevant experience in supporting enterprise products, demonstrating expertise in resolving complex technical issues, and delivering exceptional customer-focused solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical skills and a proven ability to manage high-priority cases in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.
* Hands-on experience in ERP support is highly preferred, including:
* Installing, upgrading, and configuring ERP systems such as QAD, SAP, Oracle ERP, or Dynamics 365.
* Troubleshooting and resolving system-level issues, including performance optimization and configuration challenges.
* Performing advanced troubleshooting and database management tasks, including backups, restores, and optimization of Progress or similar DB environments.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting Unix, Windows, internet, and network environments.
* Programming knowledge in C, C++, Unix scripting, and Progress for issue resolution.
* Expertise in Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backup/restore, and performance monitoring.
* Strong Linux skills and basic SQL knowledge for database queries and troubleshooting.
* Experience with QAD product installation, configuration, and administration.
* QAD PKS or other relevant industry certifications are a plus.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.

title: Production Support Systems Intern
description:
**About Vcheck**
Vcheck was founded in 2012 on the belief that the investigative rigor of a boutique firm could be brought to scale through technology. Today, we run more than 25,000 investigations a year across six continents, helping financial institutions, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies see clearly through complexity and make decisions with confidence. Based in New York, with team members in the US, Canada, Romania, and India, we have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 for five consecutive years and are backed by Sunstone Partners as we enter our next phase of growth.
  
  
We are building something different: a portfolio risk management platform that pairs the rigor of an investigative shop with the efficiency of a modern technology company. Our team brings together talent from tech and SaaS companies with people from compliance, law enforcement, journalism, and many other fields. Whatever path brought each of us here, what unites us is curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to getting it right.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Production Support Systems Intern supports the team that keeps our production systems stable and available. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will learn how incidents, monitoring alerts, and escalations are handled in a live environment—starting by observing and following runbooks, and gradually taking on more of the triage yourself. You will get hands-on exposure to our AWS-hosted Python/Django/FastAPI backend and React JS frontend, and learn to track incidents via JIRA Service Management while monitoring system health through Sentry and CloudWatch. This is a paid internship with a monthly stipend and structured mentorship, and it offers a clear path to a full-time Production Support Systems Engineer role.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Monitor Sentry and CloudWatch dashboards for errors and anomalies under the guidance of a senior engineer
* Perform first-level triage of alerts and follow documented runbooks for known issues
* Create and update JIRA Service Management tickets with clear, complete incident details
* Escalate issues to the on-call engineer or Tier 3 with accurate, well-structured summaries
* Prepare shift handoff reports and join the overlap with the wider team
* Read CloudWatch Logs to identify ECS task errors, AWS Batch job failures, and Lambda/API issues
* Assist with restarting failed ECS tasks and retrying Batch jobs, as directed by the senior engineer
* Run start-of-shift and end-of-shift environment health checks and confirm nightly batch jobs have completed
* Learn to tell frontend (React JS) issues from backend API failures using Sentry error traces
* Run basic PostgreSQL/RDS checks and flag slow queries or connection issues to the team
* Verify that nightly backup and data replication jobs completed, and report any failure promptly
* Observe and support scheduled maintenance and deployments, including post-deployment monitoring
* Write simple Python scripts to automate repetitive checks and parse logs
* Document incident summaries, resolution steps, and learnings; help update runbooks and SOPs in the knowledge base

We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
  
  

* We're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and driven to grow through ownership, attention to detail, and upstanding character. No prior production support experience is needed. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Foundational understanding of cloud concepts; exposure to AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch, RDS) through coursework, projects, or certifications is a plus
* Basic proficiency in Python for scripting and log parsing

* Awareness of Docker and containers is a plus; exposure to Django, FastAPI, or React JS is a plus

* Calm, methodical, and attentive to detail when things go wrong
* Strong written communication skills for incident notes and shift handoffs
* Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and ask for help or escalate when unsure
* Prior internship, academic project, or hands-on lab experience in IT support, DevOps, or NOC environments is a plus
* AWS Cloud Practitioner or ITIL Foundation certification (or willingness to pursue one) is a plus

****Why us?****
You Will Be Joining a Cutting-edge Company, Where You Will Tackle Complex Challenges And Work With The Very Best In The Industry. In Addition, We Offer

* Quarterly team events to keep us connected in a hybrid environment
* Playing a vital role in shaping our company's future

title: Execution systems-Snr Eng
description:
**Job Summary**

* Develop and optimize scalable data models within relational databases to ensure reliable storage retrieval and reporting of execution and process information for enterprise stakeholders
* Configure and maintain AVEVA PI Historian environments to capture high fidelity time series data from plant systems enabling advanced analysis of production performance and asset health
* Create and manage Azure DevOps pipelines that automate build test and deployment workflows for execution system components improving release reliability and reducing manual intervention
* Administer and enhance GITHUB based repositories by enforcing branching strategies and pull request practices that support clean version control and traceability of execution system code artifacts
* Collaborate with cross functional teams in a hybrid work model to translate manufacturing and supply chain requirements into detailed technical designs that support standardized and compliant execution processes
* Perform detailed root cause analysis of incidents in execution systems by reviewing logs data traces and configuration states and implement sustainable corrective actions to prevent recurrence
* Optimize query performance and database configurations in RDBMS platforms to support timely reporting dashboards and analytics that guide tactical and strategic decisions in operations
* Develop and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions for execution systems using PI data and database metrics to detect anomalies early and support proactive maintenance and operational continuity
* Document system architectures integration patterns and configuration standards for execution platforms so that support teams and stakeholders can clearly understand dependencies and maintenance procedures
* Coordinate and perform system upgrades patches and configuration changes during day shifts in a controlled manner to minimize disruption while keeping execution environments secure and current
* Support validation and testing activities by preparing test data executing test cases and confirming that execution systems meet functional performance and compliance expectations before release to production
* Provide guidance and mentoring to peers on best practices in Azure DevOps GITHUB RDBMS and AVEVA PI Historian so that the broader team can consistently deliver high quality execution solutions

**Qualifications**

* Apply advanced knowledge of Azure DevOps to define pipeline stages artifact management and environment strategies that align with execution system lifecycle needs and organizational governance
* Use deep experience in GITHUB and related workflows to maintain clean repositories code reviews and collaboration models that support stable development of execution system applications and services
* Leverage strong RDBMS expertise including schema design indexing and query tuning to ensure that execution data structures support reporting integration and long term maintainability
* Utilize extensive hands on proficiency with AVEVA PI Historian including tag configuration interface management and data compression settings to deliver reliable industrial data infrastructure
* Draw on practical exposure to manufacturing processes to design execution solutions that respect shop floor constraints production sequencing and quality considerations for real world plants
* Apply understanding of supply chain concepts such as demand planning inventory flows and logistics to shape execution data models and integrations that provide end to end visibility
* Operate effectively within a hybrid work model by using collaboration tools structured communication and disciplined documentation practices to maintain continuity between remote and onsite activities

title: Senior Lead - Observability – Dynatrace
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position : Senior Lead - Observability – Dynatrace
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled
**Senior Observability Engineer**
to support and enhance enterprise observability capabilities across infrastructure, applications, cloud, and business services. This is an
**individual contributor role**
focused on hands-on engineering, platform operations, monitoring standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across observability platforms including
**Dynatrace, Microsoft SCOM, ServiceNow ITOM & Event Management, and related monitoring integrations**
.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a key role in improving monitoring effectiveness, reducing alert noise, enhancing event correlation, enabling faster incident response, and supporting operational resilience through automation and observability best practices. The role requires strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, and the ability to work closely with platform, application, infrastructure, and operations teams to deliver reliable and scalable monitoring solutions.
  
  
This role builds on the observability focus outlined in the reference document, including enterprise visibility across applications, infrastructure, cloud, and business services through Dynatrace, ServiceNow ITOM Event Management, AI-driven observability, and automation-led efficiency improvements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement, maintain, and continuously improve enterprise observability capabilities across Dynatrace, SCOM, ServiceNow ITOM & Event Management, and supporting monitoring tools.
* Configure and support monitoring for infrastructure, applications, services, databases, middleware, cloud, and hybrid environments to ensure end-to-end visibility and operational stability.
* Develop, tune, and optimize monitoring alerts, dashboards, thresholds, synthetic checks, anomaly detection, and service-level views to improve signal quality and reduce false positives.
* Drive alert hygiene activities, including duplicate alert reduction, threshold tuning, suppression logic, event enrichment, and monitoring standardization across technology teams.
* Support integrations between observability platforms and ServiceNow Event Management, ensuring events are enriched, correlated, deduplicated, and routed effectively for incident response.
* Manage and enhance monitoring integrations from tools such as Dynatrace, SCOM, infrastructure monitoring sources, and application monitoring platforms into ServiceNow Event Management.
* Use Dynatrace capabilities such as service flow, distributed tracing, Davis AI, anomaly detection, problem correlation, dashboards, management zones, tags, and alerting profiles to improve root cause analysis and operational insights.
* Support Microsoft SCOM monitoring activities including management pack configuration, alert rule tuning, agent health checks, monitoring coverage, and operational troubleshooting.
* Build automation scripts and reusable solutions using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, YAML/JSON, CI/CD pipelines, and other automation frameworks to improve onboarding, monitoring configuration, health checks, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to observability-as-code practices by supporting standardized, repeatable, and automated monitoring onboarding patterns.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, cloud, and support teams to onboard new applications and services into enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Troubleshoot monitoring gaps, integration failures, agent issues, event flow problems, and alerting defects across observability systems.
* Support operational reporting and KPI tracking related to alert volume, noise reduction, MTTR improvement, event quality, monitoring coverage, and automation adoption.
* Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, configuration standards, troubleshooting guides, and onboarding procedures.
* Participate in incident reviews and problem management discussions to identify opportunities for monitoring improvement and proactive detection.
* Apply ITIL practices and event lifecycle management principles to improve incident quality, operational response, and service reliability.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years of overall IT experience, with strong hands-on experience in observability, monitoring, event management, infrastructure operations, application support, or platform engineering.
* Strong practical experience with Dynatrace including OneAgent, dashboards, alerts, management zones, synthetic monitoring, service flow, problem detection, tagging, and Davis AI capabilities.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft SCOM, including alert configuration, management packs, agent monitoring, rule tuning, infrastructure monitoring, and operational troubleshooting.
* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow Event Management / ITOM, including event ingestion, event rules, alert correlation, deduplication, enrichment, service mapping awareness, and incident integration.
* Experience integrating monitoring tools with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
* Good understanding of observability concepts including metrics, logs, traces, events, topology, service health, synthetic monitoring, and full-stack monitoring.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, shell scripting, or similar technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD tools, source control, configuration files, automation workflows, and infrastructure-as-code or observability-as-code practices.
* Familiarity with cloud and hybrid environments such as Azure, AWS, VMware, Windows, Linux, databases, middleware, and enterprise infrastructure platforms.
* Understanding of ITIL processes, especially Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Event Management, and operational support models.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify monitoring gaps, alert quality issues, and event flow problems.
* Ability to work independently as an individual contributor while collaborating effectively with engineering, operations, application, and support teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with OpenTelemetry, log analytics, AIOps, machine learning-based monitoring, predictive monitoring, or GenAI-assisted incident diagnosis.
* Exposure to enterprise observability platforms beyond Dynatrace and SCOM, such as Splunk, Elastic, Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or other monitoring ecosystems.
* Experience building dashboards, operational reports, executive metrics, and service health views.
* Knowledge of CMDB, service mapping, application dependency mapping, and event-to-CI relationships in ServiceNow.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise monitoring environments in financial services or regulated industries.
* Familiarity with Ansible, Terraform, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or other automation and DevOps tooling.
* Ability to contribute to monitoring governance, standards, best practices, and platform maturity improvements.

Certifications
  
  
**Preferred Certifications Include**

* Dynatrace Associate, Professional, or equivalent certification.
* Microsoft SCOM or Microsoft infrastructure/platform certifications.
* ServiceNow ITOM / Event Management certification.
* Microsoft Azure or AWS certification.
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.

Success Measures
  
  
**Role**
The individual in this role will be measured on the ability to deliver measurable improvements in observability maturity, monitoring quality, automation, and operational effectiveness. Key success measures include:
  
  

* Improved incident quality and faster triage through actionable alerts and contextual event information.
* Increased monitoring coverage across applications, infrastructure, and services.
* Faster and more consistent onboarding of applications into observability platforms.
* Increased use of automation for repeatable monitoring and operational tasks.
* Improved dashboard quality, service health visibility, and operational reporting.
* Stronger alignment with enterprise monitoring standards and ITIL event management practices.
* Reduction in duplicate, noisy, unactionable, or low-value alerts.
* Improved signal-to-noise ratio across monitoring platforms.
* Better event correlation and enrichment through ServiceNow Event Management.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**Position Summary**
**Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)**
**At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise - we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.**
**We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most, from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments.**
**But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.**
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation, from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation.**
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, Strategy & Transactions is your next move.**
**The Team**
Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
  
  
Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
  
  
We are looking for Consultants for our Enterprise and Growth Strategy practice, with relevant experience in Financial Services Industry (specifically, Investment Management).
  
  
**Work You Will Do**
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
  
  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop appropriate business models, operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues, determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches, evaluating, and validating analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Contribute to multiple work-threads of large, complex engagements, with high-quality deliverables
* Participate in the development and presentation of proposals for business development activities
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies

**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy – FSI – Investment Management**
In Deloitte, FSI consists of the following vertical / sectors:
  
  

* Investment Management (IM): Includes working with Active & Passive Asset Management, Wealth Managers, fintech firms and its associated global entities

**FSI Industry Experience**

* Hands-on experience of working in Corporate Strategy or consulting firm catering to leading FSI companies in one or more of the following domains –Asset Management, Wealth Management, etc. (minimum 1+ years of experience for Consultant level)
* Awareness of industry trends, challenges, technology adoption levels and solution landscape in at least one of the IM sub-sectors
* Understanding of any one of the areas across asset management and wealth management products or aspects or tools (e.g., Informatica, Alladin, Charles River Development, SimCorp) are a plus
* Certifications related to FSI sector (e.g., CFA, FRM) are also a plus

**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy**

* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends including the associated technology implications
* Demonstrate application of business acumen while leveraging information technology
* One life cycle project execution experience in recommending and/or implementing IT strategy and solutions for improving business outcomes
* Experience of being a Technology Product Owner and responsible for delivering product model and communicating the product needs with business partners
* Strong understanding of front to back architecture principles, technology stack, infrastructure with exposure to new age tools
* Exposure to working in non-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders
* Candidates are also required to have at least one full project experience in one or more of the following areas :
* IT Strategy & Alignment: Delivering IT Strategy, driven both from a top-down analysis starting with an articulated business strategy and a bottom-up technology capability analysis; Experience working on cost reduction techniques, portfolio modernization and delivery roadmap creation for FSI players
* Technology Operating Model Design: Assessment of current state operating model -its underlying processes, ability to identify pain points and process gaps; design of target state operating model and associated roadmap
* Enterprise Architecture: Experience of Enterprise Architecture capabilities such as Blueprinting, solution architecture, architecture assessment, planning and cost estimation. Knowledge of any of the major Enterprise Architecture Frameworks (preferred) E.g. TOGAF, FEA(F), and DoDAF
* IT Outsourcing: Experience working on IT Outsourcing model, vendor analysis and benchmarking, contract analysis and understanding of how IT resources create shareholder (business) value
* Enterprise Data Management & Governance: Strong understanding of data management process across the data lifecycle (MDM, ingestion, storage, transformation) with experience in evaluating the client's data landscape and architecture to identify opportunities for improvement. title: Travel Consultant
description:
About the Role

At
**Waari – Travel Uniquely Different**
, we believe luxury is not just about where you travel, but how you experience the world.

We are looking for a passionate, detail-oriented, and well-travelled
**Luxury Travel Consultant**
who can transform travel aspirations into extraordinary, tailor-made journeys. From handpicked luxury stays and private transfers to immersive cultural encounters and exclusive experiences, you will craft itineraries that reflect each traveller’s unique preferences, personality, and definition of luxury.

As the primary point of contact throughout the travel journey, you will combine destination expertise, creative itinerary design, and exceptional client service to deliver seamless, memorable experiences for discerning travellers.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Crafting Bespoke Luxury Experiences**

* Design highly personalised domestic and international itineraries tailored to clients’ interests, travel styles, budgets, and expectations.
* Curate premium and luxury experiences, including boutique and luxury hotels, private guided tours, exclusive excursions, fine dining, and unique local encounters.
* Develop in-depth knowledge of luxury destinations, emerging travel trends, exceptional properties, and offbeat experiences across Europe, the Americas, Asia, Africa, and beyond.
* Manage end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, luxury accommodation, private transfers, rail journeys, curated activities, and destination experiences.

**2. Luxury Sales & Client Relationship Management**

* Engage with discerning clients, understand their travel aspirations, and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through consultative selling.
* Recommend and upsell relevant premium services, room categories, exclusive experiences, private guides, and other value-added offerings.
* Build long-term relationships by understanding individual client preferences and delivering consistently personalised service.
* Drive repeat business, referrals, and revenue growth within the luxury FIT segment.

**3. Seamless Travel Operations**

* Ensure accuracy in bookings, travel documentation, confirmations, vouchers, visa information, and pre-departure communication.
* Coordinate effectively with international DMCs, hotels, airlines, and ground-handling partners to deliver seamless travel experiences.
* Provide timely on-tour assistance and resolve unexpected changes or travel disruptions with professionalism and composure.
* Maintain detailed client records, itinerary documentation, and sales pipelines using travel CRM systems.

**4. Destination Expertise & Continuous Learning**

* Stay updated on luxury travel trends, emerging destinations, premium hospitality offerings, and experiential travel.
* Build strong supplier relationships to access quality services, competitive commercial terms, and distinctive experiences.
* Continuously enhance destination knowledge to create itineraries that go beyond the conventional and deliver genuine value.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in tailor-made travel, luxury FIT, premium holiday planning, or customised international travel.
* Strong knowledge of international destinations, flight connectivity, seasonality, accommodation options, and ground logistics.
* A genuine appreciation for luxury hospitality, experiential travel, and personalised service.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to create compelling, well-presented itineraries.
* Strong sales, negotiation, client relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in travel CRM systems and itinerary planning tools.
* Exceptional attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple itineraries simultaneously.
* A customer-first mindset and the ability to remain calm and resourceful when plans change.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

Someone who understands that luxury is personal. You enjoy discovering extraordinary places, have an eye for detail, think creatively, and take pride in making complex travel arrangements feel effortless. You are equally comfortable building client relationships, designing imaginative itineraries, and ensuring every detail is executed flawlessly.

Why Join Waari?

Be part of a growing travel company with a 22-year legacy, a customer-first philosophy, and an ambition to redefine personalised travel. At Waari, you will have the opportunity to create meaningful journeys, work with distinctive global experiences, and help shape the future of bespoke luxury travel.

**If you believe exceptional journeys begin with exceptional people, we would love to hear from you.**

**📩 Apply now or share your profile with us.**

* **Waari – Travel Uniquely Different.**

Augle AI is a deep-tech startup founded by alumni from IIT Bombay, building AI & 3D Vision powered Robotics and Automation Systems for manufacturing companies. We are developing the next generation of manufacturing technology—flexible, intelligent, and adaptable to rapidly changing consumer demand.

Our solutions help manufacturers achieve new levels of efficiency by automating processes that were previously impossible with conventional technologies. We serve diverse industries including Automotive, Medical Devices, Renewables, Aerospace, Semiconductors, and Electronics.

title: Real Estate Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Mavericks Landmark is a growing real estate firm focused on delivering value-driven residential and commercial property solutions. The company operates in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area, working closely with clients to understand their preferences, budget, and long-term investment goals. Mavericks Landmark emphasizes transparent transactions, professional guidance, and strong market research to help clients make informed decisions. Team members are encouraged to build lasting client relationships and contribute to the company’s reputation for reliable and customer-centric service.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Real Estate Consultant role based in the Pune/Pimpri-Chinchwad area. The Real Estate Consultant will meet and engage with prospective clients, assess their needs, and present suitable property options from the company’s portfolio. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting property visits, explaining project features and pricing, guiding clients through legal and financial aspects, and supporting them through the entire transaction process. The Consultant will also contribute to client training and education on property investments, compliance, and documentation where needed.

* Strong knowledge of Real Estate and Real Property, including local market trends, property types, and regulatory considerations.
* Proven Sales skills, with experience in lead generation, client engagement, and closing transactions.
* Effective Negotiation abilities to facilitate fair and mutually beneficial deals between buyers, sellers, and other stakeholders.
* Experience in Training clients or team members on property-related processes, documentation, and best practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and long-term relationships.

* Basic understanding of financial concepts related to real estate, such as loans, EMIs, and investment returns.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Real Estate, or a related field is preferred, along with prior experience in real estate consulting or sales.

* Support month end close activities related to cash posting and reconciliations.
* Act as a Senior/Lead associate, mentoring and supporting junior team members.
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to knowledge sharing.
* Actively identify and propose process improvement ideas, focusing on automation, efficiency, accuracy, and turnaround time.
* Support system enhancements, transitions, and UAT activities related to cash application tools.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong experience in AR Cash Application.
* Hands on working knowledge of SAP and High Radius Cash App.
* In depth understanding of US payment methods: ACH, Checks, Wire Transfers, and Credit Cards.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure in a fast paced environment.
* High learning agility and adaptability.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (mandatory).

* US shifts / Night shifts – mandatory
* Flexibility to support peak volumes and month end close
* 2-3 years of experience in cash application/Accounts receivable

Bachelor’s degree
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Night shifts – mandatory
* Strong experience in AR Cash Application.
* Hands on working knowledge of SAP and High Radius Cash App.

In this role, you will handle installation, breakdown troubleshooting, and performance monitoring of deployed AMR platforms, working closely with internal technical teams and on-site operators.

title: Staff Financial Planning Analyst [T500-30312]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**About DIRECTV:**

Since our inception in 1994, DIRECTV has been part of millions of American households, delivering favorite shows, sports, and premium content anytime, anywhere. We believe media entertainment is meant to be enjoyed, so we continuously evolve to provide personalized, best-in-class options that exceed expectations. We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer.

**About DIRECTV India GCC:**

DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what’s next. It’s a high-impact, high-visibility environment built to deliver on business-critical priorities. Here, your work directly shapes entertainment technology that reaches millions, while you grow your career in one of the world’s most dynamic talent markets.

**Our Purpose:**

We’re here to reimagine what’s possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer’s needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day.

**Our Values and Culture:**

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate.

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we’re building a future better than yesterday – for our colleagues, our customers, and our company.

**Position Summary:**

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking a Staff Financial Planning Analyst to join our Financial Planning and Analysis organization. This role executes end-to-end planning cycles, develops financial models, analyzes performance drivers, and provides executive-ready commentary while partnering across the United States and India.

The ideal candidate combines strong financial planning and modeling capabilities, business-partnering experience across geographies, and a passion for improving decision-making through clear analysis and automation.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Financial Planning & Analysis:**

* Execute end-to-end planning, forecasting, and reporting cycles.
* Perform variance and driver analysis and prepare executive-ready commentary.
* Build and maintain advanced Excel financial models.
* Support operating expense and headcount governance.

**Business Partnership & Governance:**

* Partner with stakeholders across two geographies.
* Support technology cost management, including software, cloud, labor, capital, and operating expenses.
* Assist with cost allocation, intercompany, vendor, purchase-order, accrual, and multi-currency planning activities.

**Systems & Automation:**

* Use EPM and consolidation platforms to support planning and reporting.
* Apply Power BI, Tableau, Power Query, SQL, Alteryx, Python, VBA, RPA, or workflow automation where appropriate.
* Support accurate, controlled, and efficient finance processes

**Qualifications:**

**Required Experience:**

* 8-10 years of progressive financial planning, analysis, or related finance experience.
* Experience executing planning cycles, financial modeling, variance analysis, and executive reporting.
* Experience partnering across geographies and governing operating expense and headcount.
* Experience with an EPM platform such as Hyperion/PBCS, OneStream, Anaplan, or SAP BPC.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* End-to-End Planning Cycle Execution
* Variance and Driver Analysis
* Executive-Ready Commentary
* Advanced Excel Financial Modeling
* Cross-Geography Business Partnership
* Operating Expense and Headcount Governance
* EPM System Fluency

**Preferred Skills & Experience:**

* SAP or Oracle ERP and general-ledger structures
* Power BI, Tableau, Power Query, and SQL
* Alteryx, Python, VBA, RPA, or workflow automation
* GCC, captive, or shared-services finance experience
* Technology cost management
* Intercompany, cost recharge, and cost-allocation models
* Vendor, purchase-order, and accrual management
* INR-USD foreign-exchange planning exposure
* US GAAP and month-end close exposure
* SOX and internal-controls awareness
* CA, CMA, CPA, MBA in Finance, or CFA credential

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA (Finance), CA, CMA, CPA, or CFA preferred.

**Note:**
This position is based in Pune, and applications are currently being considered from candidates based in Pune.

**Talent Value Proposition statement:**

At DIRECTV India, we're building a culture with our people, not for them, grounded in the values of We Care, We Challenge, and We Deliver. We will focus on building a better future than yesterday for our colleagues, customers, and company. As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey.

Headquartered in El Segundo, California, DIRECTV has been a household name in sports and entertainment for 30 years. We've grown our global footprint with DIRECTV India, a capability center in Pune built to support our operations and speed up how we build new technology. Here, our teams work on the platforms and products that bring together satellite and streaming, so customers get their favorite content without the hassle of switching between apps or inputs. From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that.

DIRECTV is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business requirements, qualifications, merit, and performance, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics under applicable laws.

title: Executive Assistant to Managing Director

**Location**
: Pune

: Full-Time

: 8 - 12 Years

: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM

We are seeking an experienced, high-ownership, and strategically minded Executive Assistant to Managing Director (EA to MD) with 8 to 12 years of multi-functional experience. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner and force multiplier to senior leadership.

You will bridge strategy and execution across key business verticals—including Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Logistics, HR, and Customer Experience. Beyond executive operations, you will actively own and drive digital marketing strategies, content creation, brand positioning, and cross-functional growth projects.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

•
**Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy**

Lead and oversee digital marketing campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, SEO/SEM, and influencer networks to drive D2C customer acquisition and retain subscription users.

Partner with growth teams and agencies to optimize Performance Marketing spend, ROAS, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV).

Direct email marketing campaigns, WhatsApp Business automation, push notifications, and app-based loyalty/retention workflows.

•
**Content Writing & Strategic Communication**

Draft compelling copy for website, mobile app landing pages, product announcements, email newsletters, and promotional messaging.

Own corporate communications, founder branding content (LinkedIn posts, industry thought leadership, media releases), and internal newsletter communications.

Review, refine, and maintain brand voice across all digital touchpoints, customer communication channels, and packaging/collateral copy.

•
**Strategic Business Operations & Cross-Functional Governance**

Act as a key strategic liaison between the Founder/Leadership and department heads (Logistics, Sales, Warehouse, Finance, Marketing, HR) to align project deliverables and monitor operational workflows.

Track company-wide OKRs/KPIs, ensure accountability across business units, and follow up proactively on critical corporate initiatives and milestone deliverables.

Lead high-priority ad-hoc strategic projects, market expansion studies, product launch readiness reviews, and process optimization initiatives.

•
**Executive Decision Support & MIS Management**

Consolidate daily, weekly, and monthly operational, sales, and financial performance metrics into actionable business intelligence dashboards and MIS reports.

Prepare high-level strategic decks, investor presentations, board meeting materials, and executive summaries (PowerPoint/Excel).

Analyze operational bottlenecks, unit economics, and last-mile delivery efficiencies to recommend actionable business improvements.

•
**Leadership Enablement & Workflow Oversight**

Manage complex schedules, prioritize appointments, organize leadership calendar, and ensure smooth daily time management for senior leadership.

Lead executive and cross-departmental reviews, document Minutes of Meetings (MoM) with clear owners, and rigorously track actionable points to closure.

Oversee executive communications, confidential records management, and strategic correspondence.

**REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

• 8–12 years of progressive experience in Founder’s Office, Strategy & Operations, Brand/Digital Marketing, or Business Management roles. Prior experience in FMCG, Dairy, D2C, E-commerce, or Food & Beverage is strongly preferred.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Commerce, or Strategic Communications.

• Solid understanding of performance marketing channels, D2C sales funnels, SEO/SEM, content strategy, and digital consumer engagement.

• High proficiency in Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and MIS/data analytics frameworks.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to write compelling copy and interface smoothly with senior stakeholders.

• Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams, push projects across the finish line, and operate with high autonomy, confidentiality, and sound business judgment.

title: Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT TIC**

Till It Clicks Studio Pvt. Ltd. (TIC) is a marketing and creative agency based in Sahakarnagar, Pune. AI plays a growing role across TIC's delivery functions. Account Management is deliberately kept fully human, because we believe our clients deserve people-to-people interaction. AI supports the backend, but the face of TIC to every client will always be a person. 

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Account Management is the backbone of every client relationship at TIC. It sits between the client and the delivery team, and between what was promised and what gets delivered. Its job is to keep clients retained, happy and growing. This is not a communication-relay role. As an Account Manager, you will think like a marketer, act like an owner, and be accountable for the health of every account you handle. You will typically own four to six client accounts at a time and work closely with the Account Management Lead, the Studio Head and the delivery team. 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client management**

Take full ownership of all deliverables across your assigned accounts (typically four to six clients). Respond to client messages promptly and proactively, with clear timelines rather than vague assurances, so clients always feel valued and heard. 

Keep all client communication in writing. Document any verbal brief, revision or instruction, share it with the client for confirmation, and only then act on it. 

Take notes in every client meeting and share them with the client and the delivery team after every interaction. 

Plan as many client tasks as possible before the start of each month. Share the next day's tasks with the Studio Head by the previous evening, or by 10:00 AM the same day. 

Build personal relationships with clients, down to acknowledging birthdays and important moments.
**Reporting & strategy**

 

Daily/weekly: Update the task tracking document daily and track all deliverables against the committed scope every week. 

Monthly: Send each client a qualitative and quantitative report, built from insights gathered from the relevant delivery team members. Attend a relationship-building meeting with every client alongside the Account Management Lead. 

Quarterly: Plan each client's strategy for the next quarter well in advance. Once it is approved, get full clarity on the quarter's deliverables. 

Take part in strategy reviews at the start and end of every month, contributing as a thinking partner who understands the strategy behind each account, not just the tasks. 

Never commit a timeline to a client without first confirming it with the relevant delivery team member.
**Delivery & process**

Give the delivery team written briefs that are detailed and unambiguous, to avoid costly reworks. Make sure every deliverable is quality-checked before it reaches the client. 

Run all tasks, briefs and updates through TIC's project management tool.

**Sales & growth**

Actively look for upselling opportunities to grow the scope of every account. Upselling is a major KPI for this role. 

Support the sales team with proposals and pitches when needed, especially with account context and client knowledge. 

Track payments for each client and, working with the Accounts team, proactively follow up on delayed payments. 

**AI-first ways of working**

**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**
The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.
  
  
This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Requirements**

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.

Skill / Experience
  
  
**Minimum**

* Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.
* Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.
* Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.

At ReliaQuest, we do things differently. We do not limit your professional growth with outdated job titles and responsibilities. Why be just a “Security Analyst”, “Detection Developer”, or “Security Engineer” when you can be all three? As a GreyMatter Specialist, you will do all of that and more. This role is uniquely designed to combine skills of threat detection, engineering, and incident response. On our team, we give you the opportunity to make an impact starting
  
  
from day one.
  
  
In this role, you’ll develop a diverse skill set which normally takes years to learn—all within your first year. Our industry-leading security operations platform, GreyMatter and immersive training will afford you the tools, experience, and opportunities to grow your career. Whether you’re conducting advanced investigations, troubleshooting technical challenges or providing customer recommendations, you’ll be solving real-world challenges and driving impact daily for our enterprise customers.
  
  
As part of the ReliaQuest team, you will receive mentorship and hands-on experiences while working alongside world-class teammates who share a high-performance mindset. In this environment, your expertise will propel you years ahead of your peers limited to traditional SOC roles. If you are looking for the monotony of manually working security alerts, this job is not for you; but if you are ready to be challenged, we are ready to invest in you.
  
  
**The everyday hustle:**

* Be a trusted technical advisor, resolving customer challenges from start to finish.
* Provide analysis and recommendations to customers based on alert activity, response playbook availability, and investigations.
* Triage and fine-tune security alerts, Digital Risk Protection (DRP) alerts, and engineering health alerts to ensure optimal performance.
* Integrate and configure log sources for existing customers.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data parsing and ingestion to ensure smooth operations and data accuracy.
* Independently integrate and configure log sources, handling both administrative tasks and ad hoc requests to complete work efficiently.
* Deploy and fine-tune detection rules using GreyMatter Detect.
* Employ the Cyber Analysis Methodology to conduct investigations.
* Conduct advanced investigations, including Tier 3 incidents, ad-hoc threat hunts, and customer-requested analyses.
* Communicate effectively with customers regarding engineering and Incident Response (IR) escalations.
* Spend 75% of your day in front of the customer

**Do you have what it takes?**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field
* Understanding of cybersecurity and IT disciplines including networking, operating systems, authentication protocols, general enterprise network, architecture, and security incident response.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP Protocols, network analysis, and network/security applications
* Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems
* Ability to blend your technical and communication skills to advise the customer
* Must demonstrate great attitude, energy, and effort
* Must be adaptable, focused, accountable, and helpful
* Must demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills (English language)

**What makes you uncommon? (not required)**

* Certifications such as Network+, Security+, CySA+
* 1-3 years' experience as a Security/Network Administrator or equivalent knowledge
* Prior SIEM experience and/or administration
* Hands-on experience with parsing data, log formats, regular expressions
* Scripting experience (bash, PowerShell, python)
* Multiple OS experience (mac, windows)
* Knowledge of various security methodologies and processes, and technical security solutions (SIEM, IDS/IPS, Firewall Solutions, Offensive Security tools)

title: VP – Enterprise Systems Monitoring, Observability & Security Engineering
description:
VP – Enterprise Observability & Security Engineering (Splunk, Datadog)

**Work shift:**
US Eastern hours; approximately 6:30 PM–3:30 AM IST, with flexibility as specified

**Role focus:**
Enterprise monitoring, observability, SIEM, infrastructure engineering, automation and security detection

The opportunity

We are looking for a technically strong enterprise infrastructure leader to engineer and evolve the monitoring, observability and security capabilities that support a complex global technology environment.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure engineering, telemetry and performance monitoring, security detection, automation and platform architecture.

You will lead technical initiatives across enterprise monitoring and security technologies, improve the visibility and resilience of infrastructure and applications, evaluate emerging solutions, and help integrate threat detection and prevention into core enterprise platforms.

We are looking for someone who understands how these systems work under the hood—not just someone who manages monitoring tools or coordinates projects.

What you will own

**1. Enterprise monitoring and observability**

* Design, engineer, implement and support enterprise-scale monitoring, telemetry aggregation and performance-management platforms.
* Work with platforms such as Splunk, Google SecOps, Datadog and SCOM, as applicable to the environment.
* Develop effective monitoring, alerting and troubleshooting approaches across Windows, Linux/Unix, networks and enterprise infrastructure.
* Work with protocols and telemetry mechanisms such as SNMP, syslog, ICMP, WMI and Windows performance counters.

**2. Security detection and infrastructure defense**

* Help engineer and implement technologies that strengthen enterprise threat detection, prevention and response.
* Integrate security monitoring and detection practices into infrastructure platforms and business systems.
* Evaluate security technologies against current and emerging infrastructure risks.
* Contribute to the engineering of internet-facing infrastructure and security controls, including data loss prevention, DNS/DHCP and local/global load balancing.

**3. Infrastructure engineering and automation**

* Apply strong Windows, Linux/Unix, networking and TCP/IP knowledge to diagnose complex monitoring and infrastructure issues.
* Develop automation and integration solutions using Python, PowerShell, Shell, Perl, Java or equivalent scripting technologies.
* Improve platform reliability, operational consistency, monitoring coverage and repeatability.
* Assess new technologies and lead implementation of solutions that deliver measurable operational or security benefits.

**4. Technical strategy and delivery**

* Define technical roadmaps, architecture standards and implementation practices for enterprise monitoring and management capabilities.
* Lead concurrent engineering projects, including implementations requiring carefully planned production changes.
* Work closely with infrastructure, networking, security and application teams, senior stakeholders and technology vendors.
* Guide technical staff, mentor engineers and provide recommendations on platform architecture and strategic direction.

What we are looking for

* 8–12 years of relevant enterprise infrastructure, systems engineering, monitoring or security technology experience.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Windows and Linux/Unix administration.
* Practical experience designing, implementing or engineering enterprise monitoring and observability solutions.
* Experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk or Google SecOps and monitoring platforms such as Datadog or SCOM.
* Strong understanding of SNMP, syslog, ICMP, WMI, performance counters and infrastructure telemetry.
* Scripting and automation capability using Python, PowerShell, Shell, Perl, Java or comparable technologies.
* Solid networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP.
* Working knowledge of information security principles and infrastructure security technologies.
* Experience contributing to the design or implementation of DLP, DNS/DHCP, load balancing or internet-facing infrastructure.
* Ability to lead technical projects, influence architecture decisions and communicate with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Willingness to work the specified US Eastern-hours shift.

Additional experience that will strengthen your profile

* SIEM integration, log pipelines, security analytics and detection engineering.
* Large-scale monitoring architecture and cross-platform telemetry.
* Enterprise cloud and modern data-centre infrastructure.
* Infrastructure security design, policy implementation and production change management.
* Experience leading senior individual contributors and complex technical delivery.

Why consider this role?

* Influence enterprise monitoring, observability and security engineering across a global technology environment.
* Work across infrastructure, networks, monitoring and security rather than in a narrowly defined tool-support role.
* Lead strategic engineering initiatives and evaluate technologies with enterprise-wide impact.
* Combine technical problem-solving, architecture and team leadership.

**Interested?**
Apply with details of the monitoring/SIEM platforms you have engineered, the scale of the environments you have supported, your scripting experience and examples of security or infrastructure improvements you have delivered.

21 January 2027

**Department:**
ICT

**Location:**
Pune, IN

**Description**
The Systems Engineer is responsible for providing first-line (L1/L2) technical support to global employees across regions, ensuring a positive, responsive, and consistent support experience. This role focuses primarily on endpoint support using Jamf and Microsoft Intune, supported by Jira Service Management, with clear escalation paths to L2/L3 teams in India, UK, and EMEA.
  
  
The Systems Engineer provides advanced L1 support and acts as a shift-level anchor, supporting junior L1 engineers while maintaining strong hands-on support for global users.
  
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Global End-User Support (L1/L2)**

* Act as a point of contact for global IT support requests.
* Support laptops (macOS and Windows), mobile devices, standard applications and collaboration tools.
* Resolve issues independently where possible, and escalate complex issues through the defined L2 paths.
* Support users across multiple time zones according to the coverage schedule.

**Identity & Access Management**

* Manage users, groups, licences and access in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Microsoft 365.
* Handle joiner, mover and leaver processes and access requests.
* Administer SaaS platforms such as Atlassian (Jira, Confluence), Slack and Microsoft 365.

**Device Management – Jamf & Microsoft Intune**

* Manage Windows devices with Microsoft Intune and macOS devices with Jamf Pro covering enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, software deployment and updates.
* Troubleshoot enrolment, access, compliance and policy issues, following documented SOPs.
* Own the laptop lifecycle: setup, deployment, replacement, recovery and secure data handling.

**Network & Security Operations**

* Support corporate networking: LAN/Wi-Fi, firewalls, VPN, DNS and SSL certificates.
* Troubleshoot user connectivity and web-gateway issues.

**IT Service Management**

* Log, track and manage tickets in Jira Service Management / Freshworks.
* Ensure accurate categorisation, prioritisation and documentation of tickets, and meet SLA targets for response and resolution.
* Provide clear handover notes and troubleshooting details when escalating.
* Help improve ITSM workflows, including request, incident, change and problem management.

**Automation, Documentation & Service Quality**

* Automate routine admin work.
* Use and update knowledge base articles and SOPs in Confluence.
* Deliver a professional, empathetic and customer-focused support experience, keeping users informed on progress.
* Adhere to security, compliance and acceptable use policies.
* Identify recurring issues and suggest process or tooling improvements.
* Work with vendors and partners on implementations and escalations.

**What We’re Looking For:**
**Experience:**
5-7 years
  
  
**What we're looking for**
:

* Experience in IT help desk, desktop support or systems engineering.
* Good working knowledge of macOS and Windows operating systems.
* Hands-on experience with Jamf and/or Microsoft Intune.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 administration.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools, preferably Jira Service Management or Freshservice.
* Understanding of networking concepts (Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, firewalls and connectivity troubleshooting).
* Experience working with regional L2/L3 engineering teams.
* Clear communication and comfort supporting users across time zones.

**Interested?**
If this role sounds like a good fit for you, please click on the “Apply” button to submit your application.
  
  
To discover more about Gentrack and how we’re transforming energy and water utilities with innovative solutions, please visit our website and LinkedIn.

title: Infrastructure Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
Ensures availability and scalability of technology platforms in collaboration with internal and external teams to meet the current and future business needs in line with prescribed IT measures and ISAs adopted policies and procedures
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  
Provides technical expertise and guidance to IT Teams on technology platforms and delivers technology designs for IT projects assists in planning and implementing systems and platforms through participation in IT projects

Recommends implements reports corrective actions to maintain improve levels of service
  
  
Performs any other additional duties as directed by the line manager
  
  
**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
Bachelor Degree in IT Engineering Computer Science Information Technology
  
  
ITIL Certified
  
  
CCNP CCIE MCSE RHEL Certification
  
  
Fluent in English Language
  
  
Work Experience
  
  
Capable of conducting cost benefit analysis for IT investments
  
  
Cost oriented possesses effective problem solving and decision making skills
  
  
Employs technical expertise and interpersonal relations to execute new initiatives and achieve companys objectives
  
  
Demonstrates the ability to contribute and successfully deliver against business strategy and set KPIs

title: BI Platform Administrator (Tableau-Power BI)
description:
