title: Senior Cloud Operations Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Assent empowers manufacturers and distributors with the intelligence to build sustainable products, meet global compliance requirements and drive better business outcomes.
  
  
At the center of our offering is the Assent Network, the industry’s most complete Product Intelligence Network, bringing together trusted parts and supplier intelligence, advanced AI and deep regulatory expertise to help organizations identify risk, make informed decisions and stay ahead of evolving requirements.
  
  
Trusted by more than 1,000 customers worldwide, Assent helps organizations stay ahead of evolving regulations across areas including responsible sourcing, human rights due diligence, PFAS reporting, Digital Product Passports, and other emerging requirements. Our platform empowers manufacturers to navigate change with confidence while building stronger supplier relationships and driving measurable business value.
  
  
With more than 1000 team members across India, North America, Malaysia, the European Union, and Kenya, Assent brings together global expertise, diverse perspectives, and a shared commitment to innovation. Our hybrid work model enables teams to collaborate across regions while staying connected to the communities where they live and work. As a certified B Corporation, we meet rigorous standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability, reflecting our commitment to creating lasting value for our customers, our people, and the planet.
  
  
**People First. Technology Forward.**
Our commitment to People, Culture & Community (PCC) is rooted in building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team. We recruit and retain team members with a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, while fostering a culture of belonging where all Assentees are respected, supported, and empowered to contribute.
  
  
As we continue to embed AI into how we work, we do so thoughtfully, enhancing human potential, supporting better decision-making, and prioritizing appropriate oversight, privacy, and fairness.
  
  
At Assent, we value your privacy and are committed to maintaining transparency in how we handle your personal information. As part of our talent acquisition and management processes, we may use AI technologies to support activities such as resume screening, candidate communication, and talent analytics.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Senior Cloud Operations Specialist is a senior technical owner for the stability, security, governance, and resilience of Assent's enterprise AWS environment and SaaS production systems. The role combines hands-on cloud operations with solution architecture, technical leadership, and sound risk-based decision making across a large multi-account AWS estate.
  
  
Working within the SaaS Product Infrastructure group, this individual partners with Engineering, Product, Corporate Security, and IT to design and operate secure, highly available cloud services. The successful candidate works independently at a high level, turns business and technical requirements into practical solutions, and constructively challenges decisions that introduce unnecessary risk, operational burden, or architectural debt.
  
  
This role follows a strict code-first and least-privilege operating model. Infrastructure changes are codified, peer-reviewed, and delivered through approved pipelines. Privileged access is exceptional, time-bound, auditable, and used only when required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture Technical Leadership and Decision Making**

* Lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable AWS solutions from initial requirements through production operation.
* Translate business, security, compliance, and operational requirements into architecture decisions, implementation plans, and reusable platform patterns.
* Evaluate technical options and make clear, risk-based recommendations that balance security, reliability, maintainability, delivery speed, and cost.
* Question assumptions and respectfully challenge designs or delivery approaches that conflict with enterprise standards, least-privilege principles, reliability objectives, or long-term platform health.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, document key decisions and tradeoffs, and ensure operational readiness before production adoption.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point, lead complex infrastructure initiatives, and coach team members through design and operational decisions.

**AWS Platform Governance Identity and Privileged Access**

* Own and continuously improve Assent's AWS multi-account environment using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, organizational units, account lifecycle controls, guardrails, and Service Control Policies.
* Architect and operate AWS IAM Identity Center, IAM roles and policies, permission sets, trust relationships, permission boundaries, federation, and cross-account access patterns.
* Apply least privilege by default. Ensure elevated access is approved, time-bound where supported, protected by strong authentication, logged, regularly reviewed, and separated from day-to-day identities.
* Maintain controlled break-glass access and prevent shared credentials, unmanaged access paths, unnecessary standing privilege, and unreviewed administrative changes.
* Lead account provisioning, compliance assessments, access reviews, drift detection, and remediation across the AWS organization.
* Partner with Corporate Security on identity governance, audit readiness, cloud control design, and the implementation of enterprise security requirements.

**Enterprise AWS Networking**

* Design, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise AWS network architectures across accounts and regions, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, and shared network services.
* Own connectivity and traffic-flow patterns using services such as Transit Gateway, VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, API Gateway, and CloudFront.
* Design secure ingress, egress, segmentation, DNS, and service-to-service connectivity patterns using AWS Network Firewall, AWS WAF, VPC endpoints, flow logs, and centralized inspection where appropriate.
* Diagnose complex routing, name resolution, load-balancing, firewall, latency, and cross-account connectivity issues and drive permanent corrective action.
* Maintain current network diagrams, traffic-flow documentation, connectivity standards, and recovery procedures.

**Infrastructure as Code Automation and Delivery**

* Provision and govern AWS platform resources through Terraform using reusable modules, secure remote state, controlled workspaces, and maintainable multi-account patterns.
* Use GitHub Actions as the primary delivery mechanism for infrastructure and governance changes, with peer review, validation, security checks, approvals, and traceable deployment records.
* Uphold a no unmanaged changes standard. Use AWS console access only for approved operational needs, and codify or reconcile any necessary emergency change promptly.
* Build automation with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Lambda, Ansible, Semaphore, or similar tools to reduce manual effort, enforce consistency, and improve recovery time.
* Review infrastructure code and automation for security, reliability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.

**Cloud Operations Reliability and Incident Response**

* Operate and improve core AWS services across compute, containers, databases, storage, messaging, DNS, content delivery, security, and monitoring.
* Install, configure, secure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows workloads in cloud environments.
* Establish effective monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and automated remediation using CloudWatch, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, or comparable platforms.
* Lead or support high-severity incident response, communicate clearly under pressure, restore service safely, and coordinate across technical and business teams.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions address underlying technical and process failures rather than only immediate symptoms.
* Participate in the on-call rotation and planned off-hours work required to support production infrastructure.

**Security Compliance Resilience and Operational Ownership**

* Maintain enterprise standards for encryption, key management, audit logging, configuration compliance, vulnerability remediation, and evidence collection using services such as KMS, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
* Support internal and external audits and provide clear evidence of cloud controls, access governance, and operational processes.
* Design, implement, and test backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and multi-region resilience capabilities.
* Create and maintain accurate documentation for cloud architecture, governance controls, operational procedures, automation workflows, and support handoffs.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned platforms and initiatives, surface risks early, and follow decisions through implementation and operational acceptance.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Requirements**

* 7 or more years of relevant experience in cloud operations, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, including substantial hands-on responsibility for enterprise AWS environments.
* Proven long-term ownership of a multi-account AWS organization using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
* Deep experience with enterprise AWS governance, including organizational design, account provisioning, Service Control Policies, guardrails, configuration compliance, and drift remediation.
* Advanced knowledge of AWS identity and access management, including least privilege, privileged-access controls, federation, cross-account access, permission sets, IAM policies and roles, and emergency access practices.
* Strong AWS networking experience, including multi-account and multi-region network design, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, segmentation, and network security controls.
* Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, multi-account deployment patterns, secure remote state in Amazon S3, code review, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure deployment, policy enforcement, and operational automation.
* Demonstrated ability to architect solutions and carry them through implementation, validation, documentation, and production support.
* Sound judgment in ambiguous or high-pressure situations, with the confidence to challenge proposals, explain risk clearly, and make defensible technical decisions.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration in production cloud environments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, security stakeholders, leadership, and vendors.
* Ability to work independently as part of a globally distributed team and to participate in on-call and planned off-hours work.
* University degree, college diploma, or equivalent practical experience.
* AWS certification at the Associate level or higher, or equivalent demonstrated enterprise AWS expertise.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Account Factory for Terraform or Customizations for AWS Control Tower.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking Specialty, or Security Specialty certification.
* Experience with ECS or Fargate, EC2, RDS for PostgreSQL or SQL Server, S3, SQS, SNS, SES, Amazon MQ, API Gateway, CloudFront, and Route 53.
* Experience with enterprise configuration management and automation using Ansible, Semaphore, or comparable tooling.
* Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, Datadog, SolarWinds DPA, or comparable observability and performance platforms
* Familiarity with Auth0 or other enterprise identity providers.
* Experience designing and testing disaster recovery across AWS accounts and regions.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, regulated industries, or high-security cloud environments.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Assent**
**Wellness:**
We believe that you and your family’s well being is important. As a result, we offer vacation time that increases with tenure, comprehensive benefits packages (details vary by country), life leave days and more.
  
  
**Financial Benefits:**
It’s not all about the money – well, it’s a little about the money. We understand that financial health is important and we offer a competitive base salary, a corporate bonus program, retirement savings options and more.
  
  
**Life at Assent:**
There is purpose beyond your work. We provide our team members with flexible work options, volunteer days and opportunities to get involved in corporate giving initiatives.
  
  
**Lifelong Learning:**
At Assent, curiosity is not only valued but encouraged. You will receive professional development days that are available to you the day you start.
  
  
At Assent, we are committed to growing and sustaining an environment where our team members feel included, valued, and heard. Our diversity and equal opportunity practices are guided and championed by our Diversity and Inclusion Working Group and our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).
  
  
Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion includes recruiting and retaining team members from diverse backgrounds and experiences, and fostering a culture of belonging where all team members are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to business success.
  
  
If you require assistance or accommodation throughout any part of the interview and selection process, please contact talent@assent.com and we will be happy to help.
  
  
We use AI to support parts of our recruitment process, such as note-taking and initial shortlisting based on job-related qualifications. AI does not make hiring decisions. All candidates will speak with a real person, and final decisions are always made by our recruitment team.

title: ServiceNow - System Administrator
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**ServiceNow System Administrator**
**Experience:**
6+ Years |
**Certification:**
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  
  
**Role Summary**
The ServiceNow System Administrator will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, operational support, security, stability, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow platform. The role requires strong hands-on experience in platform administration, production troubleshooting, upgrades and patching, deployments, access management, integrations, and Automated Test Framework (ATF).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support ServiceNow Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments, ensuring platform stability and availability.
* Troubleshoot production incidents involving workflows, Business Rules, integrations, authentication, notifications, scheduled jobs, performance, and platform configuration.
* Plan and support ServiceNow releases, upgrades, patches, and hotfixes, including impact assessment, skipped-record review, regression validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
* Perform code migrations and deployments using Update Sets, Application Repository, and established release-management processes.
* Define, develop, maintain, and execute ATF test cases and suites for critical business processes, upgrades, patches, and releases.
* Monitor platform health, integrations, scheduled jobs, email processing, failed transactions, logs, and performance indicators, proactively addressing operational issues.
* Administer platform components including system properties, plugins, notifications, Flow Designer, Service Catalog, Import Sets, Transform Maps, and scheduled processes.
* Support integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Servers, SSO, and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
* Work closely with Engineering Leads, Developers, Architects, Security, Infrastructure, and ServiceNow Support on complex issues, platform improvements, and operational governance.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, primarily in platform administration and production support.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) required.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale, multi-environment ServiceNow implementations.
* Demonstrated experience managing production incidents, upgrades, patches, hotfixes, and deployments.
* Experience supporting key ServiceNow capabilities such as ITSM, CMDB, HAM/SAM, SecOps, HRSD, or SPM is preferred.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, SSO, MID Servers, Discovery, IntegrationHub, and privileged credential solutions such as CyberArk is desirable.
* Experience working within a highly governed or regulated enterprise environment is preferred.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Deputy Manager_ Weblogic,Oracle SQL
description:
Who we are
  
  
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced application operations professional to manage the day-to-day operational health, availability and performance of Oracle WebLogic-hosted Telecom Order Management services in Pune.
  
  
This hands-on role focuses on platform reliability, customer order-fulfilment integrity, SLA adherence, incident and problem resolution, observability, operational automation and continual service improvement. You will support reliable customer-order journeys across CRM, Order Management, middleware, provisioning and downstream systems.
  
  
You will also apply SRE, automation and responsible AI/AIOps practices to improve issue detection, diagnosis and recovery while maintaining appropriate human validation, access controls, traceability and rollback safeguards.
  
  
The role supports service governance and stakeholder coordination but does not own application development, deployment execution or L3 defect delivery.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* You have 6-8 years of Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise application-operations experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on production support involving Oracle WebLogic and Order Management or OSM platforms
* You have practical expertise in Oracle WebLogic Server administration and production support, including domains, clusters, managed servers, Node Manager, JVM, JDBC, JMS, threads and heap analysis
* You understand Telecom Order Management or Oracle OSM operations, including COM/SOM/TOM concepts, order orchestration, order states, fallout and recovery
* You understand order capture, decomposition, fulfilment, provisioning and service activation
* You have experience troubleshooting WebLogic and application logs, performance issues and production incidents
* You are proficient in Oracle SQL/PLSQL for operational analysis, reconciliation and controlled data validation
* You have Unix/Linux, Shell scripting and preferably WLST experience
* You can troubleshoot integrations across CRM, OMS/OSM, SOA/OSB/AIA, UIM, ASAP and downstream provisioning platforms
* You understand REST/SOAP services, XML/XQuery, queues, adapters and message-based interfaces
* You have hands-on experience with observability platforms such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix
* You understand Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request management, alongside ITIL practices and SLA/KPI management
* You have contributed to automation, observability or continual-improvement initiatives
* You can communicate clearly when coordinating technical activities, service restoration and operational governance
* Practical exposure to AIOps, anomaly detection, intelligent alert correlation, AI-assisted RCA or incident summarisation is beneficial
* ITIL Foundation certification and exposure to Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA, Oracle OSM, UIM, ASAP and SRE practices are preferred
* Experience supporting high-availability telecom order-fulfilment services is advantageous

Not a Perfect Fit?
  
  
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* The opportunity to work hands-on with business-critical, high-availability telecom Order Management services
* Exposure to complex customer-order journeys spanning CRM, middleware, Order Management, provisioning and activation platforms
* Opportunities to contribute to SRE-based reliability improvements, observability and operational automation
* Practical involvement in approved AI/AIOps use cases, including anomaly detection, incident summarisation, probable-cause analysis and order-fallout classification
* The opportunity to influence measurable improvements in service availability, MTTD, MTTR, order fulfilment and operational efficiency

**What Skills You Will Learn**
Building on your existing production-support expertise, the role provides opportunities to further develop:
  
  

* Advanced WebLogic and Telecom Order Management troubleshooting
* End-to-end analysis of integrated telecom order-fulfilment journeys
* Observability, event correlation and proactive service monitoring
* WLST, Shell and SQL/PLSQL-based operations automation
* SRE and continual service-improvement practices
* Responsible application of AI/AIOps within production operations
* Cross-functional incident coordination, RCA and service-governance capabilities

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Technology Operations Specialist, VP
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Technology Operations Specialist**
**Corporate Title: VP**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
You will be operating within the Production Support Services team of the TST domain, spanning SES, TAS and Trade Finance Lending within Corporate Bank Production Services. The role is focused on providing hands-on production support, troubleshooting and operational ownership for applications hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with strong emphasis on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), containerised workloads, PostgreSQL/Postgres-backed services and related cloud-native technologies. You will be expected to lead incident recovery, perform deep technical analysis across application, infrastructure, database and platform layers, improve observability, and drive automation to enhance service stability, resilience and operational efficiency.
  
  

* Lead technical and functional troubleshooting for production incidents, user requests and platform issues across GCP-hosted applications, including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM, networking, PostgreSQL/Postgres databases and database connectivity.
* Drive end-to-end incident recovery for P3H and above incidents by analysing logs, metrics, traces, deployment history, configuration changes, infrastructure events and application behaviour.
* Use GCP observability tools such as Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, dashboards, uptime checks and alert policies to identify root cause, reduce mean time to detect and improve service reliability.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, SRE, security and engineering teams to troubleshoot cloud networking, container runtime, IAM, quota, performance, scaling and availability issues.
* Drive automation, toil reduction, platform hygiene, monitoring improvements and operational controls for cloud-native applications and supporting infrastructure.
* Prepare and distribute clear incident communications, technical updates, recovery timelines and service restoration summaries for senior stakeholders.
* Participate in CAB, change validation and post-change support activities to assess operational risk, ensure rollback readiness and support safer change delivery.
* Collaborate with Global Incident Management, L2/L3 support, SRE and platform teams to orchestrate recovery of major incidents and implement preventive actions.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
  
  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide hands-on technical and functional production support for applications deployed on GCP and integrated enterprise platforms within the TST domain.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across cloud runtime, containers, application services, middleware, databases, network connectivity, IAM permissions, certificates, secrets and deployment pipelines.
* Analyse GCP logs, metrics and alerts using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, dashboards and log-based metrics to identify root cause and restore service quickly.
* Support containerised workloads running on GKE and Cloud Run, including pod/container restarts, scaling behaviour, node pressure, cluster events, health checks, readiness/liveness failures, resource saturation, ingress/service issues and deployment rollbacks.
* Troubleshoot PostgreSQL/Postgres production issues, including connection failures, query performance, locks, replication or failover symptoms, storage growth, backup/restore readiness and application-to-database connectivity.
* Build technical and functional subject matter expertise across supported applications, business flows, cloud architecture, service dependencies and infrastructure configuration.
* Identify proactive opportunities for automation, self-healing, alert rationalisation, toil reduction and improved operational resilience.
* Drive service requests and incidents to resolution within L2 scope, ensuring timely escalation to L3, SRE, infrastructure or vendor teams where deeper engineering intervention is required.
* Review monitoring coverage for critical services, SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, availability, latency, throughput, saturation and business-critical transaction flows.
* Maintain and continuously improve runbooks, KEDB articles, support procedures, troubleshooting guides and operational readiness documentation.
* Participate in BCP, DR, EDR, SSRTO and component failure tests for cloud and application services, validating recovery procedures and operational readiness.
* Understand data flow, request flow and service dependencies across cloud infrastructure to provide effective operational support during incidents and changes.
* Own managed risk, operational controls, production hygiene and continuous improvement initiatives for supported services.
* Mentor and coach global support team members on GCP troubleshooting, incident handling, observability and production support best practices.
* Apply an SRE mindset with practical understanding of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident learning and reliability improvement.

**Your Skills And Experience**
**Must Have**
: -
  
  

* 12+ years of IT experience in large corporate environments, with strong exposure to controlled production support environments, preferably within Financial Services Technology.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting production workloads on Google Cloud Platform, with deeper focus on GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, IAM, VPC networking, load balancers and service accounts.
* Proven ability to investigate incidents using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, dashboards, alerts, log-based metrics and application traces. Strong troubleshooting skills across application, infrastructure and platform layers, including container failures, scaling issues, latency, memory/CPU saturation, network connectivity, DNS, certificates, secrets, IAM permissions and deployment failures.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes concepts and GKE operations, including pods, deployments, services, ingress, node pools, namespaces, autoscaling, config maps, secrets, health checks, cluster events, workloads, logs and kubectl-based diagnostics.
* Working knowledge of cloud-native application architecture, microservices, REST APIs, service-to-service communication, event-driven flows and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of UNIX/Linux operating systems, shell commands, process analysis, file systems, logs, network utilities and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of scripting and automation using UNIX shell, Python, PowerShell, Perl or similar tools for diagnostics, reporting, remediation and toil reduction.
* Understanding of middleware and messaging platforms such as MQ, Kafka or similar, including operational troubleshooting of connectivity, message flow and performance issues.
* Understanding of web and application server environments such as Apache, Tomcat, WebLogic or equivalent cloud-hosted runtimes.
* Strong understanding of relational databases, especially PostgreSQL/Postgres and Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, including connectivity, query performance, locks, indexing concepts, backup/restore, storage growth, availability and operational troubleshooting.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as Geneos, AppDynamics, New Relic, Dynatrace, Grafana or equivalent, alongside GCP observability tools. Strong understanding of ITIL Service Management practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request and Major Incident Management.
* Experience in securities services, asset management or trade finance domains will be an advantage.
* Flexibility to support incident callouts after office hours and during weekends, including participation in rotational weekend cover.

**Nice to Have:**

* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with attention to detail.

+ Ability to work in virtual teams and in matrix structures.
+ Team management and program management skills

* ITIL / best practice service context. ITIL foundation is plus.
* Ticketing Tool experience – Service Desk, Service Now.
* Understanding of SRE concepts (SLA, SLO’s, SLI’s)
* Knowledge and development experience in Ansible automation.
* Working knowledge of one cloud platform (AWS or GCP).

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**About Us And Our Teams**
Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
  
  
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
  
  
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Lead Platform Engineer
  
  
Lead Platform Engineer (Database, Cloud & DevOps)
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible.
  
  
The Database & Platform Engineering team is responsible for building and operating secure, scalable, highly available, and automated database platforms that support Mastercard's mission-critical payment systems. We are seeking a Lead Platform Engineer to drive the engineering, automation, reliability, and operational excellence of Oracle and PostgreSQL platforms across on-premises and AWS cloud environments.
  
  
This role combines deep database expertise, cloud engineering, DevOps automation, and technical leadership to deliver resilient platforms that enable Mastercard's next generation of payment solutions.
  
  
Role
  
  
**As a Lead Platform Engineer, You Will:**
Lead the design, build, automation, and support of Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms.
  
  
Engineer highly available and resilient solutions using Oracle RAC, Data Guard, GoldenGate, PostgreSQL Replication, and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL.
  
  
Drive AWS cloud adoption and modernization initiatives across database and infrastructure platforms.
  
  
Develop Infrastructure-as-Code and automation solutions to improve provisioning, deployment, patching, monitoring, and recovery processes.
  
  
Implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines to accelerate delivery while maintaining security and compliance.
  
  
Partner with Software Engineering, SRE, Security, and Product teams to deliver reliable and scalable services.
  
  
Lead performance optimization, capacity planning, observability, disaster recovery, and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
Provide technical leadership during major incidents, root cause analysis, and platform improvement activities.
  
  
Mentor engineers and champion engineering best practices, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**All About You**
Extensive hands-on experience with Oracle Database administration and engineering, including RAC, ASM, RMAN, Data Guard, and GoldenGate.
  
  
Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, including performance tuning, replication, backup, recovery, and high availability.
  
  
Experience designing and supporting large-scale production platforms in AWS, including Aurora, RDS, EC2, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and S3.
  
  
Strong DevOps and automation experience using Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or similar technologies.
  
  
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Shell, Bash, or PowerShell.
  
  
Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions such as OEM, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or CloudWatch.
  
  
Strong understanding of database security, operational resilience, disaster recovery, and compliance requirements.
  
  
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience within financial services, payments, or other high-volume transaction processing environments.
  
  
Knowledge of Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, and cloud-native platform technologies.
  
  
Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and platform modernization initiatives.
  
  
AWS, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or related cloud certifications.
  
  
**Experience Driving Automation, Self-service Platforms, And AI-assisted Operational Capabilities.**
Corporate Security Responsibility
  
  
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Come With An Inherent Risk To The Organization. Every Person Working For Or On Behalf Of Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  
Abide by Mastercard security policies and practices.
  
  
Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information.
  
  
Report security incidents, vulnerabilities, or policy violations.
  
  
Complete all required security and compliance training.
  
  
This position offers the opportunity to shape the future of Mastercard's database and cloud platforms while driving innovation, automation, and operational excellence at global scale.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Enterprise Support Engineer (GOC) - THG India
description:
**About THG Ingenuity**
THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises:
  
  

* THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system.
* THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.
* THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce.
  
  
**Primary Job Role**
As a GOC Enterprise Support Engineer, you will play a critical role in maintaining the operational stability and efficiency of THG’s core systems. You will be responsible for managing major incidents, monitoring infrastructure, diagnosing issues, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations and rapid incident resolution.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Deliver exceptional technical support via chat, tickets, and calls, ensuring prompt resolution and a world-class customer experience.
* Monitor THG websites and infrastructure using dashboards, wall boards, and Teams channels to ensure optimal performance and availability.
* Respond to critical alerts and collaborate with technical teams to triage and restore service.
* Manage, coordinate, and communicate Major Incidents (MIs), including stakeholder updates and post-incident reviews.
* Support change coordination activities, including impact assessments, scheduling, and communication.
* Log and respond to internal and external customer queries across multiple channels.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of operational processes and documentation.
* Participate in continual service improvement (CSI) initiatives to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate within a 24/7 shift rotation to ensure consistent coverage and support.
* Meet SLAs and individual KPIs for incident resolution and service delivery.
* Identify and implement opportunities for process and service improvement.
* Actively contribute to team meetings and communications, fostering a collaborative and proactive culture.

**Additional**

* Demonstrate and advocate THG’s company values and behaviours.
* Support cross-functional teams in achieving company objectives.
* Adhere to company policies and undertake additional tasks as directed by the Team Lead.

**Success Factors**

* Maintain high-quality standards in technical support and incident handling.
* Apply technical expertise to achieve first-time resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Lead by example, demonstrating professionalism and integrity.

description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

 

For more information, visit


www.sonicwall.com

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

,


Facebook

, and


Instagram

.

 

CSE SRE – DBA Focus

**Job Description**

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer — setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead on call response and triage – help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
* Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership.
* Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
* Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms — metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing — to ensure full visibility into production systems.
* Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams.
* Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers.

* Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion.
* Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout.
* Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists.
* Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection.

**Required:**

* 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
* 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
* 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management.
* 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required.

description:

Lead Platform Engineer (SME Jfrog Artifactory)
  
  
DevOps & SRE Lead – JFrog Artifactory SME (12+ Years)
  
  
Mastercard
  
  
**Overview**
MSBX (Mastercard Secure Build Experience) is transforming how more than 11,000 software engineers build, test, and deliver software across Mastercard. Our mission is to provide a secure, resilient, and frictionless software delivery ecosystem, enabling engineers to focus on customer value rather than infrastructure complexity.
  
  
DevFlow is a cornerstone of this mission, modernizing Mastercard’s CI/CD ecosystem through secure, scalable, and cloud-ready engineering platforms. Artifactory is a critical part of this ecosystem, providing enterprise artifact management across on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments. DevFlow is built for enterprise scale, reliability, security, and developer trust.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of DevOps and SRE, providing technical ownership and operational excellence for the enterprise Artifactory platform across on-premises and cloud environments, including AWS and Azure.
  
  
The Role
  
  
As a Lead, you will provide technical leadership and end-to-end ownership of the JFrog Artifactory platform across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments, covering platform architecture, engineering, reliability, security, automation, upgrades, and lifecycle management.
  
  
You will act as a hands-on Artifactory platform leader, designing, engineering, and operating enterprise Artifactory services across on-premises and cloud environments. You will drive platform standards, automation, operational resilience, and developer experience while ensuring Artifactory remains secure, scalable, highly available, and easy to consume.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Platform & CI/CD Leadership
  
  

* Lead the design, delivery, and evolution of enterprise JFrog Artifactory capabilities across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments, with secondary responsibilities across SonarQube, Bitbucket, and broader CI/CD capabilities.
* Drive consistent adoption of artifact lifecycle, repository management, artifact promotion, and secure build practices across engineering teams.
* Treat Artifactory as a product, prioritizing developer experience, platform stability, security, scalability, and long-term sustainability.

DevOps & Automation
  
  

* Design and maintain Artifactory automation, integrations, shared pipeline components, templates, and automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Enable scalable and repeatable CI/CD execution using Artifactory across on-premises and cloud environments, including containerized and ephemeral build environments.

SRE & Operational Ownership
  
  

* Own the operational health of the Artifactory platform across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments, including:

○ Reliability, availability, and performance
  
  
○ Monitoring, alerting, and observability
  
  
○ Capacity, storage, and platform health
  
  
○ Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery readiness
  
  

* Partner on incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless postmortems, ensuring learnings are incorporated into platform improvements and automation.
* Drive platform upgrades, patching, lifecycle management, and operational automation to maintain security, reliability, and supportability.
* Improve monitoring and feedback loops so platform issues are identified early and resolved with minimal impact to engineering teams.
* Provide secondary operational support and engineering contribution across SonarQube, Bitbucket, and related CI/CD capabilities.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Lead pragmatic design and trade-off discussions across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments, balancing speed, reliability, security, scalability, and cost.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership for Artifactory architecture, integrations, automation, upgrades, and platform engineering, while contributing to SonarQube, Bitbucket, and broader CI/CD initiatives as needed.
* Contribute reusable patterns, automation, and engineering practices through platform communities and engineering guilds.
* Strong production ownership mindset, with hands-on experience operating Artifactory and Linux/Unix-based platforms.
* Experience improving platform reliability through monitoring, alerting, observability, resilience, capacity management, and automation.
* Experience establishing monitoring and observability for Artifactory across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Strong focus on availability, performance, storage health, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Experience supporting production incidents, root cause analysis, problem management, and continuous operational improvement.

Collaboration & Leadership
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of platform standards across diverse engineering teams.
* Strong mentoring skills, supporting the growth of junior and mid-level engineers.
* Clear and effective communicator, able to work closely with Product, Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Platform teams.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models, including planning, demos, and retrospectives.

**All About You**
Experience & Background
  
  

* 12+ years of professional engineering experience, with significant hands-on ownership of JFrog Artifactory and enterprise DevOps/platform engineering environments.
* Proven experience designing, building, operating, and upgrading enterprise Artifactory platforms across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Strong understanding of Artifactory architecture, repository management, storage, high availability, security, integrations, upgrades, and disaster recovery.
* Strong fundamentals in DevOps and SRE practices, with experience operating business-critical platforms at enterprise scale.
* Experience with SonarQube, Bitbucket, and broader CI/CD platforms is preferred as a secondary capability.

CI/CD & Tooling Expertise
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with JFrog Artifactory in large enterprise environments, with working knowledge of SonarQube and Bitbucket.
* Deep understanding of:

○ Artifact lifecycle management, repository management, and promotion models
  
  
○ Artifactory permissions, access controls, and security
  
  
○ Build governance and software supply-chain security
  
  
○ Artifactory integration with CI/CD pipelines and build tools
  
  

* Experience operating and integrating Artifactory across on-premises, AWS, and Azure environments.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including artifact and container-image management.
* Experience with one or more modern programming or scripting languages such as Java, Groovy, or Python for platform automation and integration.

Cloud & Modern Engineering Practices
  
  

* Hands-on experience working across AWS, Azure, and on-premises/hybrid environments, including access controls, identity, networking, storage, and automation relevant to Artifactory.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes and containerized or ephemeral execution models for CI/CD workloads.
* Experience supporting highly available and resilient enterprise platforms across hybrid infrastructure.
* Passion for simplifying systems, reducing operational overhead, and improving developer experience at enterprise scale.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Meet agreed service levels for GBS Finance LAO customers, ensuring timely and quality delivery based on customer requirements.
* Review Purchase Orders associated with invoices and validate goods receipts and service acceptances to ensure compliance with three-way matching / triple validation requirements.

**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced and passionate Cyber Security Trainer to deliver industry-oriented training in CEH, WAPT, SOC, and CHFI. The candidate should have strong technical expertise, practical lab experience, and the ability to train students and working professionals using real-world scenarios and hands-on exercises.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Deliver theoretical and practical training in CEH, WAPT, SOC, and CHFI.
  
  
Conduct hands-on sessions using industry-standard cybersecurity tools and lab environments.
  
  
Demonstrate ethical hacking techniques, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing methodologies.
  
  
Train students in Security Operations Center (SOC) processes, SIEM tools, threat detection, and incident response.
  
  
Teach digital forensics, evidence collection, malware analysis fundamentals, and cybercrime investigation techniques.
  
  
Develop training materials, practical assignments, projects, and lab exercises.
  
  
Conduct assessments, evaluate student performance, and provide technical guidance.
  
  
Prepare students for cybersecurity certifications, technical interviews, and industry requirements.
  
  
Stay updated with emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and security technologies.
  
  
**Technical Skills Required**

* CEH – Certified Ethical Hacker

Ethical hacking methodologies and penetration testing fundamentals
  
  
Network scanning, enumeration, and vulnerability assessment
  
  
Tools: Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark, Burp Suite
  
  
Web application and network security fundamentals
  
  

* WAPT – Web Application Penetration Testing

OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
  
  
SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, and authentication flaws
  
  
Manual and automated web application testing
  
  
Tools: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap
  
  
Vulnerability identification, exploitation in authorized labs, and report writing
  
  

* SOC – Security Operations Center

Security monitoring, threat detection, and incident response
  
  
SIEM tools such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, or QRadar
  
  
Log analysis, alert triage, and threat hunting
  
  
MITRE ATT&CK framework and security incident handling
  
  
Basic malware analysis and endpoint security monitoring
  
  

* CHFI – Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator

Digital forensics and cybercrime investigation
  
  
Disk, file system, and memory forensics fundamentals
  
  
Evidence acquisition, preservation, and chain of custody
  
  
Log analysis and forensic reporting
  
  
Tools such as Autopsy, FTK, and Wireshark
  
  
**Required Skills**
Strong hands-on knowledge of cybersecurity tools and technologies.
  
  
Excellent communication, presentation, and classroom management skills.
  
  
Ability to explain complex security concepts through practical demonstrations.
  
  
Experience in conducting lab sessions and real-world scenario-based exercises.
  
  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Relevant certifications such as CEH, CHFI, Security+, or other recognized cybersecurity credentials.
  
  
Experience in cybersecurity training, penetration testing, SOC operations, or digital forensics.
  
  
Practical experience with enterprise security tools and security lab environments.

**#FY27ReferralCampaign**

title: Powertrain & Motor Design Engineer
description:
**Company Description:**

We see ourselves as a bunch of crazy maniacs who refuse to understand "It Can Not Happen". People know us for building the most awesome e-bikes (electric bicycles) but, how we see it is "We believe we are changing the world, one e-bike at a time, and playing a part in bringing India to the Global map for EVs." The company aims to bring across top-quality eBikes which would currently cost way more in the Indian market at an affordable price utilizing its local sourcing and manufacturing capabilities.

Let's talk numbers We are currently the market leader in India across the e-bike category and are just on the verge of announcing our series C. Having grown from a team of 5 to 150+ across the globe, from a small garage to offices across 15 countries and clocking in INR 300+ Cr revenue in first three years of operations. We have raised a series B from global investors. We think this is a great start to our exciting journey.

We think this is a great start to our exciting journey.

Come, join us, help us transform the world, mobility, and have a blast while doing it! Think you are the right fit? Feel free to apply!

**Experience: 3–5 years**

**Department: New Product Development**

**Reports to: Product & Strategy Lead**

**Work Mode: On-site**

**About the Role:**

We are developing a new, compact electric mobility product from the ground up. As the Powertrain & Motor Design Engineer, you will own the drive system from the motor through to the final output. You will size the motor, define the gear reduction and design the supporting mechanical hardware. You will validate it through simulation and testing so the product is efficient, quiet, durable and lightweight.

This is an early-stage role with real ownership. You will work closely with the founder and have a direct say in how the product takes shape.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Derive powertrain requirements from product-level targets: load, gradient, target speed, range and operating modes.

• Calculate required motor torque, speed, power and thermal limits across the full duty cycle, including peak and continuous-load cases.

• Select or specify the motor (BLDC or similar). Define Kv, winding, pole/slot configuration and the operating point for peak efficiency.

• Design and size the gear reduction (planetary, spur or belt) for ratio, torque capacity, efficiency, backlash and noise.

• Design the output and mounting interfaces, accounting for loads, contact conditions, wear and durability.

• Create 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings of housings, gear trains, shafts, bearings and brackets, with GD&T and tolerance stack-ups.

• Run FEA (structural, fatigue, modal) and thermal simulation on critical components.

• Run electromagnetic and system-level simulation: efficiency maps, torque–speed curves, thermal rise and range estimation.

• Work with the electronics and firmware team on controller interface, sensor integration, current limits and regen behaviour.

• Design for manufacturing, assembly and cost, working with suppliers on prototypes and tooling.

• Plan and run bench and field tests (dyno, thermal, noise/vibration, ingress protection, durability) and feed results back into the design.

• Support regulatory and safety compliance for the product category.

• Work directly with the founder to turn product vision into engineering decisions.

**Required Qualifications:**

• B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics or Automotive Engineering.

• 3–5 years in powertrain, motor or drivetrain design, preferably in e-bikes, e-scooters, EV two-wheelers, micro mobility or small electric drives.

• Hands-on experience working on physical products and delivering projects end to end, from concept through prototype to production release.

• Strong grounding in motor sizing and vehicle dynamics, including road-load, gradeability and acceleration calculations.

• Proficiency in gear design and reduction-ratio selection, with knowledge of gear failure modes, bearing selection, shaft design and fits.

• Hands-on CAD in SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA or Fusion 360, including assemblies, GD&T and tolerance analysis.

• Simulation experience: FEA in ANSYS, Abaqus or SolidWorks Simulation, and motor/system modelling in MATLAB/Simulink, Motor-CAD, ANSYS Maxwell or similar.

• Understanding of BLDC/PMSM motors, FOC control basics, battery–motor–controller interaction and thermal management.

• Ability to read test data and turn it into design changes.

• Preferably currently working, or having worked, in the R&D department of a motor manufacturing, gear or powertrain company, developing and delivering projects.

• Candidates from BITS, IIT, MIT, VIT and COEP are warmly invited to apply.

• Immediate joiners and candidates serving their notice period will be given first preference.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

• Experience with compact geared motors, hub motors or mid-drives.

• Knowledge of NVH reduction in small geared motors.

• Familiarity with injection moulding, die-casting, CNC and sheet-metal design for cost-effective manufacture.

• Experience with IP-rated sealing, regen braking and freewheel/clutch mechanisms.

• Exposure to DFMEA, DVP&R and prototype-to-production handover.

**Key Skills:**

Motor sizing · Gear reduction design · Vehicle dynamics · 3D CAD and GD&T · FEA and thermal simulation ·

MATLAB/Simulink · BLDC/PMSM · NVH · DFM/DFA · Test and validation

**What We Offer:**

• Direct, close collaboration with the founder, with high visibility and influence on product decisions.

• Ownership of a core subsystem in a ground-up product development program.

• A hands-on prototyping environment where your work goes from simulation to a physical build quickly.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As an NHI Specialist, you will help organizations strengthen identity security for machines, services, applications, and AI agents across complex enterprise environments. In this role, you will design and implement controls for secrets, certificates, service accounts, and workload identities, applying the same governance and rigor used for human identities. The role combines privileged access management, cloud identity, and automation to reduce risk and improve resilience across modern platforms.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As an NHI Specialist on the Cyber & Strategic Risk team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Establishing continuous discovery processes for non-human identities, including service accounts, application credentials, tokens, certificates, and secrets across cloud, on-premises, CI/CD, and software-as-a-service environments
* Designing and managing secrets management, certificate lifecycle, and workload identity solutions using platforms such as CyberArk Conjur, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Secrets Manager, and cloud-native identity capabilities
* Architecting and enforcing identity and privileged access controls for service accounts, applications, automation identities, and AI agents, including least-privilege access, just-in-time access, ephemeral credentials, and auditability
* Developing automation using PowerShell, Python, Terraform, and application programming interfaces (APIs) to support provisioning, credential rotation, compliance reporting, and platform integrations
* Conducting risk assessments, driving remediation of non-human identity findings, onboarding platforms into governance frameworks, and documenting standards, architecture, and runbooks in collaboration with security, platform, and application teams

**The team**
Cyber & Strategic Risk
  
  
The cyber risk services—IAM practice helps organizations in designing, developing, and implementing industry-leading IAM solutions to protect their information and confidential data, as well as help them build their businesses and supporting technologies to be more secure, vigilant, and resilient. The cyber risk services—IAM team delivers service to clients through following key areas of IAM:
  
  

* Application Onboarding
* Lifecycle Manager
* Compliance Manager
* Password Management
* Automated Provisioning
* Roles Management
* ITSM tools Integration
* Advanced Authentication Methods
* Strategy and Road Map

Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
* Experience with secrets management platforms, including CyberArk Conjur, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, Amazon Web Services (AWS) Secrets Manager, or comparable cloud-native solutions
* Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM), including roles, policies, entitlements, and least-privilege enforcement
* Experience implementing just-in-time access and ephemeral credential or session models

* Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JSON Web Token (JWT)-based authentication, workload identity concepts, and automation using PowerShell, Python, APIs, or software development kits (SDKs)

The ability to effectively scale your interactions from highly technical I.T. staff to key stakeholders at the Executive level is a must. Flexibility in your current skill set and a demonstrable eagerness to learn new things are key criteria to any candidate for this position.

title: Lead - Claims
description:
**Lead - Claims**

**AArete is one-of-a-kind when it comes to consulting firm culture.**

We’re a global, innovative management and technology consulting firm with offices in the U.S. and India. Our name comes from the Greek word for excellence: “Areté.” And excellence is exactly what we strive for.

We’re celebrating our fourth year as one of Forbes’
*World’s Best Management Consulting Firms*
– and our success starts with our people. From robust career development planning to competitive life and wellness benefits, AArete’s “Culture of Care” takes a holistic approach to the employee experience.

AAretians (our team members) are leaders at every level. You are encouraged to unlock your full potential by directly contributing to our mission and prioritizing personal development and fulfillment.

**The Role**

As a Lead, you will work with US healthcare payer clients to identify opportunities that reduce medical and administrative costs, improve payment accuracy, and strengthen operational performance. You will help clients understand business issues, dig into the data, and develop recommendations that can be put into action. We are looking for someone who is comfortable going deep on unfamiliar payer topics, knows how to research quickly and thoughtfully, and can connect the dots across claims, operations, reimbursement, and client priorities.

**Work You’ll Do**

* Research payer topics, industry trends, regulations, operating models, and client-specific business issues.
* Review and analyze medical, eligibility, provider, pricing, reimbursement, and other healthcare data to find trends, issues, and opportunities.
* Use SQL and other tools to work through large datasets and evaluate utilization, cost drivers, reimbursement patterns, payment accuracy, and operational performance.
* Check data quality, test assumptions, document the logic behind the analysis, and make sure the work can stand up to client review.
* Develop recommendations, business cases, and implementation plans tied to cost savings, process improvement, medical cost management, and operational efficiency.
* Build practical points of view on payer topics such as claims, provider networks, reimbursement, payment integrity, utilization management, prior authorization, medical management and payer operations.
* Take loosely defined problems and turn them into a clear workplan by identifying the right questions, data sources, research sources, and decision points.
* Create presentations, summaries, dashboards, and reports that clearly explain what the analysis shows and what actions the client should consider.
* Lead workstreams, manage day-to-day analysis, and coordinate with client stakeholders, vendors, and internal AArete teams.
* Explain technical findings in plain business language during client meetings and internal working sessions.
* Identify related client needs and bring them to leadership when additional AArete support may be useful.
* Bring sound judgment, ownership, curiosity, and a hands-on problem-solving mindset to each engagement.

title: Sr./Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Design, develop, integrate, and debug embedded firmware for 32-bit ARM-based microcontrollers, including STM32 and NetX90.
* Develop embedded software using Embedded C/C++, with strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and real-time operating systems.
* Develop device drivers and low-level interfaces using I²C, SPI, UART, and other peripheral interfaces.
* Develop and integrate industrial communication protocols including PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link.
* Develop embedded web pages and user interfaces using JavaScript and HTML, including configuration and diagnostic features.
* Develop, maintain, and validate device configuration and integration files such as GSD/GSDML, EDS, and IODD for PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and IO-Link devices, supporting PLC configuration and fieldbus integration.
* Perform functional testing of fieldbus nodes using industrial PLCs such as Siemens, Rockwell, and similar platforms.
* Design and integrate REST APIs for device configuration, diagnostics, monitoring, and communication.
* Perform hands-on firmware debugging, optimization, integration, testing, and root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with hardware and system teams for board bring-up, product integration, and validation.
* Conduct code reviews and contribute to firmware architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and best practices.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to firmware engineers and support resolution of complex technical issues.
* Contribute to project planning, technical estimation, documentation, project metrics, and EIC-Pune initiatives.

**Who You Are:**
As a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer, you are a hands-on technical contributor with expertise in ARM/STM32, NetX90, Embedded C/C++, device drivers, and low-level interfaces (I²C, SPI, UART). You have strong knowledge of PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link, including fieldbus testing with Siemens/Rockwell PLCs. Experience in JavaScript, HTML, REST APIs, data structures, debugging, and firmware architecture, with the ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring. You are experienced in developing scalable, reliable, embedded software, collaborating across hardware and software teams to deliver robust and time-critical motion control solutions.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor of Engineering degree or equivalent in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, or related field.
* 8+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience, preferably in industrial automation, motion control, or connected products.
* Strong expertise in 32-bit ARM, STM32, NetX90, Embedded C/C++, data structures, algorithms, and firmware architecture.
* Hands-on experience in device driver development and low-level interfaces such as I²C, SPI, and UART.
* Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols: PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link, device configuration files like GSD, EDS, IODD etc.
* Experience with fieldbus functional testing using PLCs, such as Siemens and Rockwell.
* Hands-on experience in JavaScript, HTML, embedded web pages, and REST APIs.
* Experience with RTOS/non-RTOS development, debugging, unit/integration testing, and Git-based development.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with experience in board bring-up, hardware-software integration, and product validation.
* Ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring while remaining primarily hands-on as an individual contributor.
* Strong communication, collaboration, documentation, and problem-solving skills; experience working in a global engineering environment preferred.
* Good verbal English communication skills with a neutral accent and a strong commitment to company values, ethics, and continuous learning.
* Respect for company values and ethics, with a strong willingness to learn.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Familiarity with PLC-based system integration, fieldbus certification/testing, and industrial product development.
* Familiarity with Protocol pre-conformance test environment and process.
* Experience in industrial automation, factory automation, motion control, or process control systems.
