title: CAD Design Engineer, Mechanical & Code-First Reverse Engineering
description:
**Job Title:**
CAD Design Engineer, Mechanical & Code-First Reverse Engineering

**Location:**
Pune| Hyderabad | Gurugram |
Bengaluru (On-site)

**Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
4+ years

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced CAD professional with strong expertise in 3D modelling, part and assembly design, and technical drafting. In this role, you will create and refine high-quality CAD models and engineering drawings, develop robust design workflows, and collaborate with engineering teams to deliver accurate, manufacturable, and production-ready designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Create and review data grounded in real CAD and mechanical design practice, parts, assemblies, drawings, and the reasoning behind them.
* Reverse-engineer geometry: take an STL/mesh with no feature history and reconstruct the design intent as parametric, code-first CAD (build123d), inferring sketches, features, datums, patterns, and key dimensional relationships.
* Evaluate AI-generated design solutions, 3D models, feature trees, mating strategies, drawings, and pin down failure cases, edge cases, and quality gaps.
* Decompose complex modelling and verification tasks into structured, step-by-step workflows the model can learn from and be measured against.

**Domain Responsibilities**

* Build and assess parametric models, assemblies, and detailed2D drawings across machined, sheet-metal, cast/moulded, and weldment parts.
* Judge design intent, constraints, and robustness, modelling approach.
* Apply and check GD&T, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing across the full product design lifecycle (concept → detailing → design review → handoff).
* Validate code-first reconstructions against source geometry via deviation and dimensional-accuracy checks.

**Requirements**

***Must Have***

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/Ph.D in Mechanical Engineering (or closely related) from a Tier 1/Tier2 institute (IIT, NIT, BITS, IIIT, DTU/NSUT, or equivalent).
* 4+ years of hands-on CAD/mechanical design with breadth across multiple platforms (Autodesk Fusion, SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA, or Inventor), multiple part types, and the full design workflow.
* Strong command of parametric modelling, assembly design, engineering drawings, GD&T, and DFM.
* Working Python ability and genuine comfort with code-first CAD (build123d / Cad Query), or a clear track record of picking up scripting fast.

***Good to Have***

* Mesh processing (trimesh, Open3D, numpy-stl) and familiarity with OpenCascade/OCCT.
* Exposure to adjacent disciplines, surfacing, simulation-driven design, generative/topology optimization, or CAM handoff.
* PLM/PDM and configuration management.

**Interested candidates are required to complete the attached CAD assessment as part of the application process and submit @shilpa.srivastava@softage.net.**

Choose one of the three CAD projects and recreate the model from scratch using the reference image and STEP file as guidance. Match the shape, proportions, and key dimensions as accurately as possible, record your complete modelling session using OBS Studio, and submit the recording along with the final CAD files via a shared Google Drive folder.

Assessment Document: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ADwGVYovLVc\_mXi32Sbe-urXUWK-X-fb/view?usp=sharing

title: Executive Assistant
description:
**Role Overview**

TLH is seeking a highly organised, proactive, discreet, and commercially aware Executive Assistant (EA) to support the Chairman in managing their professional priorities, executive schedules, stakeholder relationships, and business commitments.

Given the diversified portfolio of businesses across multiple sectors and geographies, this role requires an individual who can operate confidently in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, manage competing priorities, and ensure seamless coordination between the leadership office, business heads, internal teams, and external stakeholders.

The EA will serve as a trusted partner to the Chairman, enabling them to focus on strategic decisions, business growth, key relationships, and long-term priorities. The position goes beyond diary management and administration; it requires strong judgement, ownership, anticipation, and the ability to drive timely execution of commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Executive Office & Calendar Management**

* Manage the Chairman’s calendar, appointments, meetings, travel schedules, and daily priorities.
* Plan and optimise schedules across business meetings, strategic discussions, personal commitments where required, and international engagements.
* Ensure meeting briefs, agendas, presentations, reports, and relevant background material are available in advance.
* Identify scheduling conflicts, anticipate requirements, and proactively recommend solutions.
* Maintain an effective system for reminders, follow-ups, deadlines, and priority management.

**B. Strategic Coordination & Business Follow-through**

* Coordinate with business heads, functional leaders, and senior management across the Group’s portfolio.
* Track key decisions, action items, commitments, and deliverables arising from meetings with the Chairman.
* Maintain a central action tracker and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely closure.
* Prepare concise management updates, briefing notes, dashboards, and meeting summaries.
* Flag delays, risks, unresolved issues, and matters requiring leadership intervention.
* Support the leadership team in coordinating strategic initiatives, special projects, business reviews, and cross-functional assignments.

**C. Stakeholder & Relationship Management**

* Act as a professional first point of contact for senior executives, business partners, investors, clients, vendors, consultants, and other important stakeholders.
* Manage communications and correspondence on behalf of the Chairman, ensuring appropriate tone, accuracy, and confidentiality.
* Coordinate meetings, introductions, business discussions, and follow-ups with internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain strong working relationships with key contacts while exercising discretion regarding access to the leadership team.
* Handle sensitive or high-priority communications with maturity and sound judgement.

**D. Meetings, Reviews & Governance Support**

* Organise leadership meetings, business reviews, internal discussions, and external engagements.
* Prepare agendas, collate inputs, document decisions, and circulate action points where appropriate.
* Coordinate periodic reviews with business leaders to monitor progress against agreed priorities.
* Maintain organised records of key decisions, presentations, correspondence, and executive documents.
* Liaise with finance, HR, legal, compliance, and other relevant functions for information and documentation required by the leadership office.
* Support the preparation and coordination of board or governance-related material when required, in consultation with the relevant teams.

**E. Travel & Executive Logistics**

* Plan domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodation, ground transportation, itineraries, and meeting schedules.
* Coordinate visa documentation, travel requirements, reservations, and last-minute changes.
* Ensure travel plans are efficient, well-documented, and aligned with business priorities.
* Manage logistics for conferences, business events, leadership engagements, and important visits.
* Provide timely updates and contingency arrangements when schedules change.

**F. Research, Briefing & Decision Support**

* Conduct preliminary research on companies, industries, prospective partners, clients, markets, and business opportunities.
* Prepare concise background notes and executive briefs before important meetings.
* Gather and consolidate information from business units to support management discussions.
* Assist in preparing presentations, reports, business correspondence, and executive communications.
* Distil complex information into clear, accurate, decision-ready summaries without substituting personal judgement for management decisions.

**G. Administrative & Personal Assistance**

* Manage expense documentation, reimbursements, invoices, and other executive office administration as assigned.
* Coordinate approved personal appointments and logistics where required by the Chairman.
* Ensure the executive office operates efficiently, with proper documentation, organisation, and timely communication.
* Handle confidential documents, correspondence, and information in accordance with internal protocols.

**H. Process Improvement & Executive Effectiveness**

* Establish practical systems for calendar management, task tracking, document management, and follow-ups.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and improve coordination between the leadership office and business units.
* Use digital productivity tools and AI-enabled solutions responsibly to improve efficiency.
* Maintain a high standard of responsiveness, accuracy, accountability, and professional conduct.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Ideally 5–10 years of experience in an Executive Assistant, Executive Office, Founder’s Office, CEO’s Office, or similar role.
* Prior experience supporting a Chairman or MD is strongly preferred.
* Experience in a diversified business group, multinational organisation, or entrepreneurial environment will be an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex schedules, senior stakeholder communication, executive meetings, travel, and multiple concurrent priorities.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, along with digital calendar, task-management, and collaboration tools.

**Core Competencies**

* **Discretion and integrity:**
  Demonstrates absolute professionalism when handling confidential business, financial, strategic, and personal information.
* **Anticipation and initiative:**
  Thinks ahead, identifies potential issues, and addresses requirements before they become urgent.
* **Ownership and accountability:**
  Follows through on commitments, takes responsibility for deliverables, and ensures tasks reach closure.
* **Communication and executive presence:**
  Communicates clearly, confidently, and professionally with stakeholders at all levels.
* **Organisation and prioritisation:**
  Manages competing demands effectively without losing sight of critical deadlines.
* **Judgement and problem-solving:**
  Understands when to act independently, when to seek clarification, and when to escalate an issue.
* **Adaptability:**
  Remains composed and effective in a dynamic environment where priorities can change at short notice.
* **Relationship management:**
  Builds trust with senior leaders, business heads, and external stakeholders while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
* **Attention to detail:**
  Ensures that schedules, documents, communications, and arrangements are accurate and complete.

**Personal Attributes**

* The ideal candidate will be mature, dependable, well-presented, highly organised, and comfortable working closely with senior leadership. They should combine the discipline of a strong administrator with the mindset of a business-oriented executive partner.
* The candidate must be comfortable handling sensitive matters, working with minimal supervision, engaging with senior stakeholders, and maintaining composure under pressure. A flexible approach to working hours may be required depending on business travel, international time zones, and leadership priorities.

The Workday Success Plans team works directly with customers through targeted micro-consulting engagements to help solve their business needs using the Workday application. Responsible for acting as a trusted Workday advisor, you will have the opportunity to assist customers with how-to questions, troubleshoot and guide customers through configuration, and provide feature demonstrations. As a Workday expert, customers will benefit from your knowledge as you share your experience, identify key considerations, and highlight standard methodologies.
  
  
Our team of professionals have a broad and deep understanding of Workday Financials & Adaptive Planning. In this position we are looking for expertise in the following:
  
  
Workforce Planning Expertise
  
  

* Strong understanding of Workday Security and Business Processes
* Experience with HR Concepts such as Supervisory Organizations, Position Changes, Headcount Forecasting
* Experience in headcount modeling and analysis

Workday Financial Planning Expertise
  
  

* Implementation experience with Workday Adaptive Planning

* Ability to develop complex reports and dashboards using Adaptive Planning

Data Management and Integration
  
  

* Experience with data integration between Workday Adaptive Planning and Workday HCM and/or other HCM systems.

Conducting research to ensure understanding of customer questions and related Workday concepts.
  
  
Delivering small scope consulting in response to customer requests; providing configuration guidance, demonstrations, considerations, tips & tricks.
  
  
Troubleshooting product configuration to resolve or provide optimal product configuration to meet customer business requirements.
  
  
Clearly and effectively communicating responses and value to customers.
  
  
Creating and delivering customer presentations on how to use Workday features to achieve business goals (Accelerator Webinars).
  
  
Providing one-on-one consulting guidance to accelerate customer feature adoption (Feature Accelerator).
  
  
Reviewing customer tenants to identify adoption opportunities (Feature Adoption Tenant Reviews).
  
  
Completing and maintaining product expertise and Workday Certification(s) along with familiarity with Workday roadmap.
  
  
Keeping up to date with industry practices and the ability to engage with our customers on those topics.
  
  
Helping drive the creation of new programs to drive customer feature adoption
  
  
In addition to delivering Workday Success Plans services, our Workday professionals will also deliver other services such as:
  
  
Perform configuration and business requirements reviews with a detailed deliverable calling out opportunities for optimization
  
  
Provide one-on-one customer configuration designs
  
  
Deployments including full deployment of Workday features
  
  
**About You**
2+ years of experience with Workday Adaptive Planning implementations
  
  
5 years of IT implementation experience
  
  
3+ years of software consulting experience
  
  
**Additional Qualifications:**
1+ years experience in Adaptive Integrations with external systems
  
  
Workday Adaptive Planning Certification is a huge plus
  
  
Ability to troubleshoot Adaptive Integrations to external systems
  
  
Ability to gain a thorough understanding of Workday concepts as new features are released
  
  
Ability to distill complex concepts into understandable presentations for our customers
  
  
Ability to multitask and work on multiple engagements and deliverables simultaneously
  
  
Strong critical thinking skills so as to understand complex, technical process issues and facilitate/influence decision making
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  
  
Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience required. Advanced degree preferred.
  
  
Travel may be up to 10%
  
  
**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. title: Payroll Analyst
description:
****Key Responsibilities:****

title: Bima Sakhi
description:
**Company Description**
The Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) is a government-owned life insurance corporation established in 1956 and headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra. It is one of the largest and most trusted life insurance providers in India, serving a broad customer base across urban and rural areas. LIC offers a comprehensive portfolio of products, including life and health insurance, pension plans, ULIPs, group schemes, and micro insurance. With an extensive network of branches and agents across India and overseas, LIC focuses on making insurance solutions accessible to diverse communities. The organization emphasizes financial security, customer service, and long-term career opportunities for its workforce.
  
**Role Description**
The Bima Sakhi role is a full-time hybrid position based in the Pune Division, with some flexibility for work-from-home activities. In this role, the Bima Sakhi supports policyholders and prospective customers by explaining insurance products, assisting with proposals, and guiding individuals through policy issuance and servicing. Day-to-day tasks include conducting outreach in local communities, providing basic financial literacy related to insurance, and helping customers understand benefits, premiums, and claims procedures. The Bima Sakhi maintains records of customer interactions, coordinates with LIC branch staff and development officers, and participates in local campaigns or awareness programs. The role requires regular field visits within assigned areas, along with periodic office-based or remote administrative work and training sessions.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to interact with diverse community members, explain insurance concepts clearly, and build trust.
* Customer service orientation with the ability to understand client needs, provide guidance, and support policyholders throughout their insurance journey.
* Basic financial awareness and willingness to learn about life insurance, health insurance, pension plans, and related LIC products.
* Ability to perform fieldwork in local communities, manage time effectively, and maintain accurate records of customer visits and follow-ups.
* Comfort with simple documentation and use of basic digital tools (such as mobile apps or messaging platforms) for communication and reporting.
* Minimum educational qualification as prescribed by LIC (typically completion of secondary or higher secondary education); higher education in commerce or related fields is an advantage.
* Proficiency in local language(s) of the Pune Division and working knowledge of English or Hindi for coordination with branch staff.
* Demonstrated reliability, ethical conduct, and commitment to promoting financial inclusion and protection for individuals and families.

title: Process Engineer
description:
**Senior Process Engineer – Industrial Water & Wastewater Treatment**

**Location: Pune**

**Experience: 6–20 Years**

**Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Tech. in Chemical Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Process Engineer to handle process engineering and design activities for industrial water and wastewater treatment projects. The role involves process calculations, engineering documentation, equipment sizing, vendor coordination, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project execution and timely delivery.

Candidates with hands-on experience in Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) or Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) recycle projects will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, review, and validate process engineering documents, including PFDs, P&IDs, equipment layouts, water balance, mass balance, and energy balance.
* Perform hydraulic calculations, line sizing, pressure-drop calculations, pump selection, and chemical consumption calculations.
* Prepare and review equipment datasheets, utility requirements, chemical requirements, electrical load lists, and control philosophies.
* Evaluate vendor offers, review technical specifications, and approve vendor engineering documents.
* Coordinate with proposal, design, drafting, procurement, project, civil, structural, instrumentation, and commissioning teams.
* Participate in FAT activities, 3D model reviews, HAZOP studies, and other technical reviews.
* Interact with clients to discuss technical requirements, resolve engineering queries, and obtain approvals for basic engineering documents.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, engineering standards, quality requirements, and project schedules.
* Support process engineering team management, technical problem-solving, and timely completion of engineering deliverables.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 6–20 years of relevant experience in process engineering for industrial water and wastewater treatment projects.
* Hands-on experience in ZLD or ETP recycle projects.
* Strong knowledge of PFDs, P&IDs, water and mass balances, hydraulic calculations, line sizing, and pump sizing.
* Experience in process equipment sizing, chemical requirements, and utility calculations.
* Exposure to project execution, vendor coordination, and cross-functional engineering activities.
* Experience with process design or calculation software; knowledge of membrane design software, Aspen, ChemCAD, or similar tools is an advantage.
* Good communication, problem-solving, coordination, and team management skills.

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across Workfront, Marketo, and the leads pipeline, performing root cause analysis and implementing fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Write clean, maintainable code and configurations following team standards for API design, data handling, error management, and security best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. title: GMS-Senior-SAP Security IAM
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**SAP Security, GRC Access Control and Identity Management Specialist**
**Professional Job Description For Modern SAP Landscapes**
Scope: SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BW and integrated SAP platforms
  
  
**Role Type**
: SAP Security, GRC, IDM and Access Governance
  
  
**Seniority :**
Senior Analyst / Consultant / Specialist / Lead, depending on experience
  
  
**Primary Focus**
: User access management, role lifecycle, GRC operations, IDM provisioning, risk ruleset management, audits and access reviews
  
  
**Landscape :**
SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC AC/PC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and related integrations
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SAP Security, GRC and Identity Access Management professional to manage end-to-end SAP user access, role design, identity lifecycle, access governance, emergency access, risk analysis, audits and security operations across a complex SAP landscape. The role will support SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC Access Control, SAP GRC Process Control, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, SAP Ariba, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and other integrated SAP applications.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for SAP user management, SAP role design and maintenance, GRC operations, access risk analysis, SAP Firefighter governance, user access review implementation, quarterly access reviews, risk ruleset management, SoD remediation support, country rollouts, SAP native security assessments and audit support. The role requires strong process discipline, documentation quality and audit-ready execution across run, change and project activities.
  
  
**Key Accountability Areas**
Area - Expected Ownership
  
  

* SAP User Access Management : Create, modify, maintain and revoke SAP user access using approved access request, provisioning and governance processes.
* SAP Role Management : Own role requirement gathering, role design, build, testing, transport, go-live and ongoing maintenance.
* SAP GRC Access Control : Administer GRC Access Control processes across ARA, EAM, ARM and access governance workflows.
* SAP GRC Process Control : Support quarterly CCM updates, control monitoring, exception validation and control evidence management.
* SAP IDM : Manage identity lifecycle workflows, provisioning, deprovisioning, reconciliation and connector issue resolution.
* Access Reviews and Audits : Implement and operate user access reviews, firefighter reviews, audit evidence packs and remediation tracking.
* Risk Ruleset Management : Design, maintain, test and govern SoD and critical access rulesets for SAP and integrated applications.
* SAP Native Security : Assess SAP authorization, user, privileged access, RFC, technical user and security configuration risks.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* SAP User Access Management

+ Manage SAP user ID creation, modification, lock, unlock, validity updates, role assignment, termination and periodic user maintenance across SAP systems.
+ Support access provisioning and deprovisioning through SAP IDM and SAP GRC Access Control workflows.
+ Handle access requests, emergency requests, weekend releases and production access support activities.
+ Ensure access is provisioned based on approved requests, business need, least privilege and segregation of duties requirements.
+ Maintain user master data, license-relevant user classifications, technical users, communication users and validity controls.

* SAP Role Management

+ Design, build, test and maintain SAP security roles for SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Fiori, BTP integrations and related SAP platforms.
+ Perform role requirement gathering with business process owners, functional teams, control owners and country rollout teams.
+ Translate business requirements into authorization concepts, role matrices, derived roles, composite roles and Fiori catalogs, groups, spaces or pages.
+ Own the role lifecycle from requirement gathering, design, build and unit testing through UAT, defect remediation, transport movement, go-live and hypercare.
+ Support role redesign, role cleanup, SoD reduction, access optimization and country-specific role rollout activities.

* SAP GRC Access Control Management

+ Administer SAP GRC Access Control modules including Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management and Business Role Management where applicable.
+ Configure and support GRC workflows, approval paths, request types, provisioning settings, connectors and access request exceptions.
+ Perform access risk analysis for users, roles, access requests and role changes.
+ Monitor and resolve GRC provisioning failures, workflow issues, connector errors and control exceptions.
+ Support integrated access governance across SAP S/4HANA, BW, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BTP and other connected applications.

* SAP GRC ARA and Risk Ruleset Management

+ Manage SAP GRC ARA risk analysis for users, roles, profiles, critical transactions and sensitive authorization combinations.
+ Design, update and maintain SAP risk rulesets including risks, functions, actions, permissions and mitigating controls.
+ Perform ruleset impact assessment, regression testing and approval tracking before production deployment.
+ Coordinate SoD risk remediation, mitigation control assignment and risk owner sign-off.
+ Maintain ruleset documentation, change history, test evidence and version control.

* SAP Firefighter and Emergency Access Management

+ Manage SAP Firefighter ID setup, owner assignment, controller assignment, reason codes and emergency access configuration.
+ Support emergency access request, approval, usage monitoring, log review and closure processes.
+ Perform SAP GRC Firefighter log reviews and coordinate timely controller review and sign-off.
+ Investigate unauthorized, excessive or inappropriate firefighter usage and track remediation actions.
+ Maintain audit-ready evidence for firefighter assignment, usage, review, exceptions and approvals.

* SAP User Access Review Implementation and Quarterly Reviews

+ Implement SAP user access review campaigns using SAP GRC or approved access certification tools.
+ Prepare user, role, critical access, SoD, privileged access and firefighter review datasets.
+ Coordinate quarterly access reviews with managers, role owners, process owners and control owners.
+ Track review completion, access retention, revocation, exceptions, remediation actions and management approvals.
+ Maintain complete evidence for internal audit, external audit and compliance reporting.

* SAP GRC Process Control and Quarterly CCM Updates

+ Support SAP GRC Process Control operations, control mapping, monitoring rules and issue tracking.
+ Perform quarterly Continuous Control Monitoring updates based on process, configuration, risk and control changes.
+ Maintain CCM business rules, monitoring schedules, exception logic and control owner assignments.
+ Coordinate with process owners to validate CCM exceptions, control failures and remediation actions.
+ Prepare control evidence, deficiency documentation and management reporting.

* SAP IDM and Identity Lifecycle Management

+ Manage identity lifecycle processes in SAP IDM including joiner, mover, leaver, role assignment, provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
+ Support integrations between SAP IDM, HR source systems, SAP GRC, SAP systems and downstream applications.
+ Maintain IDM workflows, connectors, provisioning rules, approval logic and reconciliation processes.
+ Troubleshoot provisioning failures, access synchronization issues and identity data inconsistencies.
+ Support future-state IAM planning involving SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP IAG or enterprise identity platforms where applicable.

* Country Rollouts and Release Support

+ Support SAP security activities for new country rollouts, company code rollouts, business process deployments and regional templates.
+ Gather local access requirements and align them with global role design, control standards and SoD requirements.
+ Prepare access matrices, role mapping, test scripts, cutover plans and go-live readiness evidence.
+ Support unit testing, UAT, defect resolution, transport movement, weekend release and hypercare activities.
+ Ensure country-specific access is secure, approved, tested and audit-ready before production use.

* SAP Native Security Assessment and Audit Support

+ Perform SAP native security assessments across S/4HANA, ECC, BW, GRC, Solution Manager, BTP-integrated applications and other SAP platforms.
+ Review SAP authorization objects, critical transactions, privileged users, RFC users, communication users, generic IDs and sensitive access.
+ Identify excessive access, weak role design, unused roles, shared IDs, control gaps and configuration weaknesses.
+ Support SAP internal audit, external audit, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
+ Prepare audit evidence packs, management responses, remediation plans and closure validation evidence.

**SAP Application Scope**

* SAP S/4HANA on RISE / Private Cloud Edition
* SAP GRC Access Control
* SAP GRC Process Control
* SAP IDM
* SAP BTP
* SAP Ariba
* SAP SuccessFactors
* SAP BW / BW4HANA
* SAP Fiori Launchpad
* SAP Solution Manager
* SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS / IPS, where applicable
* Integrated non-SAP systems connected to SAP access governance

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC Access Control and SAP user administration.
* Experience in SAP role design, role build, UAT support, transport movement and production deployment.
* Working knowledge of SAP GRC ARA, EAM, ARM and risk ruleset management.
* Experience with SAP Firefighter ID management, log review and emergency access governance.
* Experience implementing and operating SAP user access reviews and quarterly access certification processes.
* Experience with SAP IDM provisioning, workflows, connectors and identity lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA security, Fiori security, authorization objects and business role concepts.
* Understanding of SAP GRC Process Control and Continuous Control Monitoring.
* Experience supporting SAP internal audits, external audits, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, evidence management and issue resolution skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA on RISE or hybrid SAP cloud landscapes.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP security, role collections, identity provider integration and cloud authorization concepts.
* Experience with SAP Ariba and SAP SuccessFactors access governance.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services, IAS, IPS, SAP IAG or Microsoft Entra ID integration.
* Awareness of cross-application SoD risks across SAP and cloud applications.
* Experience in global SAP template rollouts and country-specific security deployments.
* Knowledge of SOX, ITGC, NIST, ISO 27001 or internal control frameworks.

title: Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security
description:
Job Title
  
  
Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security
  
  
**Job Description**
**Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security | Pune | Full-time**
Vanderlande is seeking a proactive and analytical Supplier Risk & Due Diligence Analyst (ESG & Cyber Security) to support the global Supplier Sustainability & Risk function within Procurement.
  
  
As part of Vanderlande’s global procurement organization, you will play a key role in assessing supplier risks and ensuring our supply base operates in line with sustainability, compliance, and cyber security expectations. You will contribute to a resilient, responsible, and future-proof supplier ecosystem by supporting supplier due diligence, ESG assessments, third-party cyber security reviews, and ongoing supplier risk monitoring.
  
  
Our global procurement organization enables projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks through the procurement of goods and services in a smart, cost-effective, sustainable, and secure way.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Supplier Risk & Due Diligence Analyst, you will support supplier qualification, onboarding, monitoring, reassessment, and remediation activities across multiple risk dimensions. You will work closely with Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, business stakeholders, and suppliers to evaluate and manage supplier-related risks throughout the supplier lifecycle and support risk management activities embedded within Vanderlande's Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes.
  
  
A key part of the role will be supporting the adoption and operational use of supplier risk and cyber security monitoring tools, including BitSight or other approved risk intelligence platforms, to assess third-party cyber exposure, identify risk indicators, and support timely follow-up actions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support execution of supplier due diligence activities as part of supplier onboarding, qualification, periodic reassessment, and ongoing monitoring processes.
* Conduct supplier risk assessments across ESG, cyber security, information security, financial stability, compliance, geopolitical, operational, and business continuity risk dimensions.
* Review supplier information, responses, supporting documentation, certifications, policies, and evidence to validate due diligence outcomes and identify potential risk indicators and information gaps.
* Review supplier cyber security documentation, including security questionnaires, ISO 27001 certifications, NIS2, SOC reports, data privacy indicators, business continuity documentation, and third-party cyber risk ratings.
* Support the implementation and operational use of BitSight or similar approved cyber risk intelligence platforms, including supplier monitoring, cyber risk score analysis, follow-up of identified risk indicators, and reporting to relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor supplier risk intelligence sources and identify emerging risks requiring escalation, mitigation, reassessment, or stakeholder review.
* Analyze supplier risk data and prepare clear insights, dashboards, reports, and management updates for procurement and governance forums.
* Review supplier documentation and due diligence evidence against established responsible sourcing, sustainability, compliance, and governance requirements, highlighting potential concerns and coordinating follow-up with relevant stakeholders
* Coordinate remediation activities with suppliers and internal stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, documented, and followed up within agreed timelines.
* Maintain accurate supplier risk records, assessment outcomes, documentation, dashboards, and reporting within approved systems and tools.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, IT, and business teams to ensure an integrated supplier risk management approach.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of supplier due diligence, ESG, risk, and cyber security assessment processes, templates, tools, and governance routines.
* Ensure all activities are executed in compliance with company policies, governance standards, confidentiality requirements, and regulatory expectations.

**What You Bring**
To succeed in this role, you bring a strong combination of analytical thinking, operational discipline, stakeholder collaboration, and risk awareness. You are comfortable working in a dynamic global environment and can translate supplier risk data into clear, actionable insights.
  
  
You should bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Sustainability, Risk Management, Information Security, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in supplier risk management, due diligence, procurement, sustainability, compliance, cyber security, audit, or a related field.
* Good understanding of supplier lifecycle management, third-party risk management, supplier onboarding, and supplier reassessment processes.
* Knowledge of ESG frameworks, responsible sourcing practices, sustainability regulations, and supply chain due diligence expectations.
* Understanding of cyber security and information security concepts, including third-party cyber risk, information security controls, ISO 27001, NIS2, SOC reports, data privacy, GDPR, business continuity, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with supplier risk, due diligence, compliance, ESG, or cyber risk monitoring platforms. Experience with BitSight or similar cyber risk intelligence platforms is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and other data analysis or reporting tools.
* Ability to assess supplier documentation, identify gaps, and translate findings into clear risk summaries and follow-up actions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across procurement, suppliers, technical teams, and global stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Curiosity, continuous learning mindset, and willingness to adapt to evolving regulations, risk landscapes, and digital tools.
* Business fluency in English.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.
  
  
At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**

title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst
description:
**About AppDirect**


Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture - one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.
  
  

**About You**


The Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst is an active participant in network incident management for managed WAN interfaces and managed security sites with circuits varying in size from T1’s to DS3, which employ technologies such as AVPN, ADI, MPLS, Multilink T1s, Ethernet, Cellular and Broadband. The role relies heavily on knowledge and understanding of monitoring and ticketing platforms to effectively troubleshoot and resolve issues.

The NOC Analyst interacts regularly with and is an advocate for all customers with whom he/she is working and who have subscribed to AppDirect’s Managed Network Services. This position requires a strong customer focus and an ability to deal with different customer requirements and priorities.

The successful candidate for this position will effectively utilize prior education and demonstrated work experience to make an immediate, independent contribution to the Network Operations Center team.

The NOC is an integral part of AppDirect’s 24x7x365 operational environment. This position may require occasional shift rotation to cover holidays, weekends, and other normal scheduling requirements as needed to support the business. Flexibility to work any shift as needed is required.

**What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact**

* Own, triage, and resolve customer network (WAN/LAN) related trouble tickets to successful completion
* Detection, tracking, and restoration of customer’s network connectivity via their data circuits and/or equipment
* Remotely troubleshoot and configure WAN equipment, including routers, firewalls, switches, and load balancers from various vendors
* Engage, escalate, and work with carriers and other 3rd parties when needed as part of service restoral
* Participate in incident command bridges, hypercare, and major incidents when required
* Understand and use network monitoring tools such as Zenoss or Logic Monitor to assist in troubleshooting or analyzing network issues and performance
* Converse with technical and non-technical contacts depending on the situation.
* Perform effective ticket management including but not limited to queue management, timely ticket documentation, proper hand-off to other analysts, teams, 3rd parties, etc., communications to customers, ticket resolution
* Adhere to established Service Level Objectives and/or Service Level Agreements
* Work both autonomously and also as part of a team, assisting, when necessary, on identifying and diagnosing issues

**What we’re looking for**

*Required*

* Minimum of two (2) years of WAN/LAN implementation and support/troubleshooting experience
* Well-versed in TCP/IP protocols and able to troubleshoot issues remotely
* Strong understanding of the OSI Model, SD-WAN, Transport, and TCP/IP
* Demonstrable experience with routing and troubleshooting routing issues with BGP, IGRP, RIP, and OSPF
* Must be knowledgeable in NAT, access lists, policy-based mapping, traffic shaping, and priority queuing
* Must have supported data networks and telecommunications functions in mid-size enterprises, including VPN, ADI, MPLS, Ethernet, Cellular, Broadband, Wireless (WWAN), Multilink T1s
* Must have experience in command line configuration using two or more of the following product lines: Cisco, SonicWall, Juniper, ADTRAN, Meraki, Fortinet, or other relevant technologies
* Knowledgeable with DNS, DHCP, VRRP, HSRP, VLANs, and Inter-VLAN routing.
* Knowledge of network monitoring and traffic capturing tools
* Must be conceptually familiar with security-related terms, and technologies, encryption, authentication, IPsec, VPN tunnels including GRE, and controlling traffic
* VoIP knowledge and experience is a plus
* Ability to interact, communicate, and collaborate with internal/external customers, service providers, and field technicians
* Strong verbal communication and documentation skills
* Strong process improvement and customer-focused skills

*Preferred*

* Large enterprise LAN/WAN environment or telecommunications company experience preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
* Experience working in a Managed Services organization a plus
* Experience with ServiceNow and monitoring tools such as Logic Monitor or Zenoss
* Possess or be working towards ITIL v3 or v4 Foundations Certification
* Relevant technical certifications a plus, i.e., CCNA, Network+, etc.
* Conceptual knowledge of Security Operations or experience is a plus

**Design it. Build it. Open it.**

Young Engineers' Academy (YEA!) is opening hands-on robotics, AI and maker learning centres for children across India — and we need a Design & Projects Manager — an architect or interior designer — who can take a centre from bare shell to launch day.

**About YEA!**

YEA! is a brand of the Robokidz group, a Pune-based K-12 STEM, Robotics and AI education company. At YEA! centres, children aged 6+ learn robotics, AI, coding, electronics, 3D printing and making by building. We are growing the network across India — company-owned centres and franchise partners.

**The Role**

You will own every centre end to end — site evaluation, design, BOQ, contractors, site execution and handover — and build the standard YEA! Centre Design Kit that lets us open faster, in more cities, at a predictable cost.

**What You'll Own**

* **Site evaluation**
  — test-fits, feasibility and fit-out budgets before a lease is signed
* **Design**
  — concept to GFC drawings; child-safe and on-brand labs, maker zones, studios, reception and parent areas
* **Execution**
  — BOQs, quotes, work orders, mall approvals, daily site management and handover on the committed date
* **Budget & vendors**
  — fixed budgets, bill checks, rate contracts and a reliable vendor panel across cities
* **The YEA! Centre Design Kit**
  — standard layouts, specifications, cost benchmarks and checklists for our own and franchise centres

**What You Bring**

* B.Arch, or a degree in Interior Design / Interior Architecture
* 2–5 years of experience, including commercial interior fit-outs (retail, showrooms, experience centres, preschools, cafés or offices)
* At least one or two projects taken end to end — design to handover — with drawings, BOQ and site photos to show
* AutoCAD, SketchUp and a rendering tool (Enscape, V-Ray, Lumion or similar); Excel for BOQs
* Working knowledge of services coordination, materials and current market rates
* Excellent communication in English and Hindi (Marathi a plus)
* A task master and a hustler who stays calm under pressure — multiple sites, tight deadlines, night work in malls
* Based in Pune or willing to relocate; frequent travel across India

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of every centre you build — and a design standard that becomes the national template
* Direct access to the Director & CEO, with quick decisions
* A growth path to lead a projects and design team as the network grows
* Competitive compensation; travel reimbursed as per company policy

**How to Apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn and include a link to your portfolio in your resume. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short design assignment before an interview with the Director & CEO.

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer

title: Manager, Technology - Network Engineering Operations
description:
**Job Description**
**Manager, Network Engineering Operations**
**About Williams-Sonoma, Inc.**
Founded in 1956 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a Fortune 500, digital first, multi-channel specialty retailer.Our company vision is to own the home, and the places where our customers work, stay, and play.We bring the latest home furnishing trends to life for customers through the individual lenses of our ten distinct brands, each serving different life stages and rooms of the home and beyond.Our brands include Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, West Elm, Rejuvenation, Mark & Graham, GreenRow, and Dormify. We are committed to sustainability, continuously working to protect our planet, while building an open and collaborative culture across our organization.
  
  
With more than 500 retail stores globally and multiple international franchise operations, technology is a core driver of our business strategy. We build and operate in-house platforms powering e-commerce, supply chain, merchandising, analytics, and customer experience ecosystems worldwide.
  
  
Engineers at the Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center build and scale digital commerce platforms that power these global brands, serving millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Manager, Network Engineering Operations will lead the India-based network engineering teams responsible for enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, wireless infrastructure, store network operations, and network reliability engineering. This role combines strong technical leadership, operational governance, engineering execution, automation enablement, and people management. The ideal candidate is an experienced network engineering leader who brings deep enterprise networking expertise together with strong operational judgment, incident leadership capability, and a passion for developing high-performing engineering teams. This role requires a technically strong leader capable of actively participating in engineering escalations, architecture reviews, project governance, budgeting, network reliability initiatives, automation discussions, and major incident management while also driving team development and operational maturity. This role reports to the Director, Technology Solutions Infrastructure.
  
  
**Impact of the Role**

* Lead and scale high-performing network engineering operations teams supporting critical enterprise infrastructure and store network environments.
* Drive operational excellence across enterprise network platforms by improving reliability, responsiveness, monitoring effectiveness, scalability, automation, and engineering consistency.
* Establish a strong culture of operational ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Lead operational readiness activities supporting peak retail periods, store operations, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.
* Partner with global engineering teams to ensure seamless operational coordination and support continuity.
* Leverage AI-assisted operational engineering practices to improve troubleshooting, monitoring analysis, operational reporting, and engineering productivity.

**Technology Platforms You Will Work On**

* Enterprise routing and switching
* Firewalls and network security
* VPNs
* Wireless infrastructure
* Load balancing
* Enterprise network monitoring and observability platforms
* Network configuration management and operational tooling
* Automation and scripting practices within network operations environments
* Store network infrastructure

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and scale high-performing network engineering operations teams supporting critical enterprise infrastructure and store network environments.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, wireless, load balancing, and network reliability operations.
* Conduct technical discussions involving operational risk, incident management, network reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness.
* Drive operational excellence across enterprise network platforms by improving reliability, responsiveness, monitoring effectiveness, scalability, automation, and engineering consistency.
* Lead operational governance processes including incident management, change management, escalation management, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* Partner closely with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure engineering, architecture, and platform teams to improve operational reliability and engineering collaboration.
* Mentor engineers through technical coaching, operational leadership, and engineering best practices.
* Establish a strong culture of operational ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Lead operational readiness activities supporting peak retail periods, store operations, and large-scale infrastructure initiatives.
* Partner with global engineering teams to ensure seamless operational coordination and support continuity.
* Leverage AI-assisted operational engineering practices to improve troubleshooting, monitoring analysis, operational reporting, and engineering productivity.

**Qualifications**

* Strong experience leading enterprise network engineering or network operations teams in large-scale production environments.
* Strong technical depth across enterprise networking technologies, operational engineering, automation, and network reliability practices.
* Ability to engage deeply in technical troubleshooting, operational escalation management, network reviews, and engineering decision-making.
* Proven experience leading technically strong engineering teams within enterprise-scale production environments.
* Strong balance of technical credibility, operational discipline, and people leadership.
* Demonstrated success building an engineering culture centered around accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking technologies including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, wireless, load balancing, and network security concepts.
* Experience managing complex incident response, operational governance, and major incident management processes.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, and network management platforms.
* Familiarity with automation and scripting practices within network operations environments.
* Demonstrated interest in AI-assisted operational engineering practices and automation-driven infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, highly collaborative enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 10+ years of enterprise network engineering or network operations experience.
* 4+ years of technical leadership and people management experience leading network engineering or operations teams.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of enterprise routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, load balancing, and wireless technologies.
* Experience with enterprise network monitoring, configuration management, and operational tooling.
* Familiarity with automation and scripting practices within network operations environments.
* Strong understanding of incident management, change management, and operational governance processes.
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and operational decision-making skills.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and business audiences.
* Experience supporting retail, eCommerce, store network infrastructure, or other large-scale customer-facing enterprise environments preferred.
* Experience supporting highly seasonal or peak-event operational environments is a plus.

**Why Join Williams-Sonoma India Technology Center**

* Our people first and performance driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career and invest in the well-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.
* Scale and innovation of a Fortune 500 company combined with a high-ownership that empowers engineers to make real impact.
* Build and operate large-scale digital commerce platforms serving millions of customers worldwide, working on systems that run at global scale.
* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven solutions, and large-scale engineering challenges.
* Hybrid work model designed for flexibility and collaboration, with two in-office days for team engagement.

**About Us**
**Williams-Sonoma India Pvt. Ltd.**
Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Today, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is one of the United States' largest e-commerce retailers with some of the best known and most beloved brands in home furnishings. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teens, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. We currently operate retail stores globally. Our products are also available to customers through our catalogs and online worldwide.
  
  
Williams-Sonoma India sourcing office was established in 2013. We are based in Gurugram, India. We are sourcing premium products across all categories of Home Furnishing and recorded double digit year-on-year growth. We have a dynamic team of over 100 members handling versatile vendors across India, Nepal & Bangladesh. We are looking to onboard talented people and create successful professional journey.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
The modern Security Operations (SecOps), effective Detection and Response relies on a tightly integrated stack like Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) aggregates and correlates vast telemetry, Threat Intelligence enriches that data with high-fidelity adversary context, and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) automates rapid orchestration and containment.
  
  
As the Detection and Response Technical Solutions Engineer Manager, you will empower engineers to debug issues across this entire pipeline from parser failures and rule latency to Application Programming Interface (API) integration bottlenecks while focusing on driving down escalation resolution times, fostering deep product expertise, and delivering a reliable, high-trust experience for enterprise security customers.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Lead a team across Asia-Pacific and India technical solutions engineering pods providing support across all Google SecOps (e.g., Chronicle SIEM, SOAR, and Google Threat Intelligence), through strategic direction, clear expectations, feedback and opportunities for professional growth.
* Partner with Software Engineering and Site Reliability Engineering to manage production incidents in real time, with emphasis on timely and thorough issue identification and customer communication
* Resolve high-profile escalations and issues, improve the customer experience and drive initiatives that increase their likelihood of success
* Work as people manager of engineers to partner with regional counterparts in Americas and EMEA to ensure seamless 24x7 case transitions, uniform SLA adherence, and standardized troubleshooting workflows

The successful candidate will work closely with Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Application Development, DevSecOps, Security Operations, and Risk teams to improve security posture through risk-based vulnerability management, exposure assessments, security testing, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Vulnerability & Threat Exposure Management**

* Perform vulnerability and exposure assessments across infrastructure, cloud, applications, containers, and enterprise technology platforms.
* Prioritize and validate vulnerabilities using threat intelligence, exploitability, business criticality, exposure, and overall cyber risk.
* Drive vulnerability remediation, validation testing, exception management, and risk acceptance processes to improve security posture.
* Monitor emerging threats, known exploited vulnerabilities, and security advisories to assess organizational impact and remediation priorities.
* Support attack surface management initiatives by identifying externally exposed assets, security weaknesses, and opportunities for risk reduction

**Cloud, Application & Container Security**

* Support vulnerability assessments across cloud platforms and cloud-native services.

* Review findings from application security testing, software composition analysis, and penetration testing activities.
* Partner with application and DevSecOps teams to remediate software, API, and supply chain security risks.

**Security Testing & Remediation Governance**

* Coordinate internal and external penetration testing activities across infrastructure, applications, APIs, and cloud environments.
* Review testing results, validate remediation ownership, and support risk-based prioritization.
* Track remediation activities through closure and coordinate validation or retesting activities.
* Work with technology teams to ensure timely remediation of identified security weaknesses.

**Governance, Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

* Produce vulnerability metrics, remediation reporting, and risk insights supporting operational governance and executive reporting.
* Maintain vulnerability records, audit evidence, and support risk documentation.
* Support regulatory, audit, compliance, and control testing activities.
* Help develop common vulnerability management processes, reporting standards, and governance practices that support consistency across global regions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of vulnerability management lifecycles, threat intelligence, risk assessment, and remediation governance.
* Experience working with cloud security, application security, container security, and security testing practices.
* Understanding of CIS Benchmarks, secure configuration standards, and security best practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to communicate technical risks clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Technologies & Tools:**

Experience with Vulnerability Management Platforms, Exposure Management Solutions, Cloud Security Tooling, Container Security Solutions, Application Security Testing Tools, Security Monitoring Platforms, Threat Intelligence Solutions, Security Automation, ITSM Platforms, and related cybersecurity technologies

**Organization Overview:**

Mizuho Global Services (MGS), Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, MGS Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

MGS Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

MGS Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices. title: CMS & Ecommerce Platform Lead
description:
**CMS & Ecommerce Platform Lead (Wordpress, Shopify, Sanity, Webflow)**
Location: Pune, India
  
  
Type: Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a CMS & Ecommerce Lead to own our website content platform and online storefront end-to-end. You'll manage everything from site architecture and content operations to product merchandising, checkout experience, and conversion optimization. This is a hybrid technical/operational role for someone who's equally comfortable managing/developing a CMS content model and analyzing funnel drop-off on the product listing page.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
CMS & Content Operations
  
  

* Own the CMS platform — traditional or headless (e.g., Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Contentful, Sanity, Strapi, Magento) including architecture, templates, and content governance
* Evaluate and drive decisions around headless/composable CMS architecture where it improves flexibility, omnichannel delivery, or front-end performance
* Manage the site's information architecture, ensuring content is structured for scalability, SEO, and reusability across pages/components
* Manage integrations between the CMS and other tools (analytics, personalization, marketing automation, CRM)
* Evaluate and recommend CMS platform upgrades, migrations, or replacements as the organization scales
* Troubleshoot CMS bugs and liaise with engineering/dev teams on more complex technical issues
* Ensure the website meets accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA), auditing templates, components, and content for issues like alt text, color contrast, keyboard navigation, and semantic markup
* Manage content modeling and API-driven content delivery for headless implementations, partnering closely with front-end engineering on consumption of the content API
* Define and maintain information architecture, taxonomy, and metadata standards across the site, structured for reuse across web, app, and other channels
* Manage the publishing workflow and QA process for landing pages, campaigns, and product content
* Manage site publishing, domain, DNS, and SSL/hosting configuration, ensuring the site is live, secure, and correctly pointed across environments
* Monitor site performance, page speed, and technical SEO health related to CMS configuration
* Train internal teams on CMS usage and maintain documentation/best practices

Ecommerce & Storefront Management
  
  

* Own the online storefront experience — product listing pages, collection pages, checkout flow, and merchandising
* Manage product catalog setup, categorization, pricing rules, and inventory sync with backend systems (ERP/OMS)
* Own site merchandising calendar — homepage takeovers, collections, promotions, and seasonal campaigns
* Monitor site performance, page speed, and mobile experience, partnering with engineering on fixes
* Manage integrations between the storefront and third-party tools (payments, reviews, personalization, email/SMS, analytics)

Cross-functional
  
  

* Partner with design and engineering on new page templates, storefront features, and platform upgrades
* Collaborate with marketing on landing page builds for campaigns and promotions

**What We're Looking For**

* 6+ years managing a CMS and/or ecommerce platform, including experience with both traditional and headless/composable systems (e.g., Contentful, Sanity, Strapi, Shopify Plus, Magento, BigCommerce, Wordpress, WooCommerce)
* Understanding of headless/composable architecture and API-driven content delivery (REST/GraphQL), and when it's the right fit vs. a traditional monolithic CMS
* Hands-on experience with product catalog management, merchandising, and promotions setup
* Hands-on experience with templates, architecture, taxonomy, and metadata standards across the site
* Hands-on experience in JavaScript/Liquid, php language (or platform-equivalent templating language)
* Solid understanding of HTML/CSS; comfortable with light template/theme edits
