title: Brand & Content Strategy Intern
description:
**Punekar Group**
is expanding into the cosmetics and beauty sector through 
**Aléxander & Victoria (AnV)**
, an emerging consumer venture focused on building an affordable premium beauty brand for the next generation of Indian consumers.

We are looking for a 
**business-minded creative who combines content creation skills with an understanding of branding, marketing and business management.**
 This role is designed for someone who can turn business ideas and consumer insights into engaging digital content while contributing to the strategic development and growth of an emerging consumer brand.

We are particularly interested in candidates from business management, marketing and related disciplines who actively follow digital trends, enjoy creating content and want to understand how brands are built, marketed and scaled.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of 
**content creation, brand strategy, digital marketing and business development**
, contributing directly to the development of a new consumer venture.

**Role Overview**

As a 
**Brand & Content Strategy Intern**
, you will work closely with the team at Punekar Group to develop the digital presence, brand identity and marketing initiatives of Aléxander & Victoria.

The role combines creative execution with strategic thinking and business analysis. You will be involved in creating digital content, researching consumer preferences, developing marketing campaigns, analysing competitors and supporting initiatives that contribute to the brand’s growth.

Beyond content creation, this role offers practical exposure to consumer behaviour, brand positioning, go-to-market planning and the commercial decisions involved in building a consumer business.

We are looking for someone who can 
**think strategically, create compelling content and approach business challenges with an entrepreneurial mindset.**

Roles & Responsibilities

* **Content Production:**
   Conceptualise, script, shoot and edit engaging reels, short-form videos, carousels, stories and other digital content for Aléxander & Victoria (AnV).
* **Creative Storytelling:**
   Develop compelling hooks, narratives, captions and creative concepts that communicate product benefits, beauty trends and lifestyle ideas in formats that resonate with Gen Z audiences.
* **Social Media Execution:**
   Plan and publish content, experiment with emerging formats and AI-powered creative tools, and improve content based on reach, watch time, engagement and audience response.
* **Brand Positioning & Identity:**
   Help develop and maintain the brand’s visual identity, tone of voice and communication style across social media and other digital touchpoints.
* **Market & Competitor Research:**
   Analyse beauty and skincare brands, consumer preferences, industry trends and competitor campaigns to identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.
* **Campaigns & Influencer Marketing:**
   Support the development of brand campaigns, product launch communication and influencer collaborations to strengthen brand awareness and audience engagement.
* **Digital Marketing & Paid Campaigns:**
   Assist in planning and executing digital marketing campaigns across relevant platforms, including Instagram and Meta Ads, to increase brand awareness, reach target audiences and support customer acquisition.
* **SEO & E-commerce Marketing:**
   Support search engine optimisation (SEO), keyword research, website content optimisation and digital growth initiatives to improve online visibility, attract relevant traffic and support future e-commerce sales.
* **Consumer & Market Insights:**
   Research target audiences, purchasing behaviour, customer preferences and emerging market opportunities to support business and marketing decisions.
* **Growth & Performance Analysis:**
   Evaluate content and campaign performance using relevant metrics, identify growth opportunities and recommend improvements based on data and consumer feedback.
* **Business Strategy & Execution:**
   Contribute to go-to-market planning, marketing initiatives and growth projects, understanding how content and branding support customer acquisition, brand development and broader business objectives.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for individuals who combine 
**creative ability, business acumen, communication skills and a strong bias towards execution.**

* **Academic Background:**
   Candidates pursuing or holding a degree in Business Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Management Studies, Communications or a related discipline are preferred. MBA and postgraduate management students with demonstrated creative abilities are particularly encouraged to apply.
* **Content Creation Experience:**
   Demonstrated interest or experience in creating reels, short-form videos, social media posts, personal-brand content or other digital formats.
* **Business & Marketing Understanding:**
   An interest in branding, consumer behaviour, marketing strategy, entrepreneurship and the commercial factors that influence brand growth.
* **Communication & Storytelling:**
   Strong communication skills and the ability to explain ideas clearly, develop engaging narratives and write compelling scripts or captions.
* **Creative Thinking:**
   An eye for trends, storytelling, visual presentation and the ability to identify why certain content captures attention.
* **Digital Fluency:**
   Familiarity with Instagram, short-form video formats, social media trends and the broader creator economy.
* **Initiative & Ownership:**
   A proactive approach to work, willingness to experiment and the ability to take ideas from concept to execution.
* **Analytical Mindset:**
   An ability to interpret content performance, research competitors and use consumer insights to improve marketing decisions.
* **Interest in Beauty & Lifestyle:**
   An interest in skincare, cosmetics, wellness, consumer brands and Gen Z culture is an advantage.

**Tools & Platforms:**
 Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Instagram, Meta Business Suite, Google Trends, Google Analytics and AI-powered content creation tools will be beneficial. Experience with video editing, on-camera presentation, paid advertising, SEO or e-commerce platforms is an advantage.

**Who Should Apply?**

This is a 
**Founder’s Office role**
 designed for individuals who want to understand how businesses are built, brands are developed and strategic decisions are translated into execution.

The role is suited to business management students, MBA candidates and aspiring entrepreneurs who combine creative thinking with commercial awareness. You should be interested not only in creating content, but also in understanding the business rationale behind marketing decisions, consumer acquisition, brand positioning and growth strategy.

We are looking for individuals who take initiative, think independently, communicate effectively and are comfortable working in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment where ideas are encouraged and execution matters.

**If you aspire to build a career in management, marketing, entrepreneurship or business strategy, this role offers an opportunity to develop both creative capabilities and a broader understanding of how a business operates and grows.**

**What You Will Gain**

* Practical exposure to building a consumer brand from the ground up.
* Hands-on experience in social media and digital marketing.
* Exposure to brand positioning, consumer research and marketing strategy.
* Experience in influencer marketing, campaign execution and audience growth.
* Practical understanding of paid campaigns, SEO and e-commerce marketing.
* An understanding of go-to-market planning, business development and consumer acquisition.
* Experience using AI tools and performance analytics in modern marketing workflows.
* The opportunity to work closely with the team at Punekar Group and contribute to real business initiatives.

**Compensation**

**Monthly Stipend: ₹6,000–₹10,000 per month**

**Application Process**

Interested candidates may apply through either of the following channels:

* **LinkedIn:**
   Submit your application through the LinkedIn job posting.
* **Email:**
   Send your CV along with proof of work to office@punekargroup.com.

Applicants are encouraged to include relevant work samples, such as reels, social media pages managed, videos created, personal-brand content, design samples, marketing projects or other examples demonstrating their creative and analytical abilities.

title: Team Lead
description:
**Company:**

Intent Amplify

**Location:**

Magarpatta Cybercity, Hadapsar, Pune

**Work Model:**

Work From Office (WFO) – Mandatory

**Shift:**

US Business Hours / Night Shift (India)

**Experience:**

4–8 years in B2B telemarketing, lead qualification or appointment generation, including 1–2

years of team leadership

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**About Intent Amplify**

At Intent Amplify, we believe successful B2B marketing is not about generating more names. It's about

identifying the right buyers, creating meaningful engagement and delivering qualified demand that Sales

teams can act on.

We are a B2B Revenue Activation company helping technology organizations connect market intelligence,

audience engagement, demand generation and buyer qualification into a measurable commercial

journey.

Our capabilities include:

**GTM Intelligence & Strategy:**

Market research, ICP development, target-account intelligence and

buying-group identification.

**Media & Marketing Activation:**

Thought leadership, executive interviews, content distribution

and audience engagement.

**Demand Generation:**

ICP-aligned campaigns, content syndication, MQLs and demand activation.

•
**Webinar & Event Audience Activation:**

Targeted registration campaigns and event audience

development.

**Pipeline Activation:**

Progressive lead qualification, including SAL, Intent, ANT, BANT and SQL

programs, enabling stronger Sales follow-up.

•
**Appointment Generation:**

Prospect engagement, discovery, objection handling and qualified

meeting coordination where required by the program.

Through
**CyberTech Intelligence**

, we also bring specialized cybersecurity market knowledge, security

buyer intelligence and engagement with relevant cybersecurity audiences.

Learn more:

https://intentamplify.com/

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a hands-on, performance-driven Team Lead – Operations who can build, coach and lead

a team responsible for engaging B2B decision-makers, qualifying buyer interest and generating high

quality sales conversations.

This is not a role focused only on managing dial counts or preparing daily reports.

We want someone who understands the difference between a contact and a qualified buyer, can turn

campaign requirements into effective calling strategies, and knows how to develop agents into confident

B2B sales professionals.

You'll work closely with our Campaign Operations, Quality, Revenue Execution and GTM teams to ensure

that campaign delivery meets agreed client expectations.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Team Leadership & Performance**

•Lead and manage a team of Telemarketing Executives and Appointment Generation Specialists.

• Set clear daily, weekly and monthly performance expectations.

• Monitor calling productivity, meaningful conversations, qualification outcomes and appointment

performance.

• Conduct daily huddles, coaching sessions, performance reviews and call audits.

• Identify performance gaps and implement measurable improvement plans.

• Support onboarding, training and skill development for new team members.

• Build a culture of accountability, consistency and continuous improvement.

**2. B2B Telemarketing & Lead Qualification**

• Manage outbound calling campaigns targeting US and other approved international B2B markets.

• Ensure agents understand campaign ICP, target accounts, buyer personas and qualification

requirements.

• Guide teams across MQL, SAL, Intent, ANT, BANT and SQL qualification programs.

• Train agents to identify business challenges, buyer interest, decision-making authority and

timelines.

• Ensure qualification evidence is captured accurately rather than assumed.

• Maintain lead quality, data accuracy and compliance with agreed client criteria.

• Monitor lead rejection reasons and implement corrective actions.

**3. Appointment Generation & Sales Conversations**

• Lead appointment generation campaigns involving senior B2B decision-makers.

• Coach agents on prospect research, cold-call openings, discovery questions, value articulation and

objection handling.

• Improve conversion from conversations to qualified meetings.

• Ensure appointments meet agreed campaign criteria before client handoff.

• Support meeting confirmations, follow-ups and rescheduling.

• Review meeting outcomes and use feedback to improve qualification and calling effectiveness.

**4. Campaign Execution & Client Delivery**

• Translate campaign briefs into practical execution plans for the calling team.

• Understand campaign goals, qualification frameworks, delivery timelines and acceptance criteria.

• Collaborate with Campaign Operations, Quality and Revenue Execution teams.

• Monitor campaign pacing, conversion trends, lead quality and delivery risks.

• Escalate operational issues proactively and recommend corrective action.

• Ensure CRM updates, disposition codes, call notes and qualification records are accurate and

complete.

• Support reporting and campaign reviews with actionable insights.

**5. Coaching, Quality & Continuous Improvement**

• Conduct regular call listening and structured feedback sessions.

• Develop scripts, discovery frameworks and objection-handling playbooks.

• Improve agent confidence when engaging Directors, VPs, CXOs and other senior decision-makers.

• Identify effective messaging, call approaches and qualification questions.

• Share campaign-level insights to improve targeting, messaging and performance.

• Lead by example through live calling, demonstrations and difficult prospect conversations when

required.

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential Requirements**

• Graduate degree from a recognized university.

• 4–8 years of relevant experience in B2B telemarketing, international lead generation, lead

qualification or appointment generation.

• At least 1–2 years of experience leading a calling or appointment generation team.

• Demonstrated experience working on US-market B2B campaigns.

• Strong understanding of MQL, SAL, BANT and SQL qualification methodologies.

• Practical experience conducting cold calls, discovery conversations and objection handling.

• Experience managing campaign delivery targets, agent performance and quality standards.

• Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

• Proficiency with CRM systems, calling platforms, Excel and performance reporting.

• Ability and willingness to work from our Pune office during US business hours.

**Preferred Experience**

• B2B technology, SaaS, cloud, IT services or cybersecurity campaigns.

• Appointment generation targeting enterprise or mid-market decision-makers.

• Managing multiple client campaigns with different qualification requirements.

• Coaching underperforming agents and improving team conversion rates.

• Working with US-based clients or stakeholders.

• Familiarity with account-based marketing and target-account lists.

**How You'll Make a Difference**

Your impact will go beyond the number of calls your team makes.

You'll help us:

-
**Turn activity into quality:**

Improve the proportion of conversations that produce relevant, validated buyer

intelligence.

-
**Build stronger talent:**

Develop agents who can confidently engage business decision-makers rather than

simply read scripts.

-
**Improve client outcomes:**

Ensure the leads and appointments delivered align with agreed qualification

standards.

-
**Create execution consistency:**

Build repeatable calling, coaching, quality and reporting practices.

-
**Strengthen Sales readiness:**

Help clients receive better-qualified buyers with clearer context for follow-up.

-
**Build a performance-driven team:**

Create an environment where productivity, quality, ownership and

professional development reinforce one another

.
**What Success Looks Like**

Your performance will be evaluated across both productivity and delivery quality, including:

• Daily calling and outreach productivity against defined team targets.

• Meaningful conversation and connection rates.

• Lead qualification and acceptance rates.

• Qualified appointments scheduled and held, where contracted.

• Campaign delivery against agreed timelines and requirements.

• CRM accuracy, documentation and compliance.

• Team coaching effectiveness and individual performance improvement.

• Client feedback, campaign quality and operational consistency.

**We value measurable outcomes not activity numbers alone.**

**Why Join Intent Amplify?**

**1. Lead a team that contributes to real commercial outcomes.**

You'll help shape how B2B technology

companies identify, engage and qualify prospective buyers.

**2. Work beyond traditional telemarketing.**

Gain exposure to demand generation, account-based

marketing, buyer intelligence, qualification frameworks and pipeline activation.

**3. Develop leadership capabilities.**

Own team coaching, execution quality, performance improvement

and campaign delivery.

**4. Gain exposure to international B2B markets.**

Work on programs involving US-market technology

companies, enterprise audiences and senior decision-makers.

**5. Influence how campaigns are executed.**

Your insights from live prospect conversations can directly

inform messaging, qualification and operational improvements.

**6. Grow with a revenue-focused organization.**

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to evolving

sales processes, team capabilities and scalable delivery practices.

**Who Will Thrive Here?**

- Someone who enjoys developing people but is equally comfortable getting involved in execution.

- Someone who can explain why a campaign isn't performing and knows how to improve it.

- Someone who understands that a successful calling team needs strong conversations, accurate

qualification, consistent coaching and disciplined execution.

- Most importantly, someone who takes ownership of outcomes rather than simply supervising

activities.

**If you believe great teams create great conversations and great conversations create stronger**

**commercial opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.**

**Apply:**

Share your updated resume with our recruitment team, mentioning Team Lead – Operations in

the subject line.

**Location:**

Magarpatta Cybercity, Hadapsar, Pune

**Work Mode:**

Full-Time | Work From Office | US Shift

title: Senior Technical Engineer - Backup/Storage
description:
Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Engineer - Backup/Storage to support our global Rubrik backup environment. You will operate, implement, and continuously improve Rubrik data protection across on-premises, datacenter, and cloud workloads, ensuring backups are reliable, secure, recoverable, and compliant with recovery objectives.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Operate and support the global Rubrik environment, including Rubrik CDM clusters and Rubrik Security Cloud, covering daily health monitoring, job success, capacity, and upgrades.
* Implement and expand Rubrik, including cluster and node deployment, workload onboarding, SLA domain design, replication, and archival.
* Protect a wide range of workloads, including VMware vSphere, physical Windows, Linux, and AIX hosts, databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server), NAS file shares, and cloud workloads.
* Manage SLA domains, retention, replication, and cloud archival policies aligned to business RPO and RTO requirements.
* Troubleshoot failed backups and restores, perform root cause analysis, and work with Rubrik support on escalated cases.
* Perform and coordinate restore testing, disaster recovery, and cyber recovery exercises, including immutable backups, anomaly detection, and ransomware recovery readiness.
* Plan and execute Rubrik software upgrades, hardware refreshes, and capacity expansion across global sites.
* Build backup reports and dashboards (e.g., Rubrik reports and Power BI) covering success rates, SLA compliance, capacity, and recovery readiness for the global landscape.
* Automate routine operations and reporting using Rubrik REST APIs and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Python), and maintain infrastructure-as-code where applicable.
* Coordinate with storage, network, virtualization, database, security, and application teams, as well as datacenter partners and third-party vendors, to deliver and support backup services.
* Manage incidents, problems, and changes through ITSM processes (e.g., ServiceNow), and provide evidence for internal and external audits.
* Maintain runbooks, standards, and operational documentation, and mentor other engineers on Rubrik and backup best practices.
* Evaluate new tools and technologies to improve backup performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.

**Required**
**What you will need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in Rubrik operations and implementation, including Rubrik CDM and SLA-based policy management.
* Experience protecting and restoring VMware, physical servers (Windows and Linux), databases, and NAS workloads with Rubrik.
* Strong understanding of backup and recovery concepts, including RPO and RTO, retention, replication, immutability, air-gapped copies, and the 3-2-1 rule.
* Good understanding of storage (SAN, NAS, and object storage) and of the networking needed for backup, such as DNS, NTP, firewalls, and bandwidth planning.
* Strong Windows and Linux administration skills and scripting experience for automation.
* Experience with cloud archival or backup targets such as AWS S3, Azure Blob, or OCI Object Storage.
* Strong troubleshooting, written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work with global teams and vendors.

**Preferred**

* Rubrik certifications and experience with Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC).
* Experience with other backup platforms (e.g., Veeam, Commvault, Cohesity, NetBackup) and migrations to Rubrik.
* Experience with Rubrik REST API, SDKs, or Terraform and Ansible automation.
* Experience with Power BI for infrastructure and backup reporting.
* Familiarity with recovery and resilience frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 22301) and ITIL change management.
* Experience with ServiceNow CMDB and asset discovery tools.

description:

This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.

* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.
* Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.
* Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred. Preferred:
* 3-5 years of relevant experience· Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Requirements**

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.

Skill / Experience
  
  
**Minimum**

* Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.
* Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.
* Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.
* Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.
* Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred.

**Preferred**

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients strengthen technology resilience and recovery capabilities across complex enterprise environments. As a Senior Consultant, you will support clients in identifying resilience risks, designing recovery strategies, and implementing solutions that improve preparedness for cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and technology failures. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, backup, and recovery domains to help organizations improve operational continuity and recovery readiness.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Conduct technology resilience risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, technical risks, and single points of failure across enterprise environments
* Design and implement cyber resilience, disaster recovery, incident response, and business continuity solutions aligned to client requirements
* Design, build, and maintain isolated recovery environments and support recovery of critical workloads, including applications, databases, and directory services
* Assess infrastructure, application, network, storage, and cloud environments to improve resilience architecture, backup integrity, and recovery readiness
* Lead recovery testing, simulation exercises, runbook development, and client preparedness activities across resilience programs

**The team**
Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help clients defend against sophisticated threats by transforming security operations, leveraging technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence for continuous monitoring and rapid incident response. They manage dynamic attack surfaces and support business continuity through services such as operational resilience, crisis and incident response, and security operations center transformation.
  
  
Resilience as a Practice focuses on preparing organizations to anticipate, withstand, and recover from disruptions—including cyberattacks, natural disasters, and operational failures—by embedding resilience into processes, technology, and culture. Deloitte’s Resilience Team combines technical, operational, and strategic expertise to deliver integrated solutions for business continuity, disaster recovery, and risk management, ensuring organizations meet regulatory demands and maintain stakeholder trust during crises.

* 6-10 years of experience with infrastructure architecture, application architecture, or both across on-premises and cloud environments

* Experience designing, implementing, or managing cloud solutions across at least two major cloud service providers
* Experience gathering technical requirements, performing gap analysis, developing technical specifications, and supporting large-scale solution architecture
* Experience with network segmentation, virtual local area networks (VLANs), firewall policy management, or isolated recovery environments
* Knowledge of National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800.53, International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, or governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) tools

* Experience with cyber resilience, technology resilience, business continuity, or disaster recovery programs

* Certifications such as Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), ISO 22301, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* Experience with resilience and recovery tools such as BC in the Cloud (BCIC), Everbridge, Rubrik, or Commvault

description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Manager, Cloud Container Services is responsible for the operational leadership, governance, reliability, and lifecycle management of the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes Service (CAKS) platform. The role leads a team of Kubernetes platform engineers and operations specialists responsible for delivering a secure, scalable, highly available, and automated container platform that enables application teams to deploy and operate workloads efficiently across the enterprise.
  
  
This position serves as the operational owner of the centralized AKS platform, driving platform adoption, service reliability, operational excellence, security compliance, and executive reporting. The role is accountable for providing leadership with actionable insights on platform performance, adoption, operational risks, capacity utilization, cost optimization, and service health. The role aligns closely with the enterprise Cloud Foundation strategy and centralized, multi-tenant AKS operating model.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Platform Operations & Service Ownership
  
  

* Own and manage the enterprise Azure Central Kubernetes (CAKS) platform.
* Ensure platform availability, stability, scalability, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change, Capacity, and Availability Management processes.
* Establish operational standards, support models, runbooks, and platform governance controls.
* Drive Kubernetes platform lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, and end-of-life planning.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements.

Kubernetes Platform Management
  
  

* Oversee centralized multi-tenant AKS environments supporting mission-critical and non-mission-critical workloads.
* Manage cluster operations, node pool lifecycle, networking, and platform integrations.
* Ensure secure workload onboarding and platform standardization across business units.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement scalable and reusable Kubernetes platform capabilities.
* Drive platform modernization initiatives, automation, and self-service capabilities.

Reliability Engineering & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Define and monitor SLAs, SLOs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead major incident management and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive reliability engineering practices and resilience improvements.
* Implement automation-first operational processes leveraging GitHub and Infrastructure as Code.
* Ensure disaster recovery and business continuity readiness for critical Kubernetes workloads.
* Reduce operational overhead through standardization and automated remediation.

Executive Reporting & Operational Metrics
  
  

* Develop executive dashboards and leadership reporting focused on:

+ Platform Availability & Uptime
+ Cluster Health Metrics
+ MTTR & Incident Trends
+ SLA/SLO Compliance
+ Kubernetes Resource Utilization
+ Capacity Planning & Forecasting
+ Node Pool Utilization
+ Security & Compliance Posture
+ Platform Adoption Metrics
+ Cost Optimization & FinOps Insights
+ Support Backlog & Service Request Metrics

* Present operational reviews, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership

**Security & Governance**

* Maintain enterprise Kubernetes governance standards.
* Oversee RBAC, Azure AD integration, Managed Identities, and secrets management.
* Ensure enforcement of Azure Policy, security guardrails, and compliance controls.
* Partner with Cybersecurity teams to ensure secure platform operations.
* Lead audit and regulatory compliance activities related to container platforms

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary operational contact for application teams consuming AKS services.
* Build relationships with Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, DevOps, and Engineering teams.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and strategic partners to optimize platform capabilities.
* Drive customer experience and service improvement initiatives across the Kubernetes ecosystem.

People Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Kubernetes platform operations team.
* Establish operational goals and performance expectations.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and technical capability growth.
* Promote a culture of automation, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Education & Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, container engineering or platform engineering with 15+ years of total work experience, including Azure and/or AWS environments.
* 5+ years of people management experience managing Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure, or Operations Teams.
* Proven experience managing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms, specifically:

+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
+ Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD.
+ DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, Hub and Spoke Architecture,
+ RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault etc..

* Strong experience leading ITIL service management functions, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Experience building and presenting executive operational dashboards and service reviews.
* Proven track record of driving platform reliability, operational transformation, and automation initiatives.
* Experience managing globally distributed teams and complex enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and Cloud Kubernetes Services.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, container orchestration, and cloud-native technologies.
* Expertise in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) administration and operations.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong knowledge of container technologies including Docker and container registries.
* Experience with GitOps practices using ArgoCD and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Bicep).
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, including Hub-Spoke architecture, Private Link, Azure Firewall, ingress, and service networking.
* Experience implementing Kubernetes security controls, RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Policy, and Secrets Management.
* Expertise in observability, monitoring, logging, and performance management using enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Planning
* Vendor and Managed Service Provider Governance.

Key Success Metrics
  
  

* Enterprise CAKS platform consistently achieves availability, performance, and security objectives.
* Increased adoption of centralized AKS services across business units.
* High levels of automation, self-service, and operational maturity.
* Reduced operational overhead and improved platform reliability.
* Leadership receives timely, actionable operational insights and recommendations.
* High-performing teams delivering secure, scalable, and resilient Kubernetes platform services.

Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

title: UAV Design & Additive Manufacturing Engineer
description:
**UAV Design & Additive Manufacturing Engineer**

Unmanned Systems | Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd.

**Location: Pune (full-time, on-site)    Experience: 3–5 years    Domain: Defence-grade UAV platforms**

**ABOUT ENHANSAFE**

Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd. is a deeptech defence and homeland security company focused on unmanned aerial systems and indigenous drone manufacturing. We build mission-ready platforms for defence and security users, and we are expanding our UAV design team.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Own the mechanical design of our unmanned platforms, from concept and CAD to flight-ready hardware. You will design multicopter and fixed-wing VTOL airframes, build and iterate them through in-house additive manufacturing, and keep our 3D printing lab running at production standard.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Design & Structural Engineering**

·       Design multicopter frames and fixed-wing VTOL airframes, including booms, fuselage, wing and mounting structures.

·       Design payload casings, enclosures and mounts with attention to weight, strength, thermal and ingress protection.

·       Run pre-assembly analysis: fit, tolerance stack-up, CG and mass balance, and structural checks before build.

·       Prepare production-ready CAD models, assemblies and engineering drawings with revision control.

**Additive Manufacturing & Rapid Prototyping**

·       Take designs from CAD to print: orientation, supports, slicing, infill and process parameters for each material.

·       Prototype and produce parts in PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, Nylon, PC, TPU and carbon-fibre-filled polymers.

·       Execute composite and continuous-fibre printing for load-bearing flight structures.

·       Select materials and process routes against strength, stiffness, weight and environmental requirements.

**Assembly, Integration & Validation**

·       Carry out carbon fibre assembly: bonding, joints, fasteners and airframe integration.

·       Support flight and bench testing; convert test feedback into design improvements.

**Printer Maintenance & Lab Operations**

·       Maintain, calibrate and troubleshoot FDM and composite printers: extruders, hotends, bed levelling, motion systems and firmware.

·       Keep print quality consistent and downtime low; support lab SOPs and equipment usage discipline.

**MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS**

·       3–5 years in UAV or unmanned system design, with at least one platform taken to flight.

·       Expert in 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CATIA, Creo or equivalent); working knowledge of FEA or structural simulation.

description:

 Pune, Maharashtra

 Full-time

 3–7 years

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Recruiter with strong experience in domestic IT staffing, particularly C2C (Contract-to-Contract), C2H (Contract-to-Hire), and bulk hiring.

The candidate will be responsible for leading the recruitment team, managing end-to-end hiring, coordinating with clients, and ensuring timely fulfillment of staffing requirements. Experience in US IT staffing is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Recruitment & Team Management**

* Lead the recruitment team, assign requirements, and monitor daily progress and performance.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment for domestic C2C, C2H, and bulk hiring requirements.
* Oversee candidate sourcing, screening, submissions, interview coordination, and follow-ups.

**2. Client & Staffing Management**

* Understand client requirements, hiring priorities, and staffing needs.
* Coordinate with clients and hiring managers to ensure timely fulfillment of requirements.
* Manage candidate submissions, interview feedback, negotiations, and resource deployment.
* Maintain strong client relationships and ensure quality hiring.

**3. Workforce Planning & Business Growth**

* Plan recruitment delivery based on client demand and talent availability.
* Identify staffing opportunities and support business development activities.
* Monitor market trends and contribute to expanding staffing services.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA in HR is preferred.
* 3–7 years of experience in IT recruitment and staffing.
* Strong hands-on experience in domestic C2C and C2H hiring.
* Experience in managing bulk hiring requirements.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring a recruitment team.
* Good understanding of client coordination, workforce planning, and recruitment metrics.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and team management skills.
* **US IT staffing experience is preferred.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of recruitment and placement targets.
* Timely fulfillment of client requirements.
* Quality of candidate submissions and successful placements.
* Recruitment team productivity and performance.
* Client satisfaction and contribution to staffing business growth.

Application Details

Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with their current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.

**CloudPrism Solutions is looking for a hands-on recruitment leader who can drive domestic C2C, C2H, and bulk hiring while managing a productive recruitment team.**

**Job Title:**
Assistant Admin Executive (Client & Government Communications)

**Company:**
Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd.

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra (with travel for demos, exhibitions and trials)

Full-time

Fresher or experienced candidates may apply

**About Enhansafe**

Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd. is a defence and homeland security company focused on unmanned aerial systems (UAS) and domestic drone manufacturing. We also offer integrated “360-degree” security solutions, including unmanned surface vessels (USVs), counter-drone systems, video surveillance, perimeter intrusion detection and traffic enforcement technology. We work closely with defence forces, police and government agencies across India.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a polished, articulate and professional Assistant Admin Executive who will be the face of Enhansafe. You will manage day-to-day communication with clients, defence and government officials, and act as the key link between customers and management through the Director Operations. This role combines administrative excellence, business communication and public-facing representation at product demos, exhibitions and defence and police trials.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Draft and send professional emails, letters and official correspondence to clients, defence officials and government departments
* Follow established communication protocols and etiquette when dealing with defence and government authorities
* Handle client queries on business matters, including quotations, proposals and pricing requests
* Follow up on ongoing projects, tenders and orders, and keep clients updated on status
* Act as the communication bridge between customers and management through the Director Operations
* Present Enhansafe products during demonstrations, after structured training from our team
* Represent the company at exhibitions, expos, and defence and police field trials
* Maintain organised records of correspondence, quotations and client interactions
* Coordinate meetings, schedules, travel and documentation for the Director Operations and the business team
* Use AI tools to improve drafting, research, documentation and overall productivity

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline (BBA, B.Com, BA, B.Sc, B.Tech or equivalent); MBA or a diploma in business administration is a plus
* Excellent spoken and written English, with a strong command of grammar and professional writing
* Proven ability to write clear, formal business emails and letters
* Confident, articulate and comfortable speaking to senior officials and groups
* Well versed with AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot) and willing to keep learning new ones
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Gmail)
* Strong organisational, follow-up and time-management skills
* Excellent personal etiquette, grooming and professional presence, as you will represent the company externally
* Willingness to travel for exhibitions, demos and trials
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in an admin, client servicing, sales support or corporate communication role
* Exposure to the defence, aerospace, security or government sector
* Experience preparing quotations or coordinating with government departments
* Prior experience in presentations, public speaking or event representation

**What We Offer**

* A front-row role in India’s growing indigenous drone and defence technology sector
* Structured training for product demonstrations and technical presentations
* Direct exposure to senior management, defence forces and government stakeholders
* Performance-based appraisal for freshers, with milestone-linked incentives
* A professional, growth-oriented work culture with real responsibility

**How to Apply**

Send a detailed application to
**directorops@enhansafe.com**
with the subject line “Application: Assistant Admin Executive”. Please include:

* Updated resume/CV
* Cover note explaining why you’re a good fit
* Salary slips (for experienced candidates)
* Educational and professional certifications
* Any relevant experience letters or work samples

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. Only complete applications will be considered.

**Enhansafe India Pvt. Ltd. |**
**www.enhansafe.com**

title: Manager
description:
**Role description**

About the Department:

  

The corporate finance department in the company handles all the financial and investment decisions. It primarily focuses on maximizing shareholder value through long-term and short-term financial planning and the implementation of various strategies. It aims to maximize the value of a business through the planning and execution of resources.

  

**The Role & Responsibilities**

  

We are seeking a highly skilled finance professional to oversee audit processes, financial consolidation, GAAP compliance, and financial analysis. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, compliance with regulatory standards, and providing key financial insights to support decision-making as per US GAAP, IFRS, IND AS, IGAAP

  

**Key Role Deliverables**

  

▪ Overseeing internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with company policies and financial regulations (US GAAP, IFRS and Ind AS, IGAAP)
  
▪ Leading the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial standalone financial closure and consolidation process for multiple entities (US GAAP, IFRS and Ind AS, IGAAP)
  
▪ Preparing and reviewing GAAP working and providing explanatory notes to the management for GAAP difference and supporting working in accordance with US GAAP / IFRS (as applicable)
  
▪ Staying updated on changes in GAAP/IFRS and assessing their impact on financial reporting.
  
▪ Implementing new accounting standards and providing technical guidance on complex accounting matters
  
▪ Liaising with auditors to facilitate audit planning, execution, and resolution of findings
  
▪ Maintaining and improving internal controls to mitigate financial risks
  
▪ Ensuring timely and accurate preparation of consolidated financial statements.
  
▪ Working closely with finance teams to ensure alignment with corporate policies
  
▪ Handling intercompany eliminations and reconciliations
  
▪ Ensuring compliance with SOX (if applicable) and other regulatory requirements

  

**Prerequisites**

  

▪ IFRS, US GAAP, Ind AS (Must) and financial reporting standards
  
▪ Experience in working with ERP systems (D365, Tally).
  
▪ Listed company or Big 4 experience
  
▪ Taxation including TP, Direct Tax, GST, International Tax
  
▪ Communication skills, presentation skills
  
▪ ERP and dashboard implementation skills
  
▪ Consolidation, ESOP, FX, TP, Corporate laws, Disclosure, ESG, lease accounting
  
▪ Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  
▪ Prior experience in a Big 4 firm or multinational corporation is a plus
  
▪ Excellent multi-tasking skills
  
▪ Relationship Management with cross functions
  
▪ Proactive and entrepreneurial traits; and a willingness to grow and learn on daily basis

  

Experience

  

Min 6-8 years of experience (post qualification)

  

**Education**

  

CA, CMA, (Mandatory)
  
CS, ACCA, Diploma IFRS (Optional)

  

Compensation

  

The compensation structure will be as per industry standard

As a Manager on the Cyber Incident Response team, you will be responsible for leading incident response engagements and supporting clients through complex cyber investigations and recovery efforts.

title: Precast Detailer and Checker
description:
**Company Description**
BTIPL is an engineering and construction-focused organization that specializes in delivering high-quality precast solutions for infrastructure and building projects. The company emphasizes precision, safety, and efficiency in its design and detailing processes to support reliable project execution. BTIPL promotes collaboration between design, production, and site teams to ensure that precast elements meet client specifications and industry standards. Team members are encouraged to develop their technical skills and contribute to continuous improvement across projects. The work environment supports professional growth and adherence to best practices in structural detailing and quality control.

**Role Description**
The Precast Detailer and Checker is a full-time, on-site role based in the Pune Division. The role involves preparing detailed precast element drawings, layouts, and reinforcement details in accordance with project specifications, applicable codes, and client standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with design engineers, reviewing structural drawings, and translating them into accurate shop and erection drawings for precast components. The Checker aspect of the role focuses on carefully reviewing and verifying drawings and schedules prepared by others to ensure dimensional accuracy, compliance with design requirements, and consistency with production and installation needs. The role also involves maintaining clear documentation, communicating with project teams to resolve design queries, and supporting quality assurance throughout the precast detailing process.

**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in precast and structural detailing using CAD or BIM tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, Tekla, or similar software).
* Sound understanding of civil/structural engineering principles, construction drawings, and relevant codes and standards.
* Attention to detail with demonstrated ability to check and review drawings for accuracy, completeness, and constructability.
* Effective communication and coordination skills for working with engineers, production teams, and site personnel.
* Ability to manage workload, prioritize tasks, and meet project deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering or related field; prior experience in precast detailing or structural drafting is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with quality assurance procedures, documentation practices, and basic project management principles.
* Commitment to safe work practices and continuous learning in precast technology and industry best practices.

title: Active Directory Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Cyberaube is a cybersecurity services company based in Nagpur and Pune that focuses on practical, vendor-neutral solutions instead of product reselling. The team brings over a decade of hands-on experience with leading security platforms such as QRadar, Splunk, CyberArk, Okta, and Guardium, helping clients avoid costly implementation mistakes. Cyberaube supports organizations with security talent placement, SIEM and IAM operations, data protection, and compliance with India’s DPDP Act and SEBI requirements. The company works with a diverse range of clients, including banks, hospitals, e-commerce firms, government bodies, and SaaS startups across India and beyond.

**Role Description**

* Senior Active Directory Engineer (L3) – Multi-Forest Enterprise
* Location: Pune or Nagpur (WFO)
* Experience: 7+ years
* Notice: Immediate–30 days preferred

**About the role**

We are looking for an L3 Active Directory engineer who owns the directory, not just the tickets in it. You will be the final technical escalation point for a large, multi-forest, multi-domain, multi-site Active Directory estate. When replication breaks, SYSVOL drifts or a DC fails, you read the repadmin and dcdiag output, find the root cause and fix it yourself.

**What will you do**

- Design, build and extend multi-domain and multi-forest AD: new domains, forest and external trusts, selective authentication, SID filtering and cross-forest DNS.

- Own replication health across a multi-site topology: sites, subnets, site links, costs, bridgeheads and KCC/ISTG behaviour.

- Diagnose and resolve deep replication failures: lingering objects, USN rollback, tombstone lifetime issues, and errors such as 8606, 8614, 8524 and 1722, using repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil and PowerShell.

- Support SYSVOL on DFSR: backlog analysis, dirty shutdown recovery, authoritative and non-authoritative restores, and FRS-to-DFSR migration where legacy domains remain.

- Manage the full DC lifecycle: promotion, demotion, forced removal, metadata cleanup, FSMO transfer and seizure, Global Catalog placement and OS upgrades.

- Run proactive DC health monitoring: define checks and alert thresholds, review Directory Service, DFS Replication and DNS logs, and act before users notice.

- Lead AD incident response for P1/P2 events and write the RCA and problem records that remove the cause, not just the symptom.

- Maintain AD backup and disaster recovery: system state backups, DSRM, and forest recovery planning and testing.

- Mentor L1/L2 engineers, write runbooks, and raise and execute change requests to ITIL standards.

**What you must have:**

- 7+ years in Windows infrastructure, including 5+ years of hands-on L3 Active Directory engineering in a large enterprise.

- Production experience in multi-forest and multi-domain environments, including setting up and troubleshooting trusts.

- Command-line fluency with repadmin, dcdiag, ntdsutil, dfsrdiag, nltest, setspn and the PowerShell ActiveDirectory module.

- A track record of resolving replication and SYSVOL/DFSR failures yourself, not escalating them.

- Experience leading AD incidents end to end, including writing the root cause analysis.

- An active Microsoft certification: Windows Server Administrator Associate (AZ-802), Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800 + AZ-801), or legacy MCSA/MCSE: Windows Server.

**Good to have:**

- AD CS / PKI, ADFS, Entra Connect in a multi-forest topology

- AD security hardening: tiered administration, LAPS, Kerberos/NTLM hardening, privileged group control

- Domain migrations or consolidations with ADMT or Quest

- PowerShell automation for health reporting and remediation

**THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF...**

Your Active Directory experience is mainly user and group administration, password resets and lockouts, SSO/Okta onboarding, or Entra ID and Conditional Access. Those are valuable skills, but this role is about the infrastructure underneath: domain controllers, replication, SYSVOL, trusts and forest design.

Please apply OR you may also send your resume with other details such as your current CTC, your expected CTC and your tetative availability to join if offered at info[at]cyberaube[dot]com

title: SAP PM CS

Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.
  
  
**Integrations Analyst**
*The largest and most impactful transformation in our 100+ year history is currently underway at New Balance. We have started a digital revolution, investing in exciting new capabilities for both our customers and associates. One of our primary initiatives is the reimagining of our global integration platforms that will unite our core business processes, aligning the demands of our channel sales with the real-time status of our supply chain. By unlocking new support functionality and consumer insights, this platform will allow us to anticipate and better serve the needs of our customers. We’re seeking agile thinkers who can quickly adapt in a collaborative, high-performance culture. Are you ready to join the revolution?*
**General Summary:**
As a Configuration Analyst for integrations, you will build, configure, and maintain EDI and non-EDI integration solutions on the Partner LINQ platform, contributing to New Balance’s global digital transformation. You will play a central role in migrating legacy IBM Sterling EDI and Cleo Harmony MFT integrations onto Partner LINQ — configuring mappings, orchestration flows, and business rules — helping drive New Balance to be a Top 3 Global Athletic Brand through responsive, standardized integration workflows that support consistent business growth, expand market share, and strengthen brand equity and reputation
  
  
**MAJOR ACCOUNTABILTIES:**

* Create and configure mappings, process/orchestration flows, business rules, cross-reference schemas, and lookups within the PartnerLinQ Design Studio to meet business requirements.
* Convert existing IBM Sterling maps and Cleo MFT flows to PartnerLinQ, leveraging AI Mapping Agent / template-based tooling to standardize and optimize designs for reuse.
* Perform unit testing on all integrations, coordinate with end-system teams, and support SIT and UAT cycles, producing test result reports against production sample files.
* Manage controlled promotion of tested configurations (mappings, alerts, dashboards, partnerships) from lower to production environments, validating dependencies and completeness before migration.
* Support white-glove partner onboarding: gather EDI specifications, IDs, and connection details; build mapping templates; run connection and business-rule testing.
* Support production deployments and provide post-go-live hypercare, troubleshooting transaction and mapping issues and creating SOPs / runbooks.
* Follow approved integration governance patterns, intake, documentation standards, and SLA checkpoints for all net-new and migrated integrations.

**REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS:**
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3 to 5 years of Hands-on experience configuring EDI/B2B integrations, ideally on PartnerLinQ or a comparable platform (IBM Sterling, Cleo), preferred.
  
  

* Working knowledge of EDI standards — X12, EDIFACT/EANCOM — and common transaction sets (850, 855, 856, 810, 820, 846)
* Mapping to/from canonical and flat-file formats
* Data transformation using XML, JSON, flat files, and XSLT

* Azure Integration Services (AIS) exposure (plus)
* Git / Azure DevOps (plus)
* Sterling→PLQ or Cleo→PLQ/AIS migration experience (nice to have)
* Solid analytical, documentation, and troubleshooting skills; ability to translate business requirements into detailed configurations. Good communication, critical thinking, and collaboration skills.
