 Sr. Test Engineer \- Master Data Management (MDM) Job
   

  

 Date: Sep 19, 2026
   

  

 Job Requisition Id: 65496
   

  

 Location:
   

  

 Pune, IN
   

  

 YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
   

  

 At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
   

  

**We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience Level 4\+ Years**
**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


****Required Skills \& Experience****
* 3\+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.


 At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
   

  

**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**
* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Principal, Enterprise Arch
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining and advancing architecture for Global Engineering. The candidate will be a key member of the Global Engineering Architecture team whose collective responsibility is to enable system development through aligned enterprise strategies, roadmaps, golden paths, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and governance frameworks. This role will partner with executives, enterprise architects, solution architects, application development teams, platform engineering, data, security, and the business. Must demonstrate a proven history of shaping large\-scale technology solutions that address the business objectives of a complex global organization. Ensures that business strategy, market trends, technology evolution, and AI\-enabled opportunities are effectively represented in the organization’s systems, platforms, data architecture, and business processes. Analyzes architectural requirements, defines the vision and target\-state architecture, assesses the current state, establishes transformation roadmaps, governs the project portfolio, and partners with solution architects and engineers to realize the target state.
   

  

 This individual must be delivery\-oriented, enterprise\-minded, and able to influence across senior business, technology, risk, security, and engineering audiences. Must be able to guide strategic direction and make pragmatic decisions that optimize business value, engineering velocity, resiliency, cost, security, regulatory expectations, and risk. Identify reusable platforms, shared engineering capabilities, overlapping functions, and opportunities to converge on standards in order to improve efficiency, quality, developer experience, and time to value across Global Engineering. The preferred candidate will have a broad background in enterprise architecture, application development, cloud\-native delivery, integration, data architecture, AI\-enabled solutions, platform engineering, security, and architecture governance. Must be able to work independently to solve complex problems, create and manage technology roadmaps, and collaborate effectively with a diverse set of partners.
   

  

**Knowledge / Skills**
* Previous or current hands\-on software development experience using modern application development frameworks such as Java/Spring, JavaScript/ReactJS, APIs, cloud\-native services, and engineering automation.
* Significant experience with enterprise architecture patterns, architecture governance, capability modeling, target\-state definition, and enterprise architecture best practices.
* Hands on experience designing and building of cloud\-native architectures; preference using Azure, AWS, Tanzu, and/or Kubernetes
* Deep knowledge of API and microservice style architectures
* Experience shaping AI\-enabled architecture strategies, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, model lifecycle management, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and integration of AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI, AI risk management, model governance, explainability, data privacy, security controls, regulatory considerations, and production observability for AI\-enabled systems.
* Experience using API Management Platforms and Storefronts (e.g. APIGEE, Software AG, etc)
* Experience using Kafka, Solace, and/or MQ for messaging/event streaming
* Deep knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and/or Zachman, with the ability to apply frameworks pragmatically across business, application, data, technology, security, cloud, and AI architecture domains.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, data platforms, metadata, data quality, lineage, and governance capabilities required to support analytics, AI, and enterprise\-scale decisioning; e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Mongo, data lakehouse, and cloud data services.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies and tools such as Agile, product\-oriented delivery, Github, GH Copilot, ADO Boards, Maven/Gradle, CI/CD (Actions), MLOps, LLMOps, and architecture\-as\-code practices.
* Experience with DevOps best practices and toolchain / pipeline automation, Azure DevOps and Atlassian Suite preferred
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and in particular, a broad and deep understanding of products and services provided by Northern Trust.
* Has an understanding of Global Engineering domains, enterprise platforms, software delivery practices, developer experience, cloud enablement, integration, data, security, and operational resiliency in a large financial services environment.
* Strong knowledge of security frameworks and controls.


**Major Duties**
* Define enterprise architecture strategies and target\-state roadmaps that provide business value while reducing complexity, technical debt, operational risk, and duplicated capabilities.
* Mediate conflicting priorities to drive optimal solutions.
* Identify and escalate duplication of effort, functional and technical redundancy, and opportunities to reuse Global Engineering platforms, standards, and shared enterprise capabilities.
* Create reference architectures and reusable patterns for common archetypes, including web, microservice, mobile, third\-party platforms, cloud\-native services, data platforms, AI\-enabled applications, and automation solutions.
* Quickly build proof of concept prototypes with new technologies being researched.
* Establish AI architecture guardrails, responsible AI design patterns, model governance expectations, data readiness criteria, and production readiness standards for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with platform engineering, data, security, risk, and application teams to integrate AI capabilities safely into enterprise platforms and business processes.
* Enable the development organization by creating working examples
* Create cloud, platform, data, and AI\-related frameworks that embed non\-functional requirements, including resiliency, observability, security, privacy, performance, scalability, cost management, and operational supportability.
* Define cloud, platform engineering, DevSecOps, data, and AI delivery best practices for Global Engineering.
* Training technologists and provide project\-based consulting/expertise
* Liaise with Enterprise Architecture, Global Engineering, Security, Data, Risk, Infrastructure, and application delivery groups to align architecture direction and execution.
* Solve problems collaboratively.
* Act as a subject matter expert on technologies and trends in enterprise architecture, cloud, platform engineering, middleware, data, security, infrastructure, generative AI, and AI\-enabled automation.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 12\+ years of technology experience across application development, engineering, architecture, platform, data, cloud, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 8\+ years of enterprise, solution, domain, or platform architecture experience, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and govern architecture decisions at scale.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI, data, automation, cloud, and platform architecture concepts to enterprise transformation, including responsible AI and AI governance considerations.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; MBA or Master’s degree preferred


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Sr Operation Manager Wedding
description:
**Role: Wedding Operations Manager** 




**Company:** 
 Benchmark Marcom Pvt Ltd
 



**Location:** 
 Pune (with extensive travel as required)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 







  





**Role Overview** 




 This role is the backbone of execution.
 



 As the Wedding Operations Manager, you are responsible for translating plans and designs into flawless on\-ground reality. You own logistics, timelines, vendor coordination, manpower, and problem\-solving across all wedding events.
 



 This is not a desk role. It requires presence, decisiveness, and the ability to stay composed while managing complexity, scale, and pressure.
 



 You are the person who ensures that what was promised is delivered—quietly, efficiently, and without drama.
 







  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Event Operations \& Execution** 



* Own end\-to\-end operational planning for all wedding events
* Create detailed event\-wise execution timelines and run\-of\-show documents
* Ensure smooth setup, transitions, and breakdowns across events
* Anticipate operational risks and plan contingencies in advance



**2\. Vendor \& Partner Management** 



* Coordinate with all vendors: decor, production, lighting, sound, hospitality, logistics, security, artists, and venues
* Share clear timelines, layouts, and expectations with each vendor
* Monitor vendor performance and adherence to timelines and scope
* Handle on\-ground negotiations, issue resolution, and last\-minute adjustments



**3\. Team \& Manpower Management** 



* Plan and deploy on\-ground teams effectively
* Assign clear roles and responsibilities to coordinators and staff
* Ensure team discipline, punctuality, and alignment
* Act as the central command point during events



**4\. Budget \& Resource Control** 



* Ensure execution stays aligned with approved budgets
* Track scope changes and flag cost implications early
* Minimise wastage through smart planning and reuse
* Coordinate with planning and accounts teams on reconciliations



**5\. Client \& Internal Coordination** 



* Work closely with Client Service, Planning, and Design teams
* Ensure client\-approved plans are executed accurately
* Shield clients from operational stress during events
* Communicate calmly and clearly during high\-pressure moments



**6\. On\-Ground Crisis Management** 



* Handle unexpected issues decisively (weather, delays, vendor failures, guest\-related challenges)
* Make quick, practical decisions without escalating panic
* Maintain control and clarity in chaotic situations







  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 4\-6 years of experience in wedding operations, large\-scale events, or hospitality operations
* Strong understanding of Indian weddings and multi\-day event formats
* Proven ability to manage large teams and multiple vendors
* Excellent logistical and organisational skills
* Comfort working long hours during event periods



**Good to Have** 



* Experience with destination weddings
* Exposure to luxury or high\-end events
* Understanding of production, staging, and technical setups
* Ability to read layouts, drawings, and spatial plans







  





**Skills \& Traits We Value** 



* Calm under pressure
* Decisive and solution\-oriented
* Highly organised
* Strong leadership presence
* Clear communicator
* Physically and mentally resilient







  





**What Success Looks Like in This Role** 



* Events run on time with minimal visible stress
* Vendors perform efficiently and responsibly
* Clients experience smooth, confident execution
* Issues are resolved before they escalate
* Planning and design intent is protected on ground







  





**Working Style \& Culture Fit** 



* This is a high\-ownership role
* Requires authority, accountability, and maturity
* Not reactive firefighting; structured operations are expected
* You will be trusted to make decisions independently







  





**Compensation** 



* Competitive fixed salary based on experience
* Performance\-linked incentives per project
* Growth opportunity into Head of Operations roles

title: Manager, Transaction Services
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
 Manager, Transaction Services
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Global Business Service Center (GBSC) is looking for a Manager for their Transaction Services team to deliver end\-to\-end support across the Procure\-to\-Pay lifecycle and oversee corporate card administration programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Cards (P\-Cards), and B2B payment solutions. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, and a natural problem solver.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**In This Position, You Will:**
* Administer and support Mastercard's corporate card programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Card (P\-Card), and B2B payment solutions, ensuring compliance with company policies and driving an optimal cardholder experience.
* Partner with cardholders, managers, banks, and internal stakeholders to resolve card program inquiries, support audits, manage exceptions, and identify opportunities to increase card adoption and program effectiveness.
* Ensure new suppliers are onboarded efficiently and timely with proper due diligence and risk assessments completed.
* Monitor PO spend and proactively submit requests to add funds to POs as needed.
* Provide advice on payment options, ensuring policy is followed for supplier engagements and charitable organizations (501(c)(3\)).
* Resolve and escalate issues in a timely fashion, providing updates to the customer.
* Provide insights on activity and recommendations on process improvements that will reduce friction and improve timeliness.
* Plan and organize work so that Service Level Agreement objectives are met or exceeded.


**All About You**
 The ideal candidate for this position should:
   

  

* Possess a deep understanding of the Procure\-to\-Pay lifecycle and supplier management processes.
* Have experience administering corporate card programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Cards (P\-Cards), and B2B payment solutions, with a strong understanding of card controls, policy compliance, expense management, and payment optimization strategies.
* Have excellent customer service skills, understand the customer journey, and advocate for process improvements that benefit both customers and operational teams.
* Work effectively across functions to drive resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. You turn problems into opportunities.
* Be skilled at explaining technical and process\-related issues succinctly and clearly.
* Have experience with ERP and expense management platforms such as Coupa, Oracle (R12/Fusion), Concur, or similar systems (preferred).
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, manage risk, and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
* Be highly organized, self\-motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


 Corporate Security Responsibility
   

  

 Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security. All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And Therefore, It Is Expected That The Successful Candidate For This Position Must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Lead Engineer - Digital Design
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 The Lead Engineer will provide technical leadership in defining and executing the Digital Design technology strategy, driving capability development to support the Digital Engineering organizations vision of achieving zero engineering lead time. Primary responsibility of this role is to lead the development of the Digital Design technology roadmap and align it with the needs of key business stakeholders.
   

  

 The individual will be expected to collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams within the Modeling \& Simulation organization, as well as with product stakeholders, to develop and deploy impactful Digital Design solutions that support key NPI and NTI programs. The role also requires identifying emerging technologies, fostering innovation, and ensuring successful adoption of digital engineering capabilities across the organization.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities Would Include**
* Lead Digital Design Deployment for Strategic Programs


 Serve as the Technical Lead/Project Lead for Digital Design solution development and deployment across key NPI/NTI programs. Drive initiatives that enable 2x engineering design speed, reduce product development costs, and support Product Line strategic objectives.
   

  

* Drive Advanced AI/ML Capability Development


 Lead capability development programs focused on applying advanced AI and Machine Learning techniques in engineering, including Scientific Machine Learning (SciML), Generative AI, Reduced Order Modeling (ROM), and AI\-enabled vertical integration of engineering models.
   

  

* Shape the Long\-Term Digital Design Technology Roadmap


 Partner with business and technology leadership teams to define and execute the long\-term Digital Design technology roadmap. Key focus areas include: Multi\-Objective and Multi\-Disciplinary Design Optimization (MDO), AI/ML and SciML\-based hybrid models, Geometric Deep Learning, Generative Design, RAG and LLM\-based workflows for Engineering and RFQ processes
   

  

* Develop Strategic Technical Proposals


 Collaborate closely with Product Engineering and Digital Engineering teams to develop compelling technical proposals that address business challenges and accelerate technology adoption.
   

  

* Drive Technology Scouting and Contemporary Thinking


 Continuously monitor and evaluate emerging advancements in AI/ML for physics\-based engineering applications. Identify, assess, and facilitate adoption of relevant technologies that create competitive advantages for Eaton.
   

  

* Champion DFSS Adoption and Execution Excellence


 Lead the implementation of DFSS methodologies within Digital Design initiatives for NPI programs. Mentor teams, support Green Belt reviews, and promote data\-driven decision\-making to improve project outcomes.
   

  

* Foster a Culture of Continuous Improvement


 Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on improving Cost, Quality, and Schedule performance through effective application of ECIS tools, methodologies, and best practices.
   

  

* Mentor and Develop Engineering Talent


 Coach and mentor engineers to ensure high\-quality technical execution, foster innovation, and accelerate professional growth within the team.
   

  

* Build and Strengthen the Digital Design Ecosystem


 Represent Eaton in external forums, industry conferences, and technology consortiums. Establish and nurture collaborations with ecosystem partners, research institutions, and universities to accelerate innovation and capability development.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Masters degree in Engineering

title: School Outreach Manager
description:
You've never met the principal you're calling. Sixty seconds in, you need them to hand you fifteen minutes of an assembly, or ten minutes of their own time.
 



  





 This job is a hundred of those calls a month, and then actually turning up when someone says yes.
 



  





**WHY THIS JOB EXISTS** 




 Let's Enterprise runs The Working BBA, a three\-year degree where the real work is the curriculum. Students run projects for real companies, do real apprenticeships, and leave with a portfolio rather than a transcript. Families choose it over a normal college with a normal degree, and that is not a small decision.
 



  





 Almost nobody discovers the Working BBA on their own. A school has to say yes to a presentation. A career fair has to have a stall we're standing at. Someone has to be the person a principal actually picks up the phone for, and then the person who shows up and makes the case to a room of students. That's you.
 



  





**HALF THE JOB: THE PHONE** 




 • Cold call schools you've never spoken to, and ask the principal or the right decision\-maker for time. Most of them say no, or say nothing at all.
 



 • Get an actual date on the calendar. Not "let's stay in touch," a scheduled slot for a presentation, an assembly, or a career fair stall.
 



 • Keep a live list of every school you've called, where each one stands, and when you're calling back. Nothing goes cold because you forgot it.
 



 • Follow up like it's the job, because it is. Most yeses come from the third call, not the first.
 



  





**THE OTHER HALF: ON THE ROAD** 




 • Travel to the schools that say yes. Some weeks that's a day trip, some weeks it's back to back across a region.
 



 • Stand in front of a room of students you've never met and make the Working BBA make sense in twenty minutes, then take their questions.
 



 • Work career fairs. Hours on your feet at a stall, talking to student after student and their parents.
 



 • Hand off every interested student and parent to admissions with the context that got them interested, so the conversation doesn't restart from zero.
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




 • One to three years in education sales, admissions outreach, or a similarly rejection\-heavy sales or relationship role.
 



 • You can call a stranger, get past a receptionist, and ask a busy principal for their time without flinching.
 



 • You can hold a room of teenagers for twenty minutes and actually keep them listening.
 



 • You're genuinely fine with a full travel calendar. Some weeks you're barely at a desk. Your own two\-wheeler and a valid licence make this workable day to day.
 



 • You keep a pipeline organised, in your head or on a sheet. A hundred schools, a hundred different stages, nothing slips.
 



  





**NICE TO HAVE** 




 • An existing network of schools or principals in and around Pune
 



 • Experience specifically working a school career fair or education exhibition stall
 



 • Marathi or Hindi alongside English, useful well beyond Pune's city limits
 



 • Any CRM experience, even a spreadsheet you built and kept alive yourself
 



  





**WHAT IT PAYS** 




 ₹4,00,000 to ₹6,00,000 a year, plus travel reimbursed separately on top of that. Where you land in that range comes down to how much of your own pipeline you can build, and how fast a cold call turns into a scheduled meeting.
 



  





**HOW WE WORK** 




 Small team, so the work is hands\-on and the ownership is real from your first week. Alongside the usual leave and public holidays, we fund your learning every year, give you paid days for volunteering and for looking after yourself, and let you pick a few extra holidays that actually matter to you. How you grow here comes down to what you contribute, not your degree or your background.
 



  





**WHEN YOU'D START** 




 We'd like whoever we hire to join within a month of us making an offer. Sooner, if you can manage it.
 



  





 We read that answer before we read the CV.

title: EMS and Controls Engineer (BESS)
description:
Industrial Automation, BESS Controls and Energy Management Systems
 



  





 As a Control Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, integration, commissioning and
 



 troubleshooting of control systems for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), renewable energy and industrial power applications. You will be responsible for PLC programming and troubleshooting, control panel integration, communication interfaces, electrical control systems and field commissioning. This is an excellent opportunity for a highly motivated and hands\-on engineer with a strong foundation in PLC, industrial automation, electrical systems and control engineering to join a fast\-paced cleantech startup and work on next\-generation energy solutions.
 



 Place of Posting – Nashik, Maharashtra
 



  





 RESPONSIBILITIES
 


1. Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC programs for BESS, EMS and industrial automation applications.
2. Troubleshoot PLC systems, I/O, control logic, interlocks, alarms and permissive sequences.
3. Work with PLC platforms such as Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Delta or equivalent.
4. Design, configure and troubleshoot control panels, including PLC panels, relay logic, contactors, MCBs/MCCBs and control circuits.
5. Read and interpret electrical SLDs, control schematics, wiring diagrams and panel drawings.
6. Perform PLC panel wiring, I/O checking, loop checking and control\-system testing.
7. Integrate PLCs with PCS, BMS, EMS, energy meters, DGs, protection relays, switchgear and other field devices.
8. Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, Ethernet and CAN.
9. Develop and test control sequences for BESS charging, discharging, DG operation, load management, backup power and energy optimization.
10. Perform installation, testing and commissioning of control systems at customer/project sites.
11. Conduct FAT and SAT activities including I/O testing, communication testing, functional testing and sequence validation.
12. Troubleshoot electrical and control\-system issues during commissioning and operation.
13. Perform root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions to improve system reliability.
14. Coordinate with electrical, software, PCS, BMS and project teams to ensure seamless system integration.
15. Support integration of solar PV, DG, grid, BESS and industrial loads with the EMS and control system.
16. Maintain accurate records of PLC programs, control logic, communication mappings, drawings, test reports and system configurations.
17. Prepare commissioning reports, troubleshooting reports and technical documentation.
18. Provide technical support to customers and site teams during commissioning and post\-commissioning activities.
19. Follow project safety procedures and ensure compliance with applicable electrical and site safety requirements.



  





 QUALIFICATIONS
 



 o Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation Engineering, Diploma or a related field.
 



 o 4–7 years of hands\-on experience in industrial automation, PV/substation SCADA, PLC, control systems, electrical maintenance, commissioning or a similar field.
 




 o
 
 o Strong hands\-on experience in PLC programming and troubleshooting.
 



 o Experience with one or more PLC platforms such as Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Delta or equivalent.
 



 o Good understanding of PLC I/O, DI/DO, AI/AO, sensors, relays, contactors and control circuits.
 



 o Good understanding of electrical and control schematic diagrams.
 



 o Hands\-on experience with PLC panels, panel wiring, control\-panel troubleshooting and commissioning.
 



 o Good understanding of industrial electrical systems including LT panels, transformers, DGs, switchgear,
 



 VCB/ACB/MCCB and protection systems.
 



 o Knowledge of industrial communication protocols, particularly Modbus RTU/TCP and Ethernet\-based
 



 communication.

 Please submit your resume to

title: Sr Analyst Data Management
description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Vendor Master Sr. Analyst to support end\-to\-end vendor onboarding and vendor master data maintenance across Coupa and SAP. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate vendor creation/updates, completing required due diligence, validating banking details, and maintaining strong controls to mitigate fraud and compliance risk. The ideal candidate has strong stakeholder management skills, excellent attention to detail, and a solid understanding of Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) controls.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Vendor Onboarding (Coupa \& SAP): Manage end\-to\-end vendor onboarding requests including vendor creation, changes, extensions and deactivations in Coupa and SAP (ECC/S4\) in line with defined policies and approval matrices.
* Vendor Onboarding \& Maintenance: Create, update, and inactivate vendor master records per documented procedures; perform duplicate checks, validate required documentation (e.g., tax/legal forms, supplier onboarding forms), and ensure accurate capture of critical data elements.
* Bank Detail Validation / Fraud Prevention: Perform bank account validation and change controls (independent verification callbacks, bank letter/cancelled check review, IBAN/SWIFT validation, 2\-person verification) to mitigate payment diversion risk.
* Document Verification: Review and validate required documents (W\-9/W\-8, VAT/GST certificates, incorporation documents, address proof, remittance details) for completeness, authenticity, and alignment to the vendor request.
* Ticket/Queue Management: Manage vendor master tickets via shared mailbox/workflow tool, prioritize based on business impact and aging, and ensure SLA adherence with timely and professional communication.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Procurement, AP, Tax, Treasury, Legal, and business requestors to resolve data issues, clarify requirements, and drive first\-time\-right submissions.
* Issue Resolution \& Root Cause: Investigate and resolve vendor setup failures, duplicate records, payment blocks, and remittance issues; perform root\-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions.
* Knowledge Management: Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, and training material for vendor onboarding and master data processes; support onboarding of new team members.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Self\-Development: Build expertise in vendor master governance and P2P controls; stay current on Coupa/SAP enhancements and policy updates.
* Process Improvement: Identify recurring defects (duplicates, missing documents, bank change errors), implement standard checklists/automation, and partner with upstream teams to improve submission quality and strengthen preventive controls.


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Experience: 3 to 7\+ years of experience in Vendor Master Data, Vendor Onboarding, AP Master Data, or P2P operations in a shared services/BPO/captive environment.
* Systems: Hands\-on experience with Coupa supplier onboarding and SAP vendor master (ECC and/or S/4HANA). Exposure to ticketing/workflow tools is an advantage.
* Due Diligence \& Documentation: Experience performing vendor due diligence and verifying documents such as tax forms (W\-9/W\-8\), VAT/GST certificates, bank letters, and incorporation/address proofs.
* Data Quality: Strong attention to detail, ability to identify duplicates and inconsistencies, and commitment to first\-time\-right processing in a high\-volume environment.
* Communication: Strong and polished English communication (written and verbal) with proven ability to manage stakeholders and drive timely closures.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze trends, track SLA/aging metrics, and perform root\-cause analysis; good working knowledge of Excel.


**Educational Qualification**
* Graduate/Post Graduate in Finance/Commerce/Business Administration (MBA preferred).
* Certifications or training in SAP/Coupa, KYC/due diligence, or compliance controls are an added advantage.


**About Medline India**
 Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500\+ strong and growing team of technology, finance \& and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024\.
   

  

 We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered \& engaged team. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.
   

  

 At present, Medline Industries, LP holds the esteemed position as the \#1 market leader, delivering an extensive portfolio of over 550,000 medical products and clinical solutions. Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. We are proud to be recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Large Employers and Best Employers for Women. Additionally, the Chicago Tribune has consistently named us a Top Workplace for the past 12 years.

title: Senior HPC Cluster Engineer - AI, ML
description:
NVIDIA is a pioneer in accelerated computing, known for inventing the GPU and driving breakthroughs in gaming, computer graphics, high\-performance computing, and artificial intelligence. Our technology powers everything from generative AI to autonomous systems, and we continue to shape the future of computing through innovation and collaboration. Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Superclusters (MARS) builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems. By joining us, you’ll help design solutions that power some of the world’s most advanced computing workloads.
   

  

 NVIDIA is looking for a Senior AI/ML HPC Cluster Engineer to join our MARS team. You will provide leadership and strategic guidance on the management of large\-scale HPC systems including the deployment of compute, networking, and storage. You will be working with a team of passionate and skilled engineers across NVIDIA that are continuously working to provide better tools to build and manage this infrastructure. Ideal candidate is strong in building and maintaining distributed clusters, driving improvements, and has the ability to understand researcher computing needs.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Provide leadership in systems administration and service delivery on our AI/HPC fleet by coordinating system upgrades, responding to incidents, and delivering reliability improvements.
* Collaborate closely with global teams to deliver a world class user experience in AI and HPC research.
* Own day\-to\-day operations of production AI/HPC clusters, ensuring system health, user satisfaction, and efficient resource utilization.
* Develop and improve our ecosystem around GPU\-accelerated computing including developing scalable automation solutions.
* Build and maintain heterogeneous AI/ML clusters on\-premises and in the cloud.
* Create and cultivate customer and cross\-team relationships to meet user evolving user needs.
* Support our researchers to run their workloads including performance analysis and optimizations
* Analyze and optimize cluster efficiency, job fragmentation, and GPU waste to meet internal SLA targets.
* Conduct root cause analysis and suggest corrective action Proactively find and fix issues before they occur.
* Lead SEV triage and postmortems for reliability incidents affecting users or infrastructure.
* Participate in on\-call rotation and incident response for critical production GPU clusters.


**What We Need To See**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field or equivalent experience
* Minimum 5 years of experience designing and operating large scale compute infrastructure
* Experience with AI/HPC advanced job schedulers, such as Slurm, K8s, PBS, RTDA, BCM, or LSF
* Proficient in administering Centos/RHEL and/or Ubuntu Linux distributions
* Solid understanding of cluster configuration management tools (BCM, Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Salt, etc.), container technologies (Docker, Singularity, Podman, Shifter, Charliecloud), Python programming, and bash scripting.
* Applied experience with AI/HPC workflows that use MPI
* Experience analyzing and tuning performance for a variety of AI/HPC workloads.
* Passion for continual learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies and effective approaches in the HPC and AI/ML infrastructure fields.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Background with NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA Programming, NCCL and MLPerf benchmarking
* Experience with AI/ML concepts, algorithms, models, and frameworks (PyTorch, Tensorflow)
* Experience with InfiniBand with IPoIB and RDMA
* Understanding of fast, distributed storage systems such as Lustre and GPFS for AI/HPC workloads

title: PBAC Operations Engineer - RDT Identity & Access Management
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**PBAC Operations Engineer \- RDT Identity \& Access Management**
 Location: Pune
   

  

 As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team protects the organization’s global digital assets by developing and operating sophisticated security platforms. We work at the forefront of identity governance, fine\-grained authorization, and hybrid cloud security to support users and business\-critical systems in a highly regulated global healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

 As a
 **PBAC Operations Engineer** 
 in the Identity and Access Management (IAM) space, you will be part of a global team responsible for the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Policy Based Access Control (PBAC) infrastructure. You will play a critical role in protecting our information and assets by moving beyond traditional access models toward a dynamic, fine\-grained authorization framework that supports our global Zero Trust strategy. In this role, you will be the technical owner of the PBAC infrastructure, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, and deeply integrated into the Roche digital ecosystem.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 In this role, you will lead complex PBAC implementations and shape the future of dynamic authorization across our global enterprise. You will:
   

  

* Architect and maintain core PBAC components (PDP/PEP) across a hybrid global landscape to ensure high availability, resilience, and performance
* Lead the transition from initial use cases to enterprise\-wide adoption while defining organization\-wide standards for policy\-based authorization
* Act as the primary technical consultant for application and data owners to seamlessly integrate systems via RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC, and LDAP
* Drive the shift to Policy as Code (PaC) by designing automated pipelines for versioning, testing, and deploying authorization logic like software
* Own the tactical lifecycle of the platform, including version upgrades, security patching, continuous performance tuning, and managing external Managed Service Providers (MSPs)
* Streamline onboarding processes for new assets, ensuring strict alignment with global security standards, ITIL change principles, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR
* Bridge the gap between vendor capabilities and internal business requirements while navigating complex stakeholder networks across global cluster squads
* Collaborate with product managers and developers to resolve unusually complex problems and create secure, user\-friendly authorization flows


 Who you are
   

  

 We are looking for an expert technical leader who combines deep IAM expertise with strong stakeholder alignment skills. To excel in this role, you bring:
   

  

* Experience: 5–9 years of experience in IT/Security, with 4\+ years dedicated to IAM and specific expertise in PBAC/ABAC within large enterprise environments
* Education: A Bachelor's degree in a technical field is required; a Master's degree or Ph.D. is preferred
* Technical Mastery: Advanced knowledge of XACML, Policy as Code (PaC), and decentralized policy management alongside standard IAM protocols (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, and IGA)
* Development \& DevOps: Proficiency in Java or Python for custom integrations, paired with hands\-on experience using Git and CI/CD pipelines for secure code deployment
* Architectural Mindset: Strong advocacy for Zero Trust principles, prioritizing configurable off\-the\-shelf capabilities over custom builds for long\-term maintainability
* Consulting \& Analysis: Proven ability to apply systems thinking to complex business problems, conducting root cause analysis, eliciting requirements, and advising senior leadership
* Communication \& Collaboration: Excellent English communication skills to explain complex concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, mentor team members, and navigate dynamic cross\-functional environments


 Call to Action
   

  

 Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
   

  

**\#RDT2026**
 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Support Manager - Microsoft Dynamics
description:
**Your Role**
 The Support Manager – Microsoft Dynamics is responsible for leading and managing application support services for Microsoft Dynamics platforms, ensuring stable operations, high service quality, and continuous improvement. The role acts as the key interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, and external partners to ensure reliable, secure, and efficient support delivery.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end application support for Microsoft Dynamics solutions, ensuring availability, performance, and reliability across global business operations.
* Manage and prioritize support incidents, service requests, and problem resolution in line with agreed SLAs and ITSM processes.
* Act as escalation point for complex or high\-impact issues, coordinating resolution across internal teams and external vendors.
* Drive root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce recurring incidents.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and ensure support services align with business priorities.
* Own and continuously improve support processes, documentation, and knowledge management for Microsoft Dynamics applications.
* Manage and develop internal support resources and external partners, including workload planning, performance monitoring, and capability development.
* Support application lifecycle activities such as upgrades, patches, releases, and integration changes, ensuring minimal business disruption.


**To Succeed, You Will Need**
* Strong experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics (Dynamics 365 Field Service, CRM, or related modules).
* Proven experience in IT application support management within an enterprise or global environment.
* Solid understanding of ITIL / ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request Management).
* Experience managing third\-party vendors and support partners.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and non\-technical business stakeholders.
* Experience with ERP integrations, data flows, and downstream systems is desirable.
* Leadership experience managing or coordinating support teams.


**In Return, We Offer You**
* Plenty of opportunities to grow and develop.
* A culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behaviour and integrity.
* Potential to see your ideas realized and to make an impact.
* New challenges and new things to learn every day.
* Access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group.
* An excellent remuneration package
* Support for maintaining a healthy work\-life balance, including vacation, personal, and sick time.


**Uniting curious minds**
 Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

title: HRIS Analyst - Oracle Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 The HRIS Analyst \- Oracle Specialist will serve as a functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS) / Oracle Fusion HCM platform, with primary responsibility for the configuration, optimization, support, and expansion of HR technology capabilities across a multinational operating environment. This role will lead the design, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Oracle HRMS solutions and act as a key partner to HR, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands\-on Oracle HRMS expertise and a strong track record supporting global HR processes across Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, Oracle Time and Labor (OTL), and related modules.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM and provide day\-to\-day support, configuration, enhancement, and optimization across key HR modules.
* Lead system design, configuration, testing, implementation, troubleshooting, and production support activities for Oracle HRMS in a multinational environment.
* Partner with HR, Payroll, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into scalable Oracle HRMS solutions, and recommend best\-practice system designs.
* Support and optimize Oracle HRMS modules, including Core HR, Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Compensation, Benefits, Talent Management, and Oracle Time and Labor (OTL).
* Research, configure, and document solutions that address global business requirements, local country requirements, and process standardization opportunities.
* Coordinate and support system upgrades, patches, releases, and enhancements, including impact assessments, test strategy, regression testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
* Maintain system configuration, tables, security roles, workflow setup, and related controls to ensure system reliability, usability, and compliance.
* Develop, validate, and support reports, dashboards, and analytics that enable HR decision\-making and improve operational visibility.
* Ensure data integrity through audits, controls, interface monitoring, issue resolution, and process improvements.
* Train and support end users, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders on reporting, system functionality, and process changes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, improve user experience, and strengthen HR operational effectiveness through Oracle HRMS.


**What You Will Need**
 Education and Experience
   

  

* BA/BS in MIS, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
* Strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Human Resources Management System (HRMS)/Oracle Fusion HCM required.
* Significant progressive HRIS experience, including hands\-on experience supporting Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM.
* Demonstrated experience with Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, enhancements, implementations, testing, and production support required.
* Experience supporting global or multinational HR operations and country\-specific process requirements preferred.
* Experience supporting HR and/or Payroll systems, self\-service platforms, and related integrations preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Deep functional expertise in Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM configuration, workflows, security, testing, troubleshooting, system maintenance, upgrades, and release support.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle HRMS business processes across Core HR, recruiting, compensation, benefits, talent, time and labor, and payroll\-related workflows.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Oracle HRMS solutions with strong attention to process design and user impact.
* Experience supporting system implementations, upgrades, and large\-scale enhancements in a complex business environment.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data validation skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve system and process issues effectively.
* Advanced reporting skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and complex Microsoft Excel functions; Power BI experience is a plus.
* Strong customer\-facing, consulting, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across HR, IT, Payroll, and business teams.
* Working knowledge of data governance, privacy, and control requirements related to HR data.
* Experience in a high\-volume, transactional environment preferred.
* Oracle HRMS/Fusion HCM reporting, dashboarding, and analytics experience preferred.
* Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality \& Environmental Management System.


**Reporting Relationships**
 The incumbent reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position. This position does not have any direct reports.

 We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

title: Academic Counsellor at Toprankers Pune
description:
**ABOUT TOPRANKERS** 




 Toprankers is India’s most preferred digital learning platform for careers beyond engineering and medicine. With a mission to “unlock every learner’s true potential”, we provide curated learning experiences across domains like Law, Management, Design, Judiciary, and more. Through our brands such as Judiciary Gold, Creative Edge, Supergrads, LegalEdge, and Toprankers School of Law, we empower students with personalized learning, best\-in\-class educators, and a tech\-driven ecosystem.
 



 We are trusted by over 3 million aspirants and are rapidly expanding to redefine the way India prepares for competitive exams and careers.
 



  





**JOB OVERVIEW** 




 We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Academic Counsellor to join our team. The primary responsibility of the Academic Counsellor will be to engage with students, understand their educational aspirations, and guide them through the process of enrolling in our various coaching programs (CAT, CLAT, IPM, CUET, Judiciary \& etc). The ideal candidate will have prior experience in counseling students for these specific exams and a passion for helping students succeed.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Student Counseling** 
 : Interact with prospective students and their families to understand their academic goals and recommend appropriate courses and coaching programs (CAT, CLAT, IPM, CUET, Judiciary \& etc).
 



**Admissions Guidance** 
 : Assist students in the entire enrollment process, including course selection, fee structure explanation, and program details.
 



**Lead Conversion:** 
 Follow up with leads, convert inquiries into enrollments by addressing their concerns, and providing them with the right information to make informed decisions.
 



**Performance Tracking:** 
 Maintain records of student inquiries, applications, and conversions. Ensure timely follow\-ups and track the progress of leads.
 



**Student Engagement:** 
 Build and maintain relationships with students to ensure a positive counseling experience and increase student retention.
 



**Information Sharing:** 
 Stay updated on exam details, course offerings, and admission timelines related to CAT, CLAT, IPM, Judiciary and CUET to effectively counsel students.
 



**Feedback and Reporting:** 
 Provide feedback to the management team on student concerns, market trends, and competitor analysis.
 



  





**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS** 




**Experience** 
 : 0\-5 years of experience in academic counseling, preferably with a focus on competitive exams like CAT, CLAT, IPM, CUET, Design \& Judiciary.
 



**Educational Background** 
 : A Bachelor's degree in any discipline (preferably in education, psychology, or business).
 



**Strong Communication Skills:** 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to articulate complex information clearly and concisely to students and parents.
 



**Counseling Expertise:** 
 Experience in understanding student needs, guiding them through course selection, and addressing their academic concerns.
 



**Sales and Conversion Skills** 
 : Ability to follow up with leads, convert inquiries into enrollments, and meet enrollment targets.
 



**Customer\-Centric Approach:** 
 Empathy towards students' academic challenges and a strong desire to help them succeed.
 



**Problem\-Solving Abilities** 
 : Strong analytical skills to handle student concerns and provide effective solutions.
 



**Knowledge of Exams:** 
 In\-depth understanding of CAT, CLAT, IPM, and CUET exams, including their syllabi, eligibility criteria, and application processes.
 



  





**PREFERRED SKILLS** 




 Experience in working with EdTech companies or educational institutes.
 



 Knowledge of digital tools used for counseling and lead management (CRM software, etc.).

title: Tech S and T-Manager- Disaster Recovery- DB-ISR-Manager-GDSF02
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Manager\- Disaster Recovery (DB)**
**The opportunity**
 At EY, our Consulting practice brings together strategy, technology, and operations to deliver real\-world, value\-driven outcomes for our clients. As part of our database and data platform team, you will work with global clients to design, modernize, and optimize mission\-critical database environments. Leveraging EY’s integrated service offerings and innovative technology ecosystems, you will help organizations accelerate their cloud transformation and build resilient, future\-ready data platforms.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Engage with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable database infrastructure solutions
* Provide advisory on database strategy, modernization, and cloud adoption
* Design, implement, and manage enterprise database platforms across Oracle, SQL Server, and other database technologies like NoSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, etc.
* Perform installation, upgrades, patching, migration, and performance tuning
* Ensure high availability, backup/recovery, disaster recovery (DR), and security of database environments
* Configure and manage database\-level DR solutions such as replication, log shipping, clustering, Always\-On, Data Guard, etc.
* Participating in DR planning, readiness validation, and periodic DR drills in collaboration with infra teams
* Develop and maintain DR plans, recovery runbooks, recovery procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Support cloud migration and transformation initiatives (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS) including DR design considerations
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and cloud teams to deliver integrated solutions
* Troubleshot complex database and infrastructure issues including failover and recovery scenarios
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and best practices including HA/DR frameworks for consulting engagements
* Support proposal development, solutioning, and client presentations


**Requirements**
* We’re looking for people with functional knowledge and diversified background in the following areas:
* 8–11 years of experience in database administration and engineering roles
* Strong hands\-on expertise in at least two database platforms such as Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server
* Strong understanding of database high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) concepts and implementations
* Practical experience in database failover, backup/recovery, and DR technologies (e.g., Data Guard, Always\-On, replication)
* Exposure to enterprise DR/BCP concepts, with participation in DR drills or failover testing preferred
* Experience with additional databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or cloud\-native databases
* Exposure to infrastructure components including OS (Linux/Windows), virtualization, storage, and compute
* Hands\-on experience in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including DR\-aware architectures
* Knowledge of automation/scripting (Shell, PowerShell, Python)
* Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines is preferred
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to clients
* Experience working in consulting or client\-facing environments is preferred


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. You will gain exposure to large\-scale transformation programs, cutting\-edge database and cloud technologies, and global clients. We offer a collaborative and inclusive culture, continuous learning opportunities, and a platform to build a strong consulting career while deepening your technical expertise.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Blender 3D Animator
description:
We are The Future Animations. Our artists animate one of the fastest\-growing story universes on YouTube. The work goes out daily, to millions of people, on channels the audience is genuinely obsessed with.We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists.
 




  






 🎬 Role Description
 




  






 Full\-time, fully remote, anywhere in India.You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, paired with a dedicated lighting artist who renders it and a lead who reviews your work.
 




  






 📅 A typical week
 




  






 One morning check\-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting.
 





 You animate. Layout, body, expressions, lip sync, camera.
 





 Your lead reviews before publish. Notes come back the same day.
 





 Your lighting artist takes it from viewport to final render.
 





 You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never blocked waiting for a review.
 




  






 🛠️ What we give you so you can actually work
 




  






 Render farm access. Your laptop is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week.
 





 A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system.
 





 An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have.
 





 Blender add\-ons built in\-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes.
 





 A named lead who reviews your work and unblocks you, not a queue.
 





 A 200\+ artist Discord where people actually answer.
 




  






 💰 Compensation and how you grow here:
 




  






 We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here.
 





 Tier 3 — ₹4,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000\. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2\.
 





 Tier 2 — ₹6,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹60,000–₹72,000\. Your lead keeps working with you toward Tier 1\.
 





 Tier 1 — ₹8,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹80,000–₹96,000\. Past 12 minutes you're over ₹1,00,000\. Tier 1 is where we look first when a 3D Lead position opens.
 





 Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines.
 




  






 Two things worth saying plainly.
 




  






 None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire.Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead.
 





 Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community.
 




  






 ✅ Qualifications
 





 You need to be strong in Blender at:
 





 Layout and scene setup
 





 Character animation — body mechanics, facial expression, lip sync
 





 Camera animation
 





 Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable
 




  






 And you need to be someone who:
 




  






 Can own a full video without being chased
 





 Takes direction from a lead and turns it around quickly
 





 Has taste. Sees the difference between animation that's finished and animation that's good.
 





 Nice to have, not required: lighting and rendering.
 





 We care about your reel. We do not care about your degree, your city, or how many years you've been doing this. Some of our highest earners had no studio experience before joining.

 https://www.youtube.com/shorts/bvn8ESiF\-mI
 





 https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o7pxb\-qOTao
 





 Watch the character work and the camera. That's the bar.

title: Blender 3D Generalist
description:
**We are The Future Animations. Our artists animate one of the fastest\-growing story universes on YouTube. The work goes out daily, to millions of people, on channels the audience is genuinely obsessed with.** 




**We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists.** 




  





**🎬 Role Description** 




  





**Full\-time, fully remote, anywhere in India.** 




**You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, with a lead who reviews your work.** 




  





**📅 A typical week** 




  




* One morning check\-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting.
* You animate. Layout, body, expressions, camera.
* Your lead reviews before you start lighting. Notes come back the same day.
* You do the lighting and either render yourself or give us your file and we render for you.
* You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never just keep waiting for a review.



  





**🛠️ What we give you so you can actually work** 




  




* Render farm access. Your laptop/PC is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week.
* NO Lip syncing req to be done from your end. we take care of it.
* A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system.
* An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have.
* Blender add\-ons built in\-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes.
* A named lead who reviews your work and gives you go ahead.
* A 200\+ artist Discord where people actually answer.



  





**💰 Compensation and how you grow here:** 




  





**We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here.** 




  





**Tier 3 — ₹5,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000\. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2\.** 




  





**Tier 2 — ₹6,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹60,000–₹72,000\. Your lead keeps working with you toward Tier 1\.** 




  





**Tier 1 — ₹7,000 per finished minute At 10–12 minutes a month, that's ₹70,000–₹84,000\. Past 12 minutes you're over ₹1,00,000\. Tier 1 is where we look first when a 3D Lead position opens.** 




  





**Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines.** 




  





**Two things worth saying plainly.** 




  





**None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire.** 




  





**Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead.** 




  





**Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community.** 




  





**✅ Qualifications** 




  





**You need to be strong in Blender at:** 



* Layout and scene setup
* Character animation — body mechanics, facial expressions.
* Camera animation
* Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable
* lighting and rendering.



  





**And you need to be someone who:** 



* Can own a full video without being chased
* Takes direction from a lead and turns it around quickly
* Has taste. Sees the difference between animation that's finished and animation that's good.
* lighting and rendering.



  





 We care about your reel. We do not care about your degree, your city, or how many years you've been doing this. Some of our highest earners had no studio experience before joining.

* https://www.youtube.com/shorts/o7pxb\-qOTao



 Watch the character work and the camera. That's the bar.
